title: RPA Developer
description:

Louis Dreyfus Company is a leading merchant and processor of agricultural goods. Our activities span the entire value chain from farm to fork, across a broad range of business lines, we leverage our global reach and extensive asset network to serve our customers and consumers around the world. Structured as a matrix organization of six geographical regions and ten platforms, Louis Dreyfus Company is active in over 100 countries and employs approximately 18,000 people globally.

**UiPath, Python, and Document AI technologies**

+ Data extraction, transformation, validation
+ File processing (Excel, CSV, PDF, JSON, XML)

+ Develop extraction, classification, and data validation workflows

* Minimum of 4-8 years of relevant experience, preferably within an international organization.
* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Information Systems

Additional Information
  

* Must have 4-8 yrs of experience with RPA including Design, Development of various automation components and features available in Robotics Process Automation products specifically in UiPath.

* Knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate, SQL and .Net is a plus.
* Strong written and oral communication skills. Ability to communicate with different regionals business teams in a non-technical manner.
* Good time management skills to lead across the regions & departments automations
* Resilience and adaptability to unforeseen work demands.
* Good interpersonal and presentation skills.

LDC is driven by a set of shared values and high ethical standards, with diversity and inclusion being part of our DNA. LDC is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion.
  
  
LDC encourages diversity, supports local communities and environmental initiatives. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.

Sustainable value is at the heart of our purpose as a company.
  
  
We are passionate about creating fair and sustainable value, both for our business and for other value chain stakeholders: our people, our business partners, the communities we touch and the environment around us
  
  
**What We Offer**
We provide a dynamic and stimulating international environment, which will stretch and develop your abilities and channel your skills and expertise with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.
  
  
**We offer**

* A workplace culture that embraces diversity and inclusivity
* Opportunities for Professional Growth and Development

* Certified Great Place to Work

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech, UTR Tech
description: DescriptionAmazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises - Same-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1-hr/3-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time-critical orders on-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.Key job responsibilitiesAs an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellencePreferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience with very large distributed systems Knowledge of design process Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, RustOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.Company - ADCI - HaryanaJob ID: A10493791

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – OpenStack / Ceph / KVM
description:
**XLoud | Delhi , India | 4–8 years**

**About XLoud**

XLoud builds sovereign private cloud infrastructure on open technologies: OpenStack, KVM, Ceph and Kubernetes. We design, deploy and run production clouds for enterprises and government customers, and help them move off VMware onto open, KVM-based platforms using our own migration tooling (XMS). The engineers here own real infrastructure, from bare metal to tenant workloads.

**What you will do**

* Deploy, operate and scale production OpenStack clouds (Kolla-Ansible), including Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Octavia and Magnum.
* Handle day-2 cloud administration: availability zones, host aggregates, flavors, quotas, project/tenant management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot OpenStack services and the infrastructure underneath them: compute, networking, storage and control plane.
* Run Ceph clusters in production: OSD add/remove/recreate, flag management, PG and recovery tuning, capacity planning, and RBD/CephFS/RGW operations.
* Manage KVM/QEMU and libvirt, including CPU pinning, NUMA, huge pages, and GPU/SR-IOV passthrough for high-performance workloads.
* Execute VMware-to-KVM migrations for customers using XMS, from discovery and planning through cutover.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack (Magnum / Cluster API) for containerised and microservices workloads.
* Build automation with Bash, Python, Ansible and Terraform for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operations.
* Configure and debug networking: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, OVS/OVN, bridging, routing, iptables, DNS and DHCP.
* Manage physical servers through iDRAC, iLO and IPMI/BMC: provisioning, firmware and hardware fault handling.
* Monitor platform health with Prometheus, Grafana and ELK/OpenSearch, and act on alerts before customers notice them.
* Apply security hardening and access controls aligned with ISO 27001 and customer compliance requirements.
* Meet SLAs and follow ITSM processes for incidents, changes and problem management.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in private cloud infrastructure, with hands-on OpenStack administration in production.
* Strong Linux administration on RHEL/Rocky and Ubuntu: installation, kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, performance analysis and upgrades.
* Hands-on Ceph operations experience.
* Solid networking fundamentals and comfort debugging at the packet level.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).
* Ability to work directly with customer teams and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

**Good to have**

* RHCSA / RHCE, Red Hat OpenStack, or CKA certifications.
* Experience with SDN/NFV, OVN, or DPDK.
* VMware vSphere background, especially migrations off it.
* GPU infrastructure (vGPU, MIG, passthrough) for AI workloads.

**Why XLoud**

You’ll work on the full stack, from hardware to the cloud control plane, with a small team that builds and runs its own platform. The problems are real, the impact is direct, and you’ll learn more in a year than most roles teach in three.

*All academic credentials must be from recognised institutions and are subject to verification.*

title: Developer ETRM
description:

* Confidence with ticketing or incident tracking tools, such as Service Now and JIRA,

The successful candidate will be comfortable learning new technologies, working across different areas of the application stack, and contributing wherever their software engineering skills can provide value.
  
  
**Who We Are**

We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.
  
  
Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. Our success starts with our people; and a workplace that champions culture and belonging ensures we grow and thrive together.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

You will collaborate with product owners, software architects, data engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into highly functional, reliable and scalable technical solutions. Development work may span custom applications, Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Azure services, APIs, databases, web applications, integrations, and Power Platform solutions. Candidates must have practical experience developing, configuring, integrating, or supporting solutions in an enterprise environment. In addition to maintaining and enhancing existing applications, you will help modernize AVI-SPL's application portfolio by developing cloud-based solutions using Azure and established software engineering standards. The successful candidate will be comfortable learning new technologies, working across different areas of the application stack, and contributing wherever their software engineering skills can provide value.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Secrets Manager)
description:
**About Bitwarden**
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden's Secrets Manager team, you will build and operate the application stack that lets developers, DevOps, and cybersecurity teams centrally store, manage, and deploy sensitive credentials. This is a
**hands-on role**
. You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code within core concepts of secrets, projects, machine accounts, and access tokens across the product suite.
  
  
Secrets Manager spans a .
***NET API, a Rust SDK core, and a TypeScript and Angular web client,***
with SDK bindings in eight further languages and integrations written in Go, C++, Java, PHP and Python. You should be comfortable moving between languages and learning new ones as the work demands, developing deep expertise as you go.

title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**Own core simulation engine work: the tick loop, task allocation, traffic and collision resolution, and the boundary where third-party algorithm plugins hook into the simulation.**
**What You'll Do**

* Implement and optimize simulation algorithms — task allocation heuristics, multi-agent path planning such as SIPP-A\* — for correctness and performance at 400+ agent scale.
* Own parts of the plugin boundary: calling into sandboxed third-party algorithm modules from the simulation tick loop within a strict per-tick latency budget.
* Work on the in-memory map and graph representation the simulator uses for pathfinding and spatial queries.
* Write high-quality, tested Rust in an async runtime (Tokio), with close attention to allocation patterns and tick-time predictability.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5-8 years of backend or systems engineering experience, with meaningful production Rust experience (2+ years preferred).
* Experience with async Rust (Tokio or equivalent) and building systems with strict per-operation latency budgets.
* Solid grounding in discrete-event simulation concepts, multi-agent systems, or game/robotics simulation — tick loops, state machines, deterministic replay.
* Comfort with algorithmic work: graph algorithms, pathfinding (A\*, Dijkstra, or similar), or scheduling and allocation problems.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with WebAssembly runtimes (Wasmtime, Wasmer, Extism) or sandboxing untrusted code.
* Familiarity with warehouse automation, robotics, AGV/AMR fleet management, or traffic simulation.
* Direct experience with SIPP, A\*, or other real-time multi-agent path planning algorithms.

title: Application Packager
description:
Screening Questions: Application Packager and Deployment Engineer

Profile: 9-10 years' experience. PSADT packaging, Intune deployment (Win32, Microsoft Store, Enterprise App Catalog), working knowledge of Entra and DEX tools (Aternity, Nexthink).

Packaging and Deployment

**1.**
A PSADT package works when you run it as an admin on your test VM, but fails when Intune deploys it. List the differences between the two contexts that could cause this.

**2.**
An installer is user-context only (writes to HKCU or %AppData%), but you need to deploy it to shared or multi-user devices. How do you approach it?

**3.**
You must upgrade an app from v1 to v2 where v1 was installed with a different installer type (EXE to MSI) and has user config to retain. Describe your packaging and deployment design.

**4.**
Your detection rule is version-based, but some devices report "not installed" after a successful install, while others loop with repeated install attempts. What causes this and how do you fix it?

**5.**
Walk through the Intune Win32 app lifecycle on a device, from assignment to reporting. Which logs and services are involved, and where would you look if an app is stuck at "Download pending" or "Installing"?

**6.**
How do you handle an app that requires a reboot, a long install window, or user interaction in a pre-login or Autopilot (ESP) scenario?

**7.**
You are packaging an app with prerequisites (for example Visual C++, .NET, or a Java runtime) and a config file that differs per region or business unit. How do you structure packages, dependencies and assignments?

**8.**
When would you deploy an app as a Win32 package vs the Enterprise App Catalog vs a Microsoft Store (new) app vs a line-of-business MSI? Give a real example of each, including its limitations.

**9.**
Describe your approach to app updates at scale. How do you keep 50+ apps current without breaking users, and how do you roll back a bad version?

**10.**
You are asked to standardise packaging across a team of 5 engineers. What would you put in place?

Entra and DEX Tools

**11.**
Your team uses Aternity or Nexthink alongside Intune. What role does each tool play in an app deployment lifecycle, what data comes from where, and how would you use them to validate that a rollout actually worked?

title: MDM Developer
description:
Amex GBT is a place where colleagues find inspiration in travel as a force for good and – through their work – can make an impact on our industry. We’re here to help our colleagues achieve success and offer an inclusive and collaborative culture where your voice is valued.
  
  
Our Enterprise Data team, part of the Data Governance, Quality & Trust organization, is seeking a Lead MDM Developer to join the NOMAD team. NOMAD is GBT’s Master Data Management platform for supplier reference data, built on Ataccama ONE. It currently covers global hotel data and European rail data, consolidated from multiple supplier and distribution sources into a single governed master record. In this role, you will be the senior hands-on engineer for the platform: designing, building, and hardening the ingestion, cleansing, matching, merging, and publication pipelines that downstream consumers rely on. You will work directly with the Product Manager, MDM Analyst, Data Quality SME, and business stakeholders, and you will help raise the engineering standard of the team as it grows.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, and customize the MDM solution on Ataccama ONE, including the solution architecture, MDM data model, and integration patterns, and perform testing and debugging.
* Build and configure data sources and data consumers on the platform, including file-based (MFT) and API-based integrations.
* Develop and tune ingestion, cleansing, standardization, and match/merge logic across multiple source systems, and improve match accuracy and duplicate rates using measurable results.
* Own the publication layer: design and maintain the data deliveries that downstream consumers depend on, and manage the impact of changes on those consumers.
* Investigate and resolve data quality defects at root cause, including malformed source data, rematch gaps, and cleansing rule errors, and deliver hotfixes with regression testing.
* Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand integration requirements and translate them into technical requirements, estimates, and acceptance criteria.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, workflows, and data mappings so platform knowledge is documented and not held by individuals.
* Act as technical lead for the team: conduct design and code reviews, set development and release standards, and mentor junior developers and contractors.
* Partner with the Ataccama vendor and internal platform teams on upgrades, environment management, performance, and deployments across environments.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5+ years of experience in MDM, RDM, or a related data management field.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with an industry-leading MDM vendor platform. Ataccama ONE MDM/RDM is strongly preferred.
* At least one large enterprise end-to-end MDM implementation, from design through production support.
* Strong knowledge of data quality, data integration, and data governance modules and best practices.
* Solid understanding of data cleansing, data standardization, matching and merging techniques, and data workflow processes.
* Strong SQL skills. Python scripting is preferred.
* Experience integrating through file-based (MFT/SFTP) and API patterns, and managing multiple source feeds with differing formats and quality.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment, and make sound technical decisions with limited supervision.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to business stakeholders.
* Experience with reference or supplier data, location or address data, or fuzzy matching and entity resolution is a plus.
* Experience in travel, transportation, or enterprise technology sectors is preferred. Familiarity with travel industry data (hotel, rail, air) is a plus.

**Location and working arrangement:**
Gurgaon, India. The role reports to the MDM Product Manager, who is based in Poland, so daily working-hours overlap with Central European time is required. Occasional overlap with US time zones may be needed for stakeholder and vendor meetings.
  
  
**Location**
Gurgaon, India

* Travel perks: get a choice of deals each week from major travel providers on everything from flights to hotels to cruises and car rentals.

You are also responsible for collaborating with internal and client SMEs to deliver complex data mapping solutions for migrations: analyzing, designing and maintaining ETL workflows, resolving issues, testing and providing post-implementation support. Analyst Developers own non-functional requirements and are responsible for ensuring that their code complies with coding standards, is secure and performs well. **Experience Required**
Primary requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher (min A- average for under-graduate, first class for post-graduate);
* Confident, and able to take initiative in a delivery-focused environment;
* Independent, self-directed working style;
* Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic fast-paced industry;
* Enjoy working as part of a high-performance team;
* Hard-working, innovative and takes pride in their work; and
* Passionate about creating innovative solutions for customers.

Secondary requirements
  
  

* Some experience with one or many programming languages;
* Experience with the following modern and legacy development products and frameworks: Microsoft .NET, C#/VB.NET, ASP.NET, MVC, WebAPI and SQL Server, Javascript, ReactJS, jQuery.
* Experience with web development
* Familiarity with financial products and markets
* Understanding of web services and enterprise integration patterns.
* Familiar with tools for code analysis and automated testing

**About FNZ Culture**
Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. At FNZ we know that great impact is only possible with great teamwork. That’s why we value the strength and diversity of thought in our global team.
  
  
The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world.
  
  

* Customer obsessed for the long-term
* Think big and make an impact
* Act now and own it all the way
* Challenge, commit and win together

**Read more about The FNZ Way and our values: www.fnz.com/culture**
Opportunities
  
  

* Right from day one, you will work alongside exceptional, multicultural teams - experts in their respective fields - who will inspire and challenge you to make your greatest impact.
* Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing, global business that is leading the delivery of financial services via cloud computing and partners with some of the world’s largest companies;
* Working in a flexible and agile way that meets the needs of the business and personal circumstances;
* Remuneration, significant financial rewards and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority;
* We provide global career opportunities for our best employees at any of our offices in the UK, EU, US, Canada, South Africa and APAC.

Commitment to Equal Opportunities
  
  
At FNZ, we recognise that diversity, equity and inclusion are important factors contributing to our success. We embrace the unique perspective and capabilities of our current and future employees, which will help us continue to drive innovation and achieve our business goals. Recruitment decisions at FNZ are made in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to gender, ethnicity/race, faith, age, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, socio-economic background, disability or military veteran status where all applicants and employees are valued and respected. In addition, we want to ensure accessibility needs are well supported, if you require specific support please advise us.
  
  
**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Palantir Foundry and AIP Developer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Palantir Foundry and AIP Developer with 8–10 years of software development and data engineering experience. The candidate will design and develop data pipelines, ontology-driven applications, operational workflows, and AI-enabled solutions using Palantir Foundry and Palantir AIP.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop applications and data solutions using Palantir Foundry and AIP.
* Design and maintain data pipelines using Pipeline Builder, Code Repositories, Python, SQL, and PySpark.
* Build ontology-based data models, actions, workflows, and Workshop applications.
* Develop AI-enabled workflows using AIP Logic, AI agents, and large language model integrations.
* Integrate Foundry and AIP solutions with enterprise systems, databases, and REST APIs.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure data quality, security, performance, governance, and production reliability.
* Support code reviews, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production operations.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry and Palantir AIP.
* Strong knowledge of Foundry Ontology, Workshop, Pipeline Builder, and Code Repositories.
* Experience with AIP Logic, AI-enabled workflows, prompt engineering, agents, or LLM integrations.
* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, TypeScript/JavaScript, and Spark/PySpark.
* Experience with ETL/ELT, data modeling, APIs, and enterprise data integration.
* Familiarity with Azure, AWS, or GCP, along with Git and CI/CD practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience delivering enterprise-scale Foundry and AIP solutions in production.
* Experience integrating Palantir with SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Databricks, or other enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, data security, and access-control practices.
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery environments.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* 8–10 years of software development or data engineering experience.
* At least 2-3 years of hands-on Palantir Foundry experience.
* Practical experience implementing Palantir AIP use cases is strongly preferred.
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Software Developer
description:
**About ETS**
ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
  
  
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Software Developer provides high-level technical and analytical leadership to software development teams, manages business analysis activity, and oversees software development for external
  
  
clients. Additionally, the Software Developer contributes a high level of subject matter expertise to the IT department and coordinates the administration of assignments for projects and tasks. The Software
  
  
Developer champions IT strategic initiatives and brings a degree of awareness to industry trends. This position mentors other software developers.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Software development groups and teams in change control, issues resolution, requirements management, analysis and design, programming/construction, testing and transition of applications into a production environment
* Serve as technical expert on development, coding, testing, and debugging stages of application and system integration
* Provide a high level of visibility to clients and act as frontline point of contact regarding ETS standards
* Formulate and define system scope and objectives for assigned projects
* Lead activities and interact with users through all phases of the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to assure consistently timely and accurate delivery of business application systems per Service Level Agreements
* Develop detailed specifications, application coding, unit and systems testing for the IT department
* Examine, devise and modify procedures to solve complex problems that require a deep level of specialization and expertise in regard to existing system capabilities, technological advancement, operating time or the form of desired results
* Work with units throughout ETS to facilitate development, validation, and delivery of software solutions
* Lead the planning and training of internal clients when new applications are launched, or new processes are put in place
* The collaboration between team members as well as across FCEs/BSUs to identify ways to improve existing processes and technical output
* Provide technical and analytical guidance to team members to facilitate the implementation of new technologies
* Conduct project tracking activity and walk throughs of software code to ensure adherence to quality standards and procedures
* Conduct analysis, identification, planning and control of risk management procedures and practices at a departmental level.
* Promote and institute policies that foster quality standards and industry best practice
* Create and update all relevant documentation and specifications for design, development, and testing
* Provide recommendations for improvement to existing processes and procedures
* Responsible for staying abreast of all new technological trends, developments and products through participation in professional associations, familiarity with trade journals and professional publications,
* attendance of relevant conferences, etc.
* Adhere to ethical standards and comply with the laws and regulations applicable to the job function
* Strong programming skills and knowledge of information processing technology
* Extensive experience with the most current software engineering standards, practices, methods, tools and trends
* Prior experience working with Windows and Unix operating systems
* Must be able to demonstrate a proactive approach to problem resolution, attention to detail and the ability to be lead a team-oriented (cross process/function/group) environment
* Ingenuity and demonstrated proficiency developing technical strategies
* Ability to interact effectively with all departments and employee levels
* Demonstrated ability to develop technical solutions that adhere to corporate business objectives
* Ability to work independently on multiple projects
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
* Strong analytical skills are crucial

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent coursework emphasizing an information processing or business-related curriculum.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted if comparable knowledge and abilities can be demonstrated.
* 8+ years of progressively responsible software development experience.

**ETS is mission driven and action oriented**

* We are passionate about hiring innovative thinkers who believe in the promise of education and lifelong learning.
* We are energized by cultivating growth, innovation, and continuous transformation for the next generation of rising professionals as leaders. Â In support of this ETS offers multiple Business Resource Groups (BRG) for you to learn and advance your career growth!
* As a not-for-profit organization we will encourage you to lean in to your passion for volunteering. Â At ETS you may qualify for up to an additional 8 hours of PTO for volunteer work on causes that are important to you!
* The base salary range advertised represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. The base pay is only one aspect of the Total Rewards Package that will be offered to the successful candidate.

**ETS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe in creating a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity.**

title: NICE CXOne Developer
description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across five continents and operates in 25 countries worldwide. Miratech retains over 1000 full-time professionals and has achieved sustained shareholder value growth exceeding 25% annually over many years.
  
  
**Job Description**
Miratech is seeking a skilled NICE CX-One Developer to contribute to a large-scale customer experience transformation initiative for a Global leader in the Healthcare industry. In this role, you will design and implement NICE-based routing solutions, develop secure and compliant IVR applications, and play a key role in the migration of legacy call center systems to modern omnichannel platforms.
  
  
You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot complex issues, optimize customer journeys, and ensure seamless system integrations. This is a high-impact opportunity to apply your technical expertise in a mission-critical environment, helping shape intuitive and efficient customer interactions within a regulated, fast-paced industry.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and perform release planning, development, testing, and releases on multiple agencies IVR enhancements.
* Build Call flow designs and integration to backend systems using application program interfaces (API).
* Manage NICE BU and provide input into solution design, and optimization for network solutions.
* Provide routing design and implementation for contact center technology
* Cooperate with the Architecture team to design, develop, and deploy APIs, and consume APIs.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance to customers and internal teams when scripting issues arise
* Coordinate issue communication and resolution with multiple other tech teams in the event of a problem.
* Review support tickets with agency leadership and oversee any support questions from other team members that might be working on one of those agencies’ tickets

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience with Nice InContact CXone.
* 5+ years of professional background with NICE CXOne Studio scripting experience.
* Hands-on experience with NICE InContact and/or NICE CXone solutions.
* Experience with cloud-based SaaS/PaaS/IaaS providers and working with virtualized systems, including application servers, databases, and networking infrastructure.
* Understand business requirements with the ability to translate into technical requirements.
* Conflict management and clear organizational communication.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in Contact Center Dashboard Creation.
* Base knowledge of intersystem networking, and data traffic flow between components.
* Ability to troubleshoot end-to-end Call center applications including Chrome and Edge issues when interacting with a Web-based application like Salesforce/ Microsoft Dynamics

**Additional Information**
**We offer:**

* Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
* Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
* Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
* Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
* Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
* Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
* Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

description:

JMD Megapolis

2-5 Years

Full-Time

The ideal candidate will be responsible for website AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) activities, ensuring website performance, security, uptime, content updates, bug fixes, and implementation of new features. * Monitor website performance, uptime, speed, and functionality.
* Perform regular updates for themes, plugins, apps, and CMS versions.
* Conduct periodic website audits and health checks.
* Resolve technical issues, bugs, and website errors promptly.
* Ensure website backups and disaster recovery processes are in place.

* Customize Shopify themes and templates.
* Configure and manage Shopify apps and integrations.
* Implement new features, landing pages, and promotional campaigns.
* Optimize product pages, collections, checkout flow, and user experience.

* Develop and customize WordPress themes and plugins.
* Manage page builders such as Elementor, WPBakery, or Gutenberg.
* Create and maintain custom pages, forms, and functionalities.

* Handle WordPress migrations and server configurations when required.

**Website Optimization & SEO**

* Improve website speed and Core Web Vitals.
* Implement on-page SEO best practices.
* Monitor Google Analytics, Search Console, and website performance metrics.
* Ensure mobile responsiveness across all devices and browsers.

**Security & Compliance**

* Monitor website security vulnerabilities.
* Implement SSL, firewall, malware scanning, and security best practices.
* Maintain compliance with data privacy and security standards.

**Coordination & Reporting**

* Work closely with Marketing, Design, and Content teams.
* Coordinate with hosting providers and third-party vendors.
* Maintain documentation of website changes, updates, and maintenance activities.
* Provide periodic AMC reports and recommendations for website improvements.

**Required Skills**

**Technical Skills**

**Strong experience with Shopify Development.**

**Strong experience with WordPress Development.**

Proficiency in:

* HTML5
* CSS3
* JavaScript
* jQuery
* PHP
* Liquid (Shopify)
* Experience with Shopify Apps and WordPress Plugins.

**Website Management Skills**

* Website troubleshooting and debugging.
* Website security and performance optimization.
* Hosting and server management knowledge.
* Domain and DNS management.
* Backup and recovery management.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with WooCommerce.
* Knowledge of Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
* Understanding of SEO best practices.
* Experience with CDN, Cloudflare, and website caching tools.
* Basic knowledge of graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Figma, or Canva.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 2-5 years of hands-on experience in Shopify and WordPress development.
* Experience managing multiple brand websites simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Website uptime and availability.
* Resolution time for website issues.
* Website speed and performance scores.
* Successful completion of updates and maintenance tasks.
* Security compliance and vulnerability management.
* SEO and user experience improvements.

* Opportunity to manage and grow premium brand websites.
* Exposure to e-commerce and digital transformation projects.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Learning and career growth opportunities.

* Build and execute a plan to resolve current and backlog issues.
* Manage the change request process with IT stakeholders.
* Keep stakeholders in India, the US East Coast, and Europe proactively informed on status and progress toward resolution.

**Security and Architecture Reviews**

* Lead security and architecture reviews to obtain approval for production deployments and changes to existing applications.
* Work with IT stakeholders (Cybersecurity, Architecture, and Infrastructure) to explain and justify your proposed approach and incorporate their review of feedback into the solution.

* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Data Scientists, Cyber, Architecture, and Data Engineering teams

**Innovation and Modernization**

* Modernize legacy applications and processes, such as converting complex VBA macros and spreadsheets into maintainable yet cost-effective custom applications.
* Incorporate open-source libraries (e.g., operations research/optimization solvers, R&D and scientific analysis packages) to extend application capabilities.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science and software engineering.
* 4+ years of full-stack development experience, with deep expertise in Python + React is non-negotiable.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming.
* Hands-on experience with at least one frontend framework (Vue.js or React).
* Proficiency in TypeScript for frontend development.
* Experience building full-stack applications that include custom GenAI functionality (e.g., using Azure AI Foundry).
* Experience with Azure web services and CI/CD practices and tools.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to learning new technologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for working with team members and stakeholders in the US and Europe.
* Able to think flexibly, quickly learn new business and technical concepts, and apply a startup-style mindset to design innovative, efficient solutions for users
* Availability to work approximately 5 hours overlapping with US Eastern Time zone each day (approx. 8:30 AM–1:00 PM US East Coast time), which often requires a later start and end time in India.

**Desired Additional Skills**

* Confident using GitHub Copilot and Claude Code as developer tools, including know-how to optimize token usage when using these tools.

title: Analyst Developer
description:
Role Description
  
  
**This Role Has Been Created To**

* Serve the needs of junior and intermediate developers in the Analyst Developer job family.
* Provide developers with a basis for developing the business, technical and professional skills required to be an effective developer at FNZ.
* Provide a launching pad for transition into Senior Analyst Developer roles.
* Support delivery obligations to customers and internal stakeholders.

Analysis & Design
  
  

* Collaborate with analyst tester and developer colleagues to create user story definitions and acceptance criteria.
* Work within the constraints of the feature/user story to define the underlying detail of required changes.
* Collaborate with analyst testers and solution consultants to ensure the solution well-defined and fit-for-purpose. It must meet end-to-end requirements are work well. This requires learning underlying business processes and understanding the technical environment in which you are operating. Provide solutions and recommendations for the resolution of technical issues that arise and ensure solutions meet the technical specs and design requirements;
* Be a part of designing APIs and external system interfaces for integration into core FNZ products and third-party vendor applications.

Development
  
  

* Interpret complex financial business requirements and translate into high-transactional, high-availability, secure, working systems
* Design and build the highly intuitive user interface and interactive financial tools required by financial advisers and investors.
* Non-functional requirements: Consider non-functional requirements. We produce high-volume, real-time transaction processing systems that support millions of trades every day in investment securities in multiple world markets. You will work with other developers to make sure that solutions developed are secure, reusable, maintainable and performant.
* Collaborate with other developers to make sure that the solutions developed are robust and in-line with the requirements.
* Ensure code is designed and built in a reusable manner.
* Able to build medium complexity features end-end.
* Continually develop an understanding of the business functionality of FNZ platforms

Quality
  
  

* Participate in code reviews to gain feedback on your technique from senior peers and to give advice to junior peers. Review senior developers' code to enhance your skills and knowledge.
* Write automated unit tests for any newly created code; and
* Perform manual testing to ensure any changes made to the system are of a high standard and the system hasn’t regressed. Collaboration / Communication
* Engage in the collaboration and communication channels in the organisation. Participate in solution design to ensure that creative solutions and tough problems solved are called out appropriately to the developer community, and where they lead to visible outcomes, to the broader FNZ teams and clients.
* Collaborate with other developers to share knowledge, best practices, useful technology, and opportunities for cross-project system design / solutions.
* Mentor new starters to ensure they understand both platform and SDLC.
* Deliver knowledge-sharing sessions on topics of your personal expertise.

Technology
  
  

* Stay up to date with industry practices, new technologies, tools and methods and suggestion adoption that are best suited to FNZ.
* Proactively resolve technical (environmental, coding and testing) issues that impede development progress. Assist in the resolution of technical issues when requested.
* Create novel solutions to problems by incorporating cutting edge technology or generic concepts.

Functional Area Responsibilities
  
  
Analyst Developers at FNZ are all-rounders who can work across the full stack. This role involves working with complex business requirements in a wide range of functional areas in the financial services and platform domain. In this role, you are responsible for continued learning both in the FNZ business domain and your technical skills as a professional software engineer. You achieve this growth through hands-on work, training and interaction with your senior colleagues. You are also responsible for collaborating with internal and client SMEs to deliver complex data mapping solutions for migrations: analyzing, designing and maintaining ETL workflows, resolving issues, testing and providing post-implementation support. Analyst Developers own non-functional requirements and are responsible for ensuring that their code complies with coding standards, is secure and performs well. At entry-level, you are responsible for learning best-practice in these areas from your senior peers.
  
  
**Experience Required**
Primary requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher (min A- average for under-graduate, first class for post-graduate);
* Confident, and able to take initiative in a delivery-focused environment;
* Independent, self-directed working style;
* Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic fast-paced industry;
* Enjoy working as part of a high-performance team;
* Hard-working, innovative and takes pride in their work; and
* Passionate about creating innovative solutions for customers.

Secondary requirements
  
  

* Some experience with one or many programming languages;
* Experience with the following modern and legacy development products and frameworks: Microsoft .NET, C#/VB.NET, ASP.NET, MVC, WebAPI and SQL Server, Javascript, ReactJS, jQuery.
* Experience with web development
* Familiarity with financial products and markets
* Understanding of web services and enterprise integration patterns.
* Familiar with tools for code analysis and automated testing

**About FNZ Culture**
Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. At FNZ we know that great impact is only possible with great teamwork. That’s why we value the strength and diversity of thought in our global team.
  
  
The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world.
  
  

* Customer obsessed for the long-term
* Think big and make an impact
* Act now and own it all the way
* Challenge, commit and win together

**Read more about The FNZ Way and our values: www.fnz.com/culture**
Opportunities
  
  

* Right from day one, you will work alongside exceptional, multicultural teams - experts in their respective fields - who will inspire and challenge you to make your greatest impact.
* Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing, global business that is leading the delivery of financial services via cloud computing and partners with some of the world’s largest companies;
* Working in a flexible and agile way that meets the needs of the business and personal circumstances;
* Remuneration, significant financial rewards and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority;
* We provide global career opportunities for our best employees at any of our offices in the UK, EU, US, Canada, South Africa and APAC.

Commitment to Equal Opportunities
  
  
At FNZ, we recognise that diversity, equity and inclusion are important factors contributing to our success. We embrace the unique perspective and capabilities of our current and future employees, which will help us continue to drive innovation and achieve our business goals. Recruitment decisions at FNZ are made in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to gender, ethnicity/race, faith, age, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, socio-economic background, disability or military veteran status where all applicants and employees are valued and respected. In addition, we want to ensure accessibility needs are well supported, if you require specific support please advise us.
  
  
**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Lead ServiceNow Developer
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO**
**SITA**
We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world’s air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
  
  
Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
We are looking for an experienced Lead ServiceNow Developer to join our team and drive the development, configuration, implementation, integration, and support of ServiceNow solutions across the organization.
  
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on ServiceNow professional with strong technical expertise who enjoys working closely with business stakeholders to deliver scalable and innovative solutions. While strategic platform ownership and architecture responsibilities are not the primary focus of this role, we are seeking candidates with practical experience in Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales & Order Management (SOM), particularly in enterprise environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will possess strong development skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-quality technical solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, support platform enhancements, and contribute to the continuous improvement of ServiceNow services and capabilities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
  
  
Gather, analyze, and document functional, technical, and process requirements.
  
  
Design, develop, configure, customize, and maintain ServiceNow applications and workflows.
  
  
Deliver technical consulting and software development services across the ServiceNow platform, including enhancements, new functionality, and ongoing support.
  
  
Lead development and configuration activities for Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales & Order Management (SOM) solutions.
  
  
Participate in the implementation, enhancement, optimization, and support of ServiceNow CSM and SOM modules within enterprise environments.
  
  
Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and external systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, and other integration technologies.
  
  
Develop and support custom applications, workflows, automations, and business rules using ServiceNow best practices.
  
  
Configure and customize forms, workflows, UI policies, UI actions, business rules, catalogs, service portals, and related platform components.
  
  
Perform platform maintenance activities, including incident resolution, defect management, performance optimization, upgrades, patches, and user administration.
  
  
Support ServiceNow release planning and testing activities, ensuring new features and updates are effectively evaluated and implemented.
  
  
Ensure consistency across Development, QA, and Production environments.
  
  
Create and maintain technical documentation, testing artifacts, and operational procedures.
  
  
Support end users through troubleshooting, training sessions, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer activities.
  
  
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend innovative ServiceNow solutions that enhance business performance and customer experience.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS:**
**Experience & Certifications**

* 8+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience.
* 10+ years of experience within the IT industry.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification required.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) preferred.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification preferred.
* ServiceNow Micro Certifications preferred.
* ITIL Foundation certification preferred.
* Proven experience implementing ServiceNow solutions within enterprise environments.
* 8+ years of experience with Customer Service Management (CSM) and/or Sales & Order Management (SOM).
* Experience participating in enterprise implementations, enhancements, or support initiatives involving CSM and SOM.
* Strong experience configuring and customizing ServiceNow applications, workflows, forms, and business processes.
* Hands-on experience developing ServiceNow scripting components including:

+ Business Rules
+ Script Includes
+ Client Scripts
+ UI Actions
+ UI Policies
+ Fix Scripts
+ Inbound Email Actions
+ Flow Designer
+ Classic Workflow
+ Strong experience with REST and SOAP integrations, including scripted API development.
+ Experience developing custom ServiceNow applications and solutions.
+ Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments and resolving complex platform issues.
+ Demonstrated success delivering ServiceNow solutions that improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business outcomes.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow platform development and administration.
* Experience working with Customer Service Management (CSM) and/or Sales & Order Management (SOM) modules.
* Experience configuring and customizing CSM and SOM business processes, workflows, and related capabilities.
* Experience implementing, enhancing, and supporting enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
* Agile delivery experience.
* Azure DevOps experience.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow configuration and customization.
* Strong expertise in Flow Designer and Classic Workflow development.
* Experience creating integrations between ServiceNow and external applications.
* Experience developing custom applications on the ServiceNow platform.
* Experience troubleshooting complex workflows and integrations involving multiple external systems.
* Experience modifying and maintaining ServiceNow forms, transform maps, service catalogs, SLAs, web services, and related platform components.
* Experience with ServiceNow Service Portal development and troubleshooting.
* Strong scripting experience across the ServiceNow platform.
* Ability to create, manage, and optimize workflows and automations.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow development standards, best practices, and platform capabilities.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within global teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in complex ServiceNow environments involving LDAP, SSO, and Domain Separation.
* Experience with Telecom Order Management and Network Inventory Management.
* Experience with ServiceNow Field Service Management (FSM).
* Experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management (SAM).
* Experience with Integration Hub.
* Experience developing ServiceNow custom applications.
* Experience with ServiceNow Agile Development and Test Management applications.
* Experience monitoring platform health, usage, compliance, and performance.
* Experience with HTML, JavaScript, Jelly Script, and related web technologies.
* Knowledge of SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, cloud computing, and automation principles.
* Experience producing technical and end-user documentation.
* Strong presentation, communication, and training skills.
* Experience with ITSM and ITOM modules; however, candidates with direct CSM and SOM experience will be prioritized.

**What We Offer**
We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡

Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)
  
  
⏰

Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎

🌿

We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀

: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
  
  
**🙌🏽**

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
**Company Profile**

Our client operates a large, complex pan-India electronics distribution network across India spanning mobile devices, consumer electronics, telecom accessories, and IT products. It is building an AI-native operations platform to rethink how distribution and logistics businesses run—from purchasing, inventory, and order management to logistics, reconciliation, finance, compliance, partner portals, and internal systems. It offers more than just solutions - it helps build ecosystems for long-term success. Their services are designed to accelerate growth, drive operational excellence, and unlock new possibilities for businesses across industries.

The client is part of a diversified business conglomerate with a strategic presence in four high-growth verticals – Trading & Distribution, Technology, Financial Services and Strategic investments. Each business unit is built to lead its domain, fuelling transformation through technology, scale, and impact.

**Job Profile**
: Senior Python Developer

**Location:**
Gurgaon, India

**Employment Type**
– Full Time

**Preferred experience:**
- 5-10 years

**The Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Python Architect / Developer**
who will work like an early engineer in a startup environment, while having the data, users, operational complexity, and resources of an established business. You will
**design, code, deploy, debug, and operate systems yourself**
, with meaningful influence over
**architecture, product direction, and engineering practices**
. The role requires strong hands-on Python development along with the ability to design scalable architectures, build AI/GenAI solutions, integrate enterprise systems, and take end-to-end ownership of production systems.

* Design and lead scalable, secure, high-performance Python-based applications, platforms and microservices.

* Develop production-grade Python backend applications, REST APIs and microservices using FastAPI/Django.

* Design and implement GenAI/LLM applications, AI Agents, RAG, Agentic RAG and orchestration frameworks.
* Integrate AI and orchestrate ERP, OMS, WMS, external APIs and enterprise systems.
* Design asynchronous, event-driven and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and Redis.

* Design and deploy solutions on AWS/Azure/GCP, leveraging Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD.
* Ensure application performance, scalability, security, reliability, observability and cost optimization.

Urban Company is Asia's largest tech-enabled home services marketplace, operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Customers use our platform to book a wide range of services — beauty and grooming, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and more — delivered at home, at a time of their choosing. Behind this simple promise sits a deep technology stack that matches millions of customers with trained, background-verified service partners while guaranteeing a standardised, high-quality, and reliable experience every single time.

**About the Fulfilment Team**

The Fulfilment team sits at the heart of Urban Company's marketplace — we make sure every customer gets the right service, from the right partner, at the right time. We do this through three core charters:

- Planning & Shaping: Efficiently planning supply to meet forecasted customer demand, and intelligently shaping that demand to meet business goals.

- Capacity Management: Managing partner time and computing real-time availability of UC services for any given time slot, customer location, business category, and skill requirement.

- Allocation & Recovery: Assigning the most suitable partner for each job while maintaining fairness in partner earnings, and protecting customer experience in cases of no-shows, cancellations, or partner unavailability.

These are classic marketplace optimization problems — forecasting, matching, scheduling, and real-time recovery — solved at the scale of millions of monthly service requests.

**Job Description: SDE-2**

We are looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE-2) to join our Fulfilment team. You will work on complex, high-impact engineering challenges — the systems you build directly determine whether a customer's booking is fulfilled seamlessly and whether a partner earns fairly. If you enjoy problems that blend distributed systems, optimization, and real-world operational constraints, this is the team for you.

**Responsibilities**

- Design and build scalable, high-performance, fault-tolerant systems and services that power supply planning, capacity, and allocation.

- Develop and optimize intelligent algorithms and ML/AI-driven solutions for demand forecasting, capacity planning, and partner–job matching.

- AI to real marketplace problems is a strong plus.

- Mindset: Bias for action, end-to-end ownership, and comfort with ambiguity.

- Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.

**Why Join Us?**

- Work on marketplace-scale optimisation problems that few companies in the region get to solve.

- High ownership from day one — your systems ship to millions of users.

- A culture that rewards initiative, craftsmanship, and first-principles thinking.
