title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce.
  
  
The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations.
* System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly.
* Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution.
* System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes.
* Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits.
* Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models.
* Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues.
* Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities.
* Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices.
* AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems.
* Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.
* Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity.
* Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems.
* Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz.
* Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs.
* Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly.
* Are proficient in Node.js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team’s technology stack.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
* Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

We are second-time entrepreneurs and operators behind Momspresso, acquired by Honasa/Mamaearth in 2023, along with leadership experience across companies like Unilever, PepsiCo, Aviva, and WinZO.
  
  
We have worked with 300+ brands across FMCG, BFSI, DTC, healthcare, retail, and other consumer categories.
  
  
**The Role**
We're hiring an AI Platform Engineer to build and own the shared runtime our AI agents run on, and the evals that keep it honest.
  
  
We run AI agents on behalf of brands. Those agents need one gateway to the models, one place prompts get routed, and one gate that checks what is allowed before anything ships. And they need proof they work, because a brand cannot take our word for it.
  
  
Reports to the engineering lead. Individual contributor. Office in Gurugram, Monday to Friday.

* Build one agent runtime that new use cases plug into, without forking the code.
* Build evals strong enough to block a bad release, not just report on it.

* Agent runtime and LLM gateway: Own one reusable platform for agent orchestration, tool execution and prompt routing, with a single path to Anthropic, OpenAI and others (caching, dedup, fallback, retries).

* Cost, retrieval and latency: Own inference spend per unit of output, prompt caching, and vector search over brand history (pgvector or similar) wired into the agents.
* Safety and brand isolation: Own the sandboxed policy gate, disclosure metadata and audit log on every asset, prompt-injection defence, four autonomy tiers, a kill switch and one-step rollback.
* Observability and design: Trace every agent step with OpenTelemetry so a wrong output points to the step that caused it, and own high-level and low-level design.

* 3–5 years of total experience, with 2+ years in backend engineering. Python, FastAPI in production.
* Shipped an LLM or agent system to production: not a demo, not a notebook.
* Built a platform others build on: SDK, shared service or internal framework with real users.

* RAG in production. Embeddings, a vector store, chunking choices you can defend.

* Distributed systems basics. Caching, queues, idempotency, P99 latency.

title: IT Engineer,Software,Expert
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Platform Optimization & Org Health**

* Hunt down technical debt — dead automations, bloated triggers, redundant fields, and queries that scan half the database for one record.
* Audit and rationalize automations into a single, sane framework. No more “which of the five automations on this object actually fires first?” mysteries.
* Monitor org health proactively — governor limits, storage, API consumption, deployment stability — using Salesforce Optimizer, Event Monitoring, and custom dashboards you build yourself.

**Development & Code Quality**

* Build production-grade Apex — bulkified, governor-limit-aware, single-trigger-per-object, with proper separation of concerns (service/selector/domain layers).
* Develop Lightning Web Components that are reusable, accessible
* Hold the quality bar in code reviews — meaningful test assertions (not just coverage farming), no hardcoded IDs, clean error handling, sensible naming.
* Own and improve the CI/CD pipeline — scratch orgs, source-driven development, automated test gates, and deployments that don’t need a war room.

**Integration & Data Management**

* Design and maintain integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture — with proper retry logic, error handling, and idempotency.
* Champion data quality — deduplication strategies, validation rules that actually help, and migration practices that don’t create a cleanup project of their own.
* Troubleshoot sync failures and API limit issues across connected systems before they become someone’s escalation.

**Collaboration & Best Practices Enablement**

* Define and document development standards and best practices — then make sure the team actually follows them.
* Mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing — not lectures.
* Evaluate every Salesforce release (three per year) for features worth adopting and deprecations worth addressing.
* Help the team make smart clicks-vs-code decisions so the org stays maintainable as it grows.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 9–15 years of hands-on Salesforce platform development — cloud-agnostic, problem-first.
* Active Salesforce certifications preferred — Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, System Architect, or any specialist certification.
* Clear communicator who can explain a complex technical tradeoff to a business stakeholder without their eyes glazing over.

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, LWC, and enough Visualforce knowledge to maintain legacy components.
* Strong JavaScript/ES6+, HTML, and CSS fundamentals.
* Expertise in Salesforce’s security architecture — profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, FLS, OWDs, role hierarchy.
* Solid Git workflow habits — branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution.
* Proficiency with Salesforce CLI, scratch orgs, metadata API, and at least one CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset).
* Sharp debugging instincts — Debug Logs, Query Plan tool, Limit monitoring, and the patience to trace a bug through five layers of automation.
* Familiarity with data migration/ETL tools — Data Loader, Dataloader.io, or equivalent.
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum rhythms without needing a ceremony for every decision.

**Good to have AI Exposure**

* Understanding of AI/ML fundamentals — supervised vs unsupervised learning, model training, evaluation metrics, and data pipelines.
* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) — prompt engineering, fine-tuning concepts, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and API-based integrations.
* Familiarity with generative AI use cases in enterprise contexts — summarization, classification, content generation, conversational bots, and intelligent search.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools for code generation, test scaffolding, or automated code review.
* Basic comfort with Python or similar languages for scripting AI/ML workflows, data wrangling, or prototyping.
* Awareness of responsible AI principles — bias, explainability, data privacy, and governance considerations.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
****About Payoneer****
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
Principal Engineer – Backend
  
  
****About Payoneer****
Payoneer empowers businesses, professionals, and enterprises to participate in the global economy by enabling seamless cross-border payments and financial services. Our technology powers critical financial workflows at global scale, with a strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Principal Engineer – Backend to provide technical leadership across Payoneer's backend engineering organization and help shape the next generation of our distributed financial systems.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems.
  
  
The role also requires an AI-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms.
* Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure.
* Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains.
* Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams.
* Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity.
* Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders.
* Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt.
* Champion an AI-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle.
* Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value.
* Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross-domain problems.
* Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority.
* Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization.
* Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.
* Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness.
* Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities.

****What We're Looking For****

* Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms.
* Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data-intensive systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event-driven architectures, and scalability.
* Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains.
* Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions.
* Experience operating systems at significant scale with strong requirements around availability, performance, security, and reliability.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, observability, production operations, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with AI/LLM technologies and a demonstrated interest in building AI-first engineering systems and workflows.
* Familiarity with AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, agentic workflows, or similar emerging AI technologies is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and technical leaders.
* Strong product mindset and the ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a globally distributed, cross-functional engineering environment.

****What Success Looks Like****
In this role, success means having an impact beyond the systems you directly build.
  
  
**You Will:**

* Shape the architecture and technical direction of critical Payoneer platforms.
* Enable multiple engineering teams to build and operate better distributed systems.
* Raise the technical bar through mentorship, architecture leadership, and engineering practices.
* Help Payoneer adopt an AI-first engineering culture and identify high-value opportunities for AI and agentic technologies.
* Drive successful adoption of emerging technologies such as MCP where appropriate.
* Improve the scalability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our platforms.
* Become a trusted technical partner to engineering, product, and business leadership.

**Why This Role**
The Principal Engineer role provides an opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, architecture, product, and organizational leadership.
  
  
You will work on complex problems at global scale, influence technology strategy across teams, mentor the next generation of engineering leaders, and help shape how Payoneer builds software in an increasingly AI-first world.
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
****Build Each Other Up****
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.
  
  
This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
* Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers. Atlys is changing that.

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**

We're looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to own the foundations that keep Atlys fast, reliable and secure.

Not someone who simply keeps servers running or closes tickets from a scanner. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure and security as products: who designs systems that are secure by default, automates away toil, and gives every engineer a paved road to ship safely.

Few companies handle data as sensitive as ours. Passports, financial documents, photographs and identity records flow every day between travellers, partners and government systems across 127 countries. You'll own the cloud infrastructure, security posture and reliability of the platform that processes it, and make sure it scales as we grow.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just ask how to pass the next audit, but how to build systems that are fundamentally hard to break.

**The Job**

* **Own our cloud infrastructure.**
  Build and run scalable AWS/GCP infrastructure with Kubernetes and make deployments repeatable and fast.
* **Data security.**
  Design access controls, audit logging across internal tooling and cloud infrastructure for PIIs like passports and financial documents, in line with compliance and data security
* **Secure the supply chain.**
  Add SAST, DAST and dependency and container scanning to CI/CD, run vulnerability management and pen tests
* **Vulnerability Discovery:**
  Find, validate and fix security gaps - business logic flaws, authorization issues, authentication bypasses, injection vulnerabilities

**The Ideal Candidate**

You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 4–6 years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE or security engineering roles, ideally at a fast-growing product company handling sensitive or regulated data.
* Have deep hands-on experience with any public cloud, Linux, networking, Docker and Kubernetes
* Have a strong grounding in security fundamentals including but not limited to OWASP Top 10 and cloud security best practices and have applied them in production, not just on paper.
* You can own security gaps in application layer and can validate and fix them yourself across the tech stack
* Take ownership end to end. You make pragmatic trade-offs between security, speed and developer experience. You explain risk clearly and bring engineers along rather than acting as a gatekeeper.
* Prior web/backend development experience is nice to have.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here's what you can expect:

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

title: Principal Robotics Engineer (Motion Control)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a
**Principal Robotics Controls Engineer (Locomotion & MPC/RL)**
to lead the development of locomotion, dynamic balance, and real-time motion control systems for advanced legged robots.
  
  
You will design and implement control algorithms that enable robots to navigate uneven terrain, transition between gaits, recover from external disturbances, and execute movements reliably. The role combines robotics dynamics, model predictive control, reinforcement learning, simulation, and real-world hardware validation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development of the locomotion and motion control stack for legged robots.
* Translate high-level navigation goals into stable, executable robot movements.
* Design and implement nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC), Whole-Body Control (WBC), and related optimization-based control methods.
* Develop locomotion policies using deep reinforcement learning where appropriate.
* Implement robot kinematics, dynamics, state estimation, contact detection, and slip-recovery algorithms.
* Develop and validate gait transitions, obstacle negotiation, stair climbing, and recovery from external disturbances.
* Build simulation-based training and testing pipelines using NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, or comparable robotics simulation environments.
* Develop Sim-to-Real workflows to transfer locomotion policies from simulation to physical robots.
* Integrate motion control systems with motor controllers and communication networks, including CAN-FD and EtherCAT.
* Optimize control performance for low-latency, deterministic execution on real-time Linux systems.
* Collaborate with mechanical, embedded, perception, and AI teams to validate complete robotic systems.

**Qualifications**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 8 years of practical experience in robotics, motion control, legged locomotion, or closely related control engineering.
* Strong understanding of robot kinematics, rigid-body dynamics, and multi-body systems.
* Hands-on experience developing locomotion or motion control algorithms for legged robots.
* Strong proficiency in modern C++ and C++20.
* Practical experience with Model Predictive Control (MPC), nonlinear optimization, and Quadratic Programming (QP).
* Experience with Whole-Body Control (WBC) or related model-based control approaches.
* Familiarity with robotics libraries and frameworks such as Pinocchio, Drake, or OCS2.
* Experience with reinforcement learning for robotics or locomotion policy development.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, or equivalent simulation platforms.
* Understanding of real-time control and PREEMPT\_RT Linux environments.
* Experience integrating control software with physical robot hardware and motor communication systems.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to lead complex robotics engineering projects.

**Why Join?**

* Lead the development of advanced robotic locomotion and control systems.
* Work on challenging problems involving dynamic balance, terrain traversal, and autonomous movement.
* Combine control theory, simulation, reinforcement learning, and physical robot testing.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to move robotics research into practical applications.

title: Field Application Engineer – Robotics
description:
Location for this opening: Delhi region

Field Application Engineer – Robotics

Join the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Learning robotics from the inside is a priceless opportunity.

Commission, program and demo cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with customer-site travel

Department: Robotics & Industrial Automation

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–4 years (immediate joiners preferred)

The Role

You will install, commission, program and troubleshoot robotic systems at customer sites, across industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. You will work with customers and our sales, design and project teams to turn applications into running automation.

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation.

• Deliver pick-and-place, material handling, palletizing, welding and machine tending applications.

• Integrate robots with PLC, HMI, servo, vision and other automation systems, and optimize cycle times.

• Run demos, application trials and customer training.

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running.

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation.

• Coordinate with sales, design and project teams, and share field feedback with our in-house robot design team.

Must Have

• Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation.

• 1–4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering.

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge.

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills.

• Willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP.

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Machine vision, Python scripting or offline robot programming.

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR/mobile robot deployment.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work alongside the people who build them, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: take projects from first demo to live operation, with fast decisions and direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: move into Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist, Project Engineering or Field Application Manager roles.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, certifications, and cutting-edge mobile robotics.

• Exciting projects in factories, warehouses and new applications.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives, travel support and a supportive, growing team.

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAE – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:

We are a technology and data services firm working with US-based real estate investment clients. We are standing up a new data-extraction and management service for a client's acquisitions business — and this role is the anchor hire for that service.

You will sit between the client's databases, software platforms, and acquisitions team, making sure information is accurate, well-structured, and flowing correctly between systems. The client's data lives across deal-management platforms and multiple loan databases; your job is to organize these disparate datasets into clean, reliable, query-ready structures that acquisitions workflows — and potentially new user interfaces — can be built on.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
SQL and data management — write and optimize SQL to extract, transform, and analyse data across multiple databases and datasets

Data flows — map how data moves from one system or platform to another and keep it flowing correctly end to end
  
  
SOPs — document how data is entered, moved, checked, and maintained so processes are repeatable and auditable
  
  
Data governance — establish and maintain standards for how data is structured, managed, and controlled
  
  
Systems and UI — build fluency with the client's software platforms and their front ends; support interface buildouts on top of the organized data

**Must-Haves\***
5–8 years in database analyst, data analyst, or database administrator roles — this is not an entry-level position

Working comfort with financial data — loan, deal, or investment datasets
  
  
Track record of documenting processes and setting data-quality or governance standards
  
  
Strong written and spoken English — this is a client-facing role with direct exposure to US stakeholders
  
  
Self-directed in a fully remote setup, with partial overlap with US business hours for key meetings
  
  
**Nice-to-Haves\***
Real estate or commercial real estate data experience (deal pipelines, loan servicing, property data)
  
  
Familiarity with deal-management platforms (e.g., Dealpath or similar)
  
  
Data warehousing experience (schema design, ETL/ELT)
  
  
Experience supporting dashboards or lightweight UIs built on curated datasets

title: Lead AI Research Scientist (Robotics)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Lead Physical AI / Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Research Scientist**
to lead the development and adaptation of foundation models that connect visual perception, language understanding, and robotic actions.
  
  
You will guide research and implementation efforts to help robots interpret visual information, understand natural-language instructions, and generate meaningful actions for navigation and manipulation. The role combines multimodal AI, foundation model adaptation, robotic learning, and applied computer vision.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the adaptation and development of Vision-Language-Action models for robotic applications.
* Fine-tune open-weight VLA models such as OpenVLA, Octo, and π0 for navigation and manipulation tasks.
* Develop multimodal representations that connect camera observations, natural-language instructions, spatial reasoning, and robot actions.
* Design action-tokenization and spatial waypoint generation approaches for robotic behavior.
* Develop parameter-efficient fine-tuning pipelines using techniques such as LoRA and other PEFT methods.
* Work with vision-language models, Vision Transformers (ViT), and large multimodal models.
* Integrate visual perception and AI capabilities into robotic decision-making systems.
* Explore cross-embodiment learning and datasets such as Open X-Embodiment to improve model generalization across robotic platforms.
* Collaborate with robotics controls and embedded systems teams to translate model outputs into executable robot behaviors.
* Lead research planning, technical evaluations, experiments, and model performance improvements.
* Guide researchers and engineers in model adaptation, training, evaluation, and deployment.

**Qualifications**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* At least 4 years of relevant experience in multimodal AI, foundation models, vision-language models, imitation learning, or robotic learning.
* Strong experience developing, training, or fine-tuning large multimodal models, Vision Transformers, or related deep learning architectures.
* Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch or JAX.
* Hands-on experience with vision-language models or Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures.
* Familiarity with open-weight VLA models such as OpenVLA, Octo, or π0.
* Experience with Hugging Face tools and model training or fine-tuning workflows.
* Practical knowledge of parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, including LoRA or related methods.
* Understanding of multimodal representation learning, visual perception, and language-conditioned action generation.
* Familiarity with robotic imitation learning, policy learning, or reinforcement learning.
* Understanding of cross-embodiment robotic learning and datasets such as Open X-Embodiment is an advantage.
* Ability to lead technical research, evaluate experimental results, and translate research findings into practical AI capabilities.

**Why Join?**

* Lead the development of emerging Physical AI and VLA technologies.
* Work at the intersection of multimodal AI, foundation models, and robotics.
* Explore new approaches to language-conditioned robotic navigation and manipulation.
* Collaborate with AI researchers and robotics engineers to translate research into real-world applications.
* Shape technical direction and research priorities for advanced AI systems.

**Work Location & Arrangement**
Remote through a US-based research team, or hybrid in New Delhi, India. Remote eligibility is subject to the employer's approved work locations.

title: Senior SDE & Technical Instructor
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Software Development Engineer & Technical Instructor**
with strong expertise in
**Low-Level Design (LLD)**
and
**High-Level Design (HLD)**
.

In this dual-track role, you will spend half your time actively building scalable internal platforms and production systems, and the other half guiding engineers and students through object-oriented design, architectural patterns, distributed systems, and real-world system design interview prep. You must be equally comfortable whiteboard-architecting a distributed cache and writing clean, SOLID-compliant code in a live classroom setting.

Core Responsibilities

1. System Architecture & Engineering (~50%)

* **Production Engineering:**
  Build, refactor, and scale core microservices, APIs, and student-facing interactive platforms.
* **LLD Implementation:**
  Apply clean code principles, design patterns (Creational, Structural, Behavioral), and SOLID paradigms to day-to-day codebases.
* **HLD Execution:**
  Assist in designing scalable, highly available backends—focusing on caching tiers, database partitioning, asynchronous processing, and load balancing.
* **Tooling & Sandboxes:**
  Build mock environments, automated test runners, and architecture simulation tools for student capstones.

2. Instruction & System Design Mentorship (~50%)

* **LLD & OOP Instruction:**
  Teach object-oriented design from first principles (UML diagrams, design patterns, schema modeling, clean code, unit testing, and concurrency models).
* **HLD Masterclasses:**
  Walk learners through end-to-end distributed system blueprints (e.g., designing URL shorteners, distributed rate limiters, notification engines, and streaming pipelines).
* **Live System Design Interviews:**
  Run rigorous, interactive mock interviews evaluating trade-offs (CAP theorem, read/write throughput, latency vs. consistency, caching strategies).
* **Curriculum & Case Studies:**
  Write real-world, production-derived case studies, design documentation templates (RFCs/PRDs), and design assignment prompts.

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**

Technical Experience (3+ Years)

* **Experience Baseline:**
  3+ years of professional software development experience shipping and maintaining production services.
* **Core Languages:**
  Strong proficiency in at least one statically typed or OOP-friendly language (Java, C++, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, or Python).
* **Low-Level Design (LLD):**
* Practical command of SOLID principles, Design Patterns (Factory, Strategy, Observer, Decorator, Adapter, etc.), and schema normalization.
* Experience with multi-threading, concurrency control, and clean modular code architecture.
* **High-Level Design (HLD):**
* Hands-on understanding of distributed system fundamentals: Microservices, Load Balancers, API Gateways, Message Queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), Caching (Redis/Memcached).
* Practical knowledge of Relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB) data modeling, replication, and indexing strategies.
* **Cloud & DevOps:**
  Familiarity with AWS/GCP services, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.

Teaching & Communication Skills

* **Pedagogical Instinct:**
  Prior experience teaching, conducting corporate training, mentoring junior/mid-level engineers, or delivering workshops on DSA and System Design.
* **First-Principles Thinking:**
  Proven ability to break down complex architectural trade-offs without buzzwords, using intuitive diagrams and clean abstractions.
* **Live-Coding & Presentation:**
  Comfortable live-coding, whiteboard sketching, and facilitating active Q&A sessions under scrutiny.

title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.

**Job Description**

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Key team values:

* Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
* Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
* Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
* Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead

About the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.
* Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.
* Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).
* Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.
* Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.
* Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.
* Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.
* Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.

You will be successful in this role if you:

* Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.
* Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.
* Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.
* Are able to make data-driven decisions.
* Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.
* Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.

**Qualifications**

We are looking for:

* 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.
* 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.
* Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.
* Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.
* Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).

Technical Skills and Experience:

* Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).
* Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).
* Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing.
* Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs.
* Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.
* Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.
* CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).
* Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).

**Additional Information**

**What You’ll Get:**

* Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
* Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.
* Career development and mentorship
* A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart

**Please be advised that Jitterbit does not:**

* Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms.
* Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact.
* Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process.
* Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages.

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Evals
description:
**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
Chegg is building the next generation
*AI Evaluation Platform*
to keep improving learner experience across product and services from copilots to autonomous agents. As we scale our use of large language models and agentic systems, the quality, safety, and reliability of these systems depend on rigorous, well-designed evaluations. We're hiring a Senior Engineer to own the design and implementation of evaluation frameworks ("evals") that measure model and agent performance across accuracy, reasoning, safety, and pedagogical quality — and that directly inform how we train, fine-tune, and ship AI systems.
  
  
This is a high-leverage, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of ML research, data engineering, and product. You'll own evaluation solutions end-to-end — from framework design through deployment and production monitoring — partnering closely with ML researchers, applied scientists, and product teams to define what "good" looks like for models and agents and turn measurements into actionable outcomes.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Own evaluation solutions end-to-end: design the methodology, build the pipeline and tooling, deploy it into training and production workflows, and maintain/iterate on it over time — with minimal hand-off to other teams.
* Design and build evaluation frameworks and harnesses for LLMs and multi-step AI agents, covering offline benchmarks, online/production evals, and human-in-the-loop review.
* Define rubrics and scoring methodologies for open-ended tasks (e.g., tutoring quality, step-by-step reasoning, citation accuracy) where correctness isn't binary.
* Build automated, model-graded (LLM-as-judge) and rule-based evaluators, and validate them against human judgment for reliability and bias.
* Develop agent-specific evaluations: tool-use correctness, multi-turn task completion, planning/trajectory quality, failure recovery, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
* Create golden datasets, adversarial test sets, and regression suites that catch quality and safety regressions before they reach production.
* Partner with research teams to translate eval results into training signal — informing SFT/RLHF/RLAIF data curation, reward modeling, and fine-tuning priorities.
* Instrument production systems to collect real-world interaction data and feed it back into the evaluation and training loop.
* Build dashboards and reporting that give researchers, PMs, and leadership a clear, trustworthy view of model quality trends across releases.
* Drive eval methodology rigor: statistical significance, inter-rater reliability, sampling strategy, and avoiding metric gaming or overfitting to benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Trust & Safety and Legal/Compliance stakeholders to build evals for bias, hallucination, academic integrity, and other responsible-AI dimensions relevant to an education product.
* Mentor other engineers on eval best practices and help establish evaluation as a first-class part of the model development lifecycle.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 5+ years of software/ML engineering experience, including hands-on work building or maintaining evaluation, testing, or measurement infrastructure for ML systems.
* Direct experience with foundation model evaluation and benchmarking beyond using APIs — experience gained at a foundation model lab or similarly frontier research environment is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to own an evaluation solution end-to-end — from initial design and dataset/methodology creation through pipeline build, deployment, and production monitoring — with minimal hand-off.
* Direct experience designing evals for LLMs and/or AI agents — e.g., benchmark design, LLM-as-judge pipelines, human annotation platforms, or A/B and offline/online eval frameworks.
* Strong programming skills in Python, PyTorch / Tensorflow and experience building production-grade data/ML pipelines.
* Hands-on knowledge of key model training and evaluation platforms, particularly AWS (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock) and Databricks (e.g., MLflow, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake).
* Solid grounding in applied statistics — comfortable reasoning about sample size, variance, significance testing, and the limitations of aggregate metrics.
* Working knowledge of how LLMs are trained and adapted (pretraining, SFT, RLHF/RLAIF/DPO) and how eval signal feeds into that lifecycle.
* Experience with agentic architectures — tool calling, multi-step planning, memory, orchestration frameworks — and the unique evaluation challenges they introduce.
* Familiarity with eval and observability tooling (e.g., internal or open-source frameworks for tracing, dataset versioning, experiment tracking).
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills; able to translate ambiguous product/research questions into concrete, measurable eval criteria.
* A bias toward rigor and skepticism — you instinctively question whether a metric is actually measuring what it claims to.

Bonus Points
  
  
We prioritize candidates with direct experience in the following areas:
  
  

* Post-training & evals: hands-on experience with post-training techniques (SFT, RLHF, RLAIF, DPO) and the evaluation methodologies used to validate them, ideally gained at a frontier model labs
* Model benchmarking: experience building, running, or maintaining benchmark suites used to track and compare frontier model capabilities across training runs and releases.
* Data quality: experience with the data quality side of model training — curation, filtering, deduplication, and quality scoring of pretraining and post-training datasets.

Why Chegg
  
  
You'll shape how Chegg measures and improves the AI systems millions of students rely on — with direct influence on model training decisions, product quality, and responsible AI practices. This role offers high visibility across research, engineering, and product leadership, and the opportunity to help define evaluation as a discipline within the company's AI strategy.
  
  
**Compensation & Benefits**
Salary range and benefits will be shared per Chegg's compensation bands and the candidate's location, in accordance with applicable pay transparency requirements.
  
  
*Chegg is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*
Why do we exist?
  
  
Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

title: Co-Founder & CTO
description:
**I'm not looking for someone to build an app. I'm looking for someone to build a company with me.**

I've spent years building Snapzo, made mistakes, learnt from them and understood what it really takes to build a scalable technology business.

Now I'm looking for a technical co-founder who can take complete ownership of technology while I focus on business, growth, partnerships and fundraising.

**What you'll be building:**

* Own Snapzo's technology vision, architecture and product development.
* Lead the development of our mobile applications and backend infrastructure.
* Work with our existing native mobile stack, PHP and Python backend, and make the right technology decisions for the future.
* Build a scalable, secure and reliable platform capable of supporting millions of users.
* Hire, mentor and lead the engineering team as we grow.
* Work directly with me on product strategy, user experience, monetisation and investor discussions.
* Move fast, test assumptions and build around product-market fit rather than unnecessary features.

**Who I'm looking for:**

* 7–12+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering and product development.
* Strong understanding of mobile applications, backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
* Someone who has built and shipped real products, not just managed developers.
* Comfortable working with an existing codebase and improving it without rebuilding everything.
* A problem solver who understands business as much as technology.
* Someone who can work with limited resources today while preparing for much bigger opportunities tomorrow.
* Most importantly, someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee.

**One thing you should know.**

Snapzo is at an early stage. This isn't a conventional CTO position with a large team, established processes and guaranteed comfort.

There will be unpredictable days, difficult decisions and moments when we'll have to figure things out ourselves.

I'm looking for someone who can see what Snapzo could become over the next 5–10 years and is willing to put in the work to get there.

**This is a co-founder opportunity with an equity-led structure, subject to mutual agreement.**
We'll discuss ownership, commitment and long-term alignment transparently.

I don't expect you to know everything.

But I do expect you to take responsibility for finding the answers.

**I've already taken my bet on Snapzo. Now I'm looking for someone who wants to build it alongside me.**

If that sounds like you, don't send me just your CV. Tell me what you've built and why you want to build Snapzo.

**Kush Chauhan | Born at 41.**

**kush@snapzo.in**

title: Research Scientist
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for an
**Research Scientist**
to push the boundaries of what AI systems can actually do.
  
  
Not someone who simply integrates existing models or builds another wrapper around an LLM. We're looking for someone who can identify why today's AI systems fail, develop new methods to overcome those limitations, and turn research breakthroughs into real-world capabilities.
  
  
You'll work on some of the hardest problems in applied AI: building autonomous agents that can plan, reason, execute complex tasks and recover from failures; improving model intelligence through reinforcement learning and post-training; and developing systems that can make reliable decisions in unpredictable environments.
  
  
We're looking for someone who doesn't just ask how to use the best available model, but how to make AI fundamentally better at solving problems it struggles with today.
  
  
**The Job**

* Push the boundaries of agentic AI. Research and develop new approaches that enable AI agents to independently plan, reason, use tools, execute complex tasks, adapt to unfamiliar environments and recover from failures.
* Advance reinforcement learning and model training. Experiment with RL, fine-tuning, post-training techniques and model architectures to improve reasoning, decision-making and autonomous behaviour beyond what existing models can achieve.
* Develop new methods for reasoning and multimodal intelligence. Investigate why models struggle with complex, multi-step problems and unstructured inputs, and design new algorithms and techniques to improve their capabilities.
* Design rigorous experiments and AI evaluations. Build benchmarks, evaluation frameworks and experimental methodologies to measure model intelligence, reliability, generalisation and failure modes. Use findings to drive meaningful improvements.
* Take original research from first principles to production. Identify unsolved problems, formulate hypotheses, build and test new approaches, and collaborate with Research Engineers to translate breakthroughs into scalable AI systems with measurable real-world impact.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have a PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience conducting original AI research.
* Have a strong track record of original research, demonstrated through publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL or EMNLP, impactful open-source contributions, or meaningful advances in production AI systems.
* Have deep expertise in one or more areas such as agentic AI, reinforcement learning, LLM reasoning, post-training, multimodal learning, model architectures or AI evaluations.
* Are highly proficient in Python and PyTorch, with hands-on experience designing experiments, training and fine-tuning models, building evaluation frameworks and independently implementing research ideas.
* Are intellectually curious, comfortable challenging existing approaches and excited by unsolved problems. You combine scientific rigour with strong engineering instincts and care about taking original research from experimentation to real-world impact.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

**Role Overview**

**Head of Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Engineering**
to architect, build, and scale our next-generation automated trading and wealth management infrastructure. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of systematic strategies in Indian derivatives (NSE Equities, Index & Stock Options/Futures)—from mathematical model design and backtesting to building low-latency, production-grade Python/C++ execution engines and broker API integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy Research & Quantitative Modeling:**

  **Python and C++**

title: Supply Chain Solutions Manager
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Every company runs on an ERP. Very few get good decisions out of it. That's where Praxas comes in.

Praxas AI is an AI-native supply chain platform that works as a decision layer on top of the systems a company already has. We pull in scattered data from ERPs, spreadsheets and email, turn it into a single, trusted picture, and use optimization models and AI agents to recommend what to produce, stock, buy and ship. Plans keep re-optimizing as orders, capacity and supply change, and planners stay in control by approving every action.

What we stand for is simple: no rip-and-replace, no multi-year implementations, and no multi-million-dollar planning suites. We're building planning software that's fast to deploy, easy to use and priced for mid-sized companies.

We're starting with production planning for manufacturers, because that's where our first clients feel the most pain. Inventory, sourcing and shipping come next, followed by industries such as CPG, retail, chemicals and logistics. Our first manufacturing partners are already sharing their data and building the product with us. Built in India, for the world.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with our clients and turn their messiest supply chain problems into optimized plans running in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a traditional consulting, project management or customer success position. You'll sit with planners and plant heads to understand how the business really runs, formulate the right mathematical model, write production-quality code, connect our platform to their ERP, and stay until the plan is trusted and used every day. You'll move between a factory floor, a solver, an ERP database and a conversation with the owner without losing the thread.

Our clients' data lives in SAP, Tally, custom ERPs, spreadsheets and inboxes, and it's rarely clean. The work is never turnkey. You'll own hard implementation problems through to resolution, and turn what you learn in the field into reusable connectors, models and playbooks that make the next deployment faster.

You'll work directly with the founders and our engineering team. As one of our first hires, you'll help define how Praxas is built, deployed and sold.

**What You Will Do**

Deliver supply chain solutions

• Embed with clients from discovery through go-live, stabilization and handover

• Map each client's production, inventory, sourcing and logistics processes, and the data behind them

• Translate business goals and ambiguous requirements into clear models, milestones and working software

• Own the outcomes clients care about: fewer lost sales, better on-time-in-full delivery, higher inventory turns and working capital released

Model and optimize

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling, inventory and safety stock, demand forecasting and supply planning problems

• Use linear and mixed-integer programming, constraint programming and heuristics, with solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX or OR-Tools

• Build models that re-optimize continuously as orders, capacity and supply change

• Validate models against real client data, test them on past periods, and explain trade-offs clearly to planners

Engineer in the client environment

• Write production-quality code in Python and SQL

• Build and maintain ERP connectors for SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics and custom databases, using APIs, OData and direct SQL

• Build data pipelines and data-quality checks, and reconcile Praxas numbers with the client's own reports
