• Build or strengthen at least one reusable ERP connector

• Write documentation that makes the next client onboarding faster

**Within 6–12 months**

• Lead several client deployments end to end, from discovery to daily use

• Cut onboarding time from weeks to days

• Show measurable impact at your clients, such as fewer lost sales, lower inventory and better on-time delivery

• Turn field lessons into product features, connectors and playbooks the whole team uses

Who You Are

Required

• 3–8 years building or implementing supply chain planning solutions, at a platform such as o9, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis or SAP IBP, at an implementation partner, or in a similar role

• Exceptional coding ability: you write production-quality Python and SQL, and you're comfortable with APIs, data pipelines and cloud deployment

• Strong operations research and mathematical modelling: linear and mixed-integer programming, scheduling, heuristics, forecasting and inventory theory

• Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning, including building with large language models and AI agents and applying them to planning problems

• Hands-on experience integrating with ERPs such as SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or custom systems

• Deep understanding of at least two of production planning and scheduling, demand planning, inventory planning, S&OP, procurement and logistics

title: Program Coordinator – Curriculum Developer
description:
**About Pulp**

Pulp is building a
**career discovery and self-discovery program for school students**
— helping young people understand themselves better, explore the world of careers, and build the skills, curiosity and confidence they need for what comes next.

As we move from an exciting pilot towards reaching thousands of students, we’re looking for someone who can help turn a strong idea into an exceptional program that works in real classrooms.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a
**Program Coordinator**
to take ownership of the day-to-day evolution and delivery of Pulp. This isn’t a conventional coordination role.

You’ll work at the intersection of
**curriculum, teachers, students, schools and the Pulp team**
— ensuring that what we design actually works when it reaches a classroom. You’ll question things, test them, improve them and help us build the systems required to take Pulp to scale.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Program & Curriculum**

Evaluate and strengthen Pulp’s curriculum across Grades 7–12. Observe what works, what doesn’t and why, and continuously improve the program with the team.

* **Classroom Testing**

Take ideas into real classrooms. Facilitate sessions, observe students and teachers, gather feedback and turn those learnings into improvements.

* **Teacher Training**

Train and support teachers and facilitators delivering Pulp, helping them understand both
*what*
to deliver and
*why*
it matters.

* **School Delivery**

Coordinate with partner schools to ensure sessions, materials, teachers and students are ready — and that the Pulp experience remains consistent.

* **Build Systems**

Help create facilitator guides, training processes, feedback loops, evaluation frameworks and other systems that allow Pulp to scale without losing quality.

* **Represent Pulp**

Work with school leaders, teachers, parents and other stakeholders and confidently represent Pulp’s philosophy and approach.

**Who We’re Looking For**

You could be a great fit if you:

* Have
  **2–5 years of experience**

  in education, curriculum development, school programs or learning.
* Have worked directly with
  **students and/or teachers**

  , ideally across Grades 7–12.
* Understand that great curriculum is built through
  **testing, observation and iteration**

  — not just writing.
* Are equally comfortable facilitating a classroom and participating in a strategy discussion.
* Are highly organised and can manage multiple moving pieces.
* Communicate clearly and build strong relationships with teachers and school leaders.
* Enjoy working in an early-stage environment where things evolve quickly.
* Want genuine ownership rather than a narrowly defined job.

Experience in
**career education, experiential learning, curriculum development, design thinking, counselling or future-skills programs**
is a plus.

**Why Pulp?**

We’re still a small team, which means you’ll work closely with the founders, curriculum, creative and technology teams. You won’t simply inherit an existing system.
**You’ll help build it.**
We want Pulp to be rigorous without becoming bureaucratic, ambitious without losing the human side of education, and most importantly — something students genuinely look forward to.

**Pulp — Think. Feel. Be.**

Our tech team is small, so this role calls for a startup mentality and the initiative to step outside a predefined job description when something needs doing, rather than waiting to be asked. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Develop and improve our field app: - Design and implement new features within our FlutterFlow app, from requirements gathering through to build and delivery, translating input from the M& E and operations teams into working functionality. - Maintain the app's underlying databases, including making manual data updates where required. - Own the full bug and issue-tracking cycle, identifying, prioritising, assigning, and resolving issues that affect app stability, data collection, or care delivery. - Manage version control and releases, testing and publishing new app versions, writing release notes, and notifying the team of changes. - Manage app accounts and access for team members, providing technical support where needed. - Periodically review and improve the app's design, evaluating user interface and user experience to improve usability. Maintain our website, tech systems and accounts: - Maintain and update Ansh's website (built in Wix), including content changes, functionality fixes, and periodic design/UX review. - Manage and maintain integrations with third-party tools (e. g., Trello, Slack, Google Workspace tools, Firebase), keeping systems efficient, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational needs. - Manage accounts and access for the tools and platforms our team relies on day-to-day (e. g. app accounts, website admin access, and other core tools), including onboarding and offboarding team members from a technical standpoint. - Conduct orientation on technology and tools for new team members. - Maintain basic security hygiene across the systems you own: access permissions, password practices, and account recovery. - Ensure backups for FlutterFlow, GitHub, and Firestore are conducted and monitored. - Support with ad-hoc technology projects and transitions, e. g. changing our Google Workspace. - Support with increased AI integration and technology innovation across the organisation. Follow good technical practice: - Apply sound engineering practices to keep our dashboards and app reliable and maintainable as they scale, rather than optimising only for short-term delivery. - Document your work clearly, so that systems and decisions are understood across the organisation rather than held only by you. - Recommend new tools or approaches that would help Ansh's team deliver more effectively. Work closely with the C-suite and program team: - Support the C-suite in building the product roadmap for our app and website, bringing a technical perspective on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. - Bring a technical perspective into strategic planning conversations, so Ansh's data and tooling keep pace with its growth ambitions. - Partner with M& E and program leads to prioritise what gets built next, based on what will most improve data quality, decision-making, or field operations. Requirements: - Around 3+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work developing mobile or low-code app platforms (FlutterFlow, Flutter, or comparable front-end platforms). - Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. Claude Code) as part of a modern development workflow, with the discipline to keep the resulting code maintainable rather than simply expedient. - Comfortable managing accounts, access, and basic security practices across a small set of tools and platforms. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from non-technical colleagues into technical specifications, and to explain technical trade-offs back to them clearly. - High ownership and agency: comfortable being the primary technical owner of these systems in a rapidly growing organisation, and able to resolve blockers independently. - Adaptability: comfortable supporting new technology projects as they arise. - Fluent in English; based in India and comfortable working remotely with a distributed, mission-driven team. - Deep alignment with Ansh's mission, and a serious, evidence-based commitment to impact. Strongly preferred/nice to have: - Direct experience with FlutterFlow specifically. - Experience with website builders such as Wix, Webflow, or similar. - Experience integrating data from custom-built mobile or field applications into analytics tools. - Experience contributing to product prioritisation or roadmap discussions. - Familiarity with data privacy and security considerations for health data. - Fluency in Hindi. Company Summary Globally, 2.4 million children died in the first month of life in 2020 India alone accounted for 22% of these newborn deaths. The leading risk factor for mortality among children under five years of age is low birth weight, which is responsible for more than 80% of neonatal deaths. A simple solution holds the potential to significantly reduce these deaths: placing low birth weight infants directly onto the mother's chest for skin-to-skin contact, an intervention known as Kangaroo Care (KC). KC entails not only prolonged and continuous skin-to-skin contact but also exclusive breastfeeding and close monitoring of the infant. KC has proven to effectively reduce mortality and morbidity rates by around 33% (compared to the standard of care using electric incubators) by preventing hypothermia, fighting infections like sepsis, and helping the newborn gain weight through the caregiver's heat. However, adoption barriers for kangaroo care in LMICs, such as India, persist. These include insufficient equipment, a shortage of human resources, and a lack of privacy within healthcare facilities. Many of our target healthcare facilities even lack the infrastructure for conventional standard of care (i. e., electric incubators), further amplifying the potential impact of Kangaroo Care in low-resource settings. Our approach is both direct and cost-effective: repurpose existing hospital spaces to facilitate KC, provide essential equipment like infant weighing scales and cloth binders, and expand capacity by training and hiring health workers (HW) dedicated to teaching and monitoring KC for mothers in the wards. Why Join Us Ansh is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from people who are underrepresented in this sector. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, disability, caste, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in people and equally comfortable with the process. You will need to hold confidence, tell leadership things they may not want to hear, and keep the administrative backbone of the function running!

title: Software Development Engineer III
description: What is Hunch?Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.Link to our fundraising announcementKey Offerings Of HunchOne Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.About The RoleWe're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.What You'll Do Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket. Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy). Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.) Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users. Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.What You'll Bring 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus. Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.Preferred ExperienceML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.What We OfferCompetitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).Life at HunchHunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.What We Hire For - The ABCsMost companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.How We WorkOwnership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
  
  
You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end-to-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor-powered workflows (e.g., large-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end-to-end - if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

title: Senior AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Engineering Expert
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking experienced AI Evaluation Engineers specializing in engineering simulation and design to author and validate complex, simulation-based engineering problems for training and evaluating state-of-the-art AI agents. The role spans electrical, mechanical, control systems, aerospace, systems, and robotics engineering. You will create challenging, multi-constraint tasks that require agents to interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will analyze agent execution logs, identify reasoning and tool-use gaps, and build objective automated graders.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
Author self-contained engineering design tasks with competing constraints, explicit optimization targets, validated reference solutions, and objective autograders.
  
Build, run, and validate problem environments using open-source simulation tools and custom Python test benches.
  
Analyze agent outputs and execution logs across repeated trials to identify systemic failure modes, such as misinterpreting simulator feedback, premature convergence, or physically impossible geometries.
  
Refine benchmark difficulty based on model performance data while avoiding ambiguity or missing information.
  
Collaborate with AI researchers, pod leads, and domain experts to integrate rigorous benchmarks into model-evaluation pipelines.
  
Requirements
  
A master's degree or PhD in electrical, mechanical, or aerospace engineering, and 10+ years of hands-on engineering design experience. The description also lists a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in any field as an education pathway.
  
Proficiency in at least one relevant open-source simulation package, such as ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, or Gmsh, along with strong Python scripting skills.
  
Hands-on experience with modern LLMs or coding agents and evaluation concepts such as pass@k, failure-mode analysis, and nondeterministic behavior; ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate reasoning or tool-use failures.
  
Strong attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation.
  
A stable, high-speed internet connection and a personal computer suitable for remote work.
  
Availability for 40 hours per week, four hours of overlap with PST, and weekend on-call availability. Part-time engagement is also noted as acceptable.

title: SAP ABAP & OData API Developer
description:
**Experience:**
Minimum 2+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Job Role:**
SAP Technical Development & Integration

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled SAP ABAP & OData API Developer with a minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP development and API integration. The candidate will be responsible for developing, enhancing, and exposing SAP APIs to enable secure and reliable data exchange between SAP S/4HANA and external applications.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, enhance, and maintain custom SAP ABAP programs and services.
* Design, develop, and expose OData APIs to provide SAP data and business functionality to external applications.
* Work with SAP CDS Views and the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), where applicable.
* Build and maintain integrations between SAP S/4HANA and external systems using APIs.
* Collaborate with technical teams to understand business requirements and define API specifications.
* Implement API authentication, authorization, error handling, logging, and performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot API connectivity, data extraction, and integration issues.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, and production support.
* Prepare technical specifications and documentation for APIs, interfaces, and custom SAP developments.

**Required Skills:**

* Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in SAP ABAP development.
* Practical experience developing and exposing SAP OData services using SAP Gateway.
* Good understanding of SAP architecture, including SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience working with SAP tables, Data Dictionary objects, function modules, and custom business logic.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, JSON, and XML.
* Experience integrating SAP with external applications and platforms.
* Knowledge of SAP CDS Views and the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP).
* Familiarity with SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite (CPI).
* Understanding of SAP S/4HANA data models, standard business objects, and relevant SAP modules such as SD, MM, and FI.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

architecture, and technical leadership capabilities.

Actions, Azure DevOps, and automated deployment workflows.

* Build & Implement HA Architectures: Hand-on code, configure, and engineer active-active clustering, global load balancing, and real-time database replication to completely eliminate single points of failure.

* Optimize Uptime & Manage Risks: Monitor infrastructure performance KPIs to identify potential bottlenecks, mitigate shortage or overload risks before they cause downtime, and ensure compliance with strict Customer SLA requirements.

 

Your skills and experience

 

We work with a broad range of technologies, and we don’t expect you to know everything on day one. You’ll have time to learn our tools and grow into the role. We're looking for diverse experiences to help strengthen our team.


 

Essential

 

* 8+ Years of HA Engineering: Extensive HA experience across cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and on-premises environments.

* Technical Influence: Proven ability to evangelize resiliency standards and influence cross-functional engineering teams to build self-healing features.

* Failover & Replication: Hands-on expertise with real-time data replication, database clustering, and automated, zero-downtime traffic failover.

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced proficiency with Terraform or Ansible to build and replicate highly available environments programmatically.

* Systems & Container Engineering: Deep technical knowledge of Linux internals and container orchestration using Kubernetes (K8s).

* Hybrid Network Engineering: Hands-on experience managing complex hybrid networking topologies, including BGP routing, DNS management, Anycast, and CDNs.

*   Strategic Execution: Ability to translate high-level uptime requirements into a technical roadmap and personally execute the engineering work.

Desirable

 

* Experience supporting SaaS products.

* Experience with Incident Management, Post Mortems and related practices.

* Knowledge of observability and monitoring best practices.

* Experience operating within one or more public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).

* Experience with configuration management, and infrastructure as code

* Knowledge of observability and monitoring best practices

title: MDM Engineer - Business Partner
description:
**Position Title:**
MDM Engineer - Business Partner
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
43654
  
  
We know the importance that food plays in people's lives – the power it has to bring people, families and communities together. Our purpose is to bring enjoyment to people’s lives through great tasting food, in a way which reflects our values. McCain has recently committed to implementing regenerative agriculture practices across 100 percent of our potato acreage by 2030. Ask us more about our commitment to sustainability.
  
  
**Overview**
As part of McCain digital transformation, we are making significant investments into our data structures and policies to increase the quality of our data, the confidence of our business teams to use this data to make decisions, and to drive value through the use of data.
  
  
We have an ambitious Global Data Governance team, which serves as an enabler to the business teams in our regions and global functions. We are currently recruiting an experienced Master Data Management Technical Process Engineer with strong MDG and ABAP technical understanding to support the governance and quality of Customer and Vendor master data.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The MDM Technical Process Engineer will follow global processes and leverage global tools to govern data in a way that is consistent and standardized across all regions. As a member of the Data and Platform Governance team, this individual will implement and maintain data governance strategies, including enforcement of policies, guidelines, standards, and procedures.
  
  
The position supports Business Partner Master Data Governance within the SAP S/4HANA environment, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and compliance across the organization. Responsibilities include driving data quality initiatives, developing metrics and reports to monitor data integrity, performing root cause analysis of data issues, and contributing to system design improvements.
  
  
The role will also collaborate with SAP technical teams by supporting ABAP code analysis, BADI enhancements, integrations between the MDM platform and S/4 Hana, troubleshooting MDG-related logic and workflows impacting customer and vendor master data.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Maintain master data governance processes from definition through to execution and continuous improvement
* A key responsibility is configuring SimpleMDG modules for vendor and customer master (Business Partner), establishing business rules, approval workflows, and validation logic.
* Implement defined policies and frameworks specifically for vendor and customer master (Business Partner) data governance in the S/4HANA environment.
* Support the implementation of data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms
* Support the integration of master data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms with target systems like S/4 Hana, Salesforce, and the Enterprise Data Platform among others.
* Configure and support SAP MDG for Customer and Vendor Master, including data models, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.
* Perform root cause analysis of data issues and ensure remediation according to data governance policies and standards.
* Develop audit and validation methods to ensure quality of the customer and vendor master data using AI-Driven and automated approaches.
* Assist with regular compliance reviews against policies and standards.
* Identify downstream impacts of master data change.
* Ensure proper monitoring of all integrations between the MDM Platform and other systems.

**Technical & ABAP Responsibilities**

* Analyze and interpret ABAP programs, user exits, BADIs, and enhancements related to Customer master data and SAP MDG processes.
* Support the implementation and enhancement of BADIs and other extension frameworks used in MDG validation, derivation, and workflow logic.
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to analyze custom code and troubleshoot issues affecting master data governance processes.
* Perform technical analysis of SAP tables, CDS views, and data models to support data governance reporting and validation.
* Support debugging and root cause investigation of MDG workflows, rules, and integration issues impacting Customer master data.
* Work with technical teams to ensure custom developments align with MDG governance standards and best practices.
* Assist with impact analysis during system changes, upgrades, or SAP S/4HANA transformations affecting Customer master data structures

**Key Qualification & Experiences**

* Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience with data management/governance, including but not limited to data protection and/or data quality
* Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA, Master Data Governance (MDG) including configuration of data models, governance processes, and validations.
* Experience implementing MDM solutions in multiple organizations.
* Working knowledge of ABAP development concepts, including:

+ BADIs and enhancement framework
+ User exits and custom logic analysis
+ Debugging and code review
+ Understanding SAP tables and data models

* A certification like MDG100 will enhance the candite profile.
* Preferred: Experience working with PIM, Data Catalog, Data Governance, and MDM systems.
* Preferred: Understanding of CPG industry specifics — product hierarchies, SKU proliferation, and regulatory data requirements.
* Experience harmonizing systems, processes, and/or data across business areas and functions
* Experience working on an agile team in a virtual, distributed environment

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and participate as an independent contributor with little supervision

We recognize that inclusion drives our creativity, resilience, and success and makes our business stronger. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.*

description:
**Hiring for a client - eDAS**

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, deploy, and maintain FreeSWITCH-based VoIP platforms from scratch in production environments.
* Design and implement call flows, dialplans, IVRs, conferencing, and call routing with end-to-end ownership.
* Configure SIP profiles, gateways, trunks, and extensions for internal and external communications.
* Design and implement multi-tenant and high-availability FreeSWITCH architectures.
* Troubleshoot SIP signaling, RTP media, SDP negotiation, call drops, one-way audio, registration failures, and NAT traversal issues.
* Configure firewalls, NAT traversal, and RTP port ranges to ensure reliable voice communication.
* Analyze SIP logs and network traces using tools such as siptrace, sngrep, and tcpdump.
* Develop FreeSWITCH dialplans using XML and scripting languages such as Lua, JavaScript, or Python.
* Implement inbound and outbound call queues, time-based routing, skill-based routing, and failover mechanisms.
* Integrate FreeSWITCH with CRM/ERP systems, billing platforms, AI voice bots (ASR/TTS), REST APIs, and WebSocket services.
* Use the Event Socket Library (ESL) for real-time call control, event handling, and monitoring.
* Configure WebRTC calling solutions using DTLS-SRTP, ICE, OPUS, mod\_verto, and SIP over WSS.
* Monitor system performance, call quality, logs, and Call Detail Records (CDRs), and optimize codec usage and RTP performance.
* Handle production incidents, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement corrective actions.
* Deploy and manage FreeSWITCH on Linux environments, including Ubuntu and CentOS, and collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD, automation, backups, scaling, and load balancing.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Profile: Strong FreeSWITCH Implementation Engineer with hands-on production deployment and troubleshooting expertise.
* Overall Experience: Minimum 4 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and supporting FreeSWITCH in production.
* FreeSWITCH Implementation: Strong experience designing and implementing dialplans, IVRs, call routing, conferencing, SIP profiles, gateways, trunks, and extensions with end-to-end ownership.
* VoIP & Networking: Strong knowledge of SIP, RTP, RTCP, SDP, and WebRTC, with the ability to troubleshoot call drops, one-way audio, registration failures, NAT traversal, and SIP/RTP-related issues.
* Dialplan Development: Hands-on experience developing XML-based dialplans and using at least one scripting language, such as Lua, JavaScript, or Python, to implement call queues, time-based routing, skill-based routing, and failover logic.
* Integrations & APIs: Experience integrating FreeSWITCH with CRM/ERP systems, REST APIs, WebSockets, AI voice bots, and billing platforms, along with practical knowledge of ESL for real-time call control.
* Linux Administration: Strong Linux administration skills and experience deploying and managing FreeSWITCH on Ubuntu or CentOS.
* Debugging & Databases: Proficiency with fs\_cli, sngrep, and tcpdump, along with SQL experience using MySQL or PostgreSQL for CDR management and reporting.
* Cloud & Scalability (Preferred): Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, high availability, load balancing, CI/CD pipelines, automation, backups, and scalable deployments.
* WebRTC (Preferred): Experience implementing browser-based calling solutions using mod\_verto, SIP over WSS, DTLS-SRTP, ICE, and OPUS codec configuration.

title: Energy Modeller
description:
**Department:**
Modelling

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Description**
This is a unique international opportunity for a professional seeking to build their career in the energy sector to join our Asia-Pacific region as an Energy Modeller. Aurora’s modelling team create and maintain the energy models that underpin our subscription analytics, advisory, and software offerings. Based in Gurugram and focused on the Asia-Pacific power markets, successful candidates will work in a dynamic and intellectually stimulating environment that values collaboration, learning and mutual support. They will contribute to our energy modelling efforts in Asia-Pacific by combining energy market knowledge with state-of-the-art modelling techniques. They will be given the opportunity to lead model development projects, mentor junior colleagues, and shape the direction of the modelling team. We value inclusive leadership and encourage diverse perspectives that strengthen our team and the solutions we deliver.
  
  
The position suits an experienced Modeller/Quantitative analyst from a top-tier strategic or economic consultancy, energy company, financial services company, or knowledge-focused firm or institution. We’re looking for candidates who bring both technical expertise and a collaborative leadership style, with a proven ability to support and inspire teams toward dependable, high-quality outcomes.
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Leading the development of features that capture complex market dynamics within Aurora’s models
* Work closely with our research and advisory teams to derive insights from model results
* Contributing to the continuous improvement of how the modelling team operates, with a focus on how we can leverage AI in our workflow
* Managing a team of junior colleagues and supporting their development

As an Energy Modeller you will be an expert in the configuration of Aurora’s modelling software, with some of the following specialist responsibilities:

* Applying expert knowledge of power markets to design new modelling approaches
* Working closely with Aurora’s Advisory teams to deliver key market insights
* Delivering Aurora’s models as robust, high-quality software for internal and external clients

**What we are looking for**
**Required attributes:**

* Relevant degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Economics
* Min 2 years of experience developing models or software, ideally in a commercial environment.
* Knowledge of one programming language, e.g. Python, Matlab, C++, R, Java
* Problem-solving skills and analytical ability

**Desirable attributes:**

* Experience in the field of mathematical optimization (Linear Programming, Dynamic programming, MIP etc.) in a commercial environment
* Experience of developing power market models
* Management experience
* Deep interest in power markets
* Knowledge of and interest in applying modern AI technology in your work

**What we offer**

* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* A competitive salary package
* Access to regular coaching and mentoring sessions and the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavourable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.
  
  
The successful candidate would start as soon as possible. The team will review applications as they are received. Salary will be competitive with experience.

  Co-design and validate PMSM/SRM traction motors along with SiC/IGBT-based power drives like Asymmetric Half-Bridge MOSFETS Converter.
* **BOM & Technical Documentation:**
  Prepare comprehensive Bills of Materials (BOM), Process Flow Diagrams (PFD), Control Plans, and DFMEA/PFMEA for hybrid drive systems.
* **Drawings & Design Review:**
  Review mechanical CAD models, PCB Schematic design & drawings, busbars, PCB layouts, and 2D blueprints with GD&T for high-speed motor and inverter assemblies.
* **Prototype Fabrication & Debugging:**
  Oversee functional prototype builds, dyno testing, drive-cycle simulation, and perform root cause analysis on drive/motor operational failures with error rectification / troubleshooting.

**B. Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA) & Compliance**

* **Quality Frameworks:**
  Drive APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) for all new electro-mechanical and electronic components.
* **Audits & Process Validation:**
  Conduct regular supplier facility audits (process and system audits) to ensure adherence to ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 standards and assess manufacturing capabilities for precision components like encoders, resolvers, and actuators.
* **Defect Management & Resolution:**
  Lead root cause analysis for any supplier-related quality issues using methodologies like 8D, Fishbone, and 5-Why. Implement and verify Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

**C. Drive Testing, Calibration & Vehicle Integration**

* **Bench & Dyno Validation:**
  Define and execute test protocols on motor dynos for Torque-Speed curves, efficiency mapping, field weakening, thermal rise, and short-circuit response.
* **Controller Tuning & Calibration:**
  Perform drive tuning using Field-Oriented Control (FOC), Space Vector PWM (SVPWM), position sensor (Resolver/Encoder) calibration, and fault diagnostic routines.
* **Vehicle System Integration:**
  Validate powertrain integration with ICE/hybrid gearboxes, Vehicle Control Units (VCU), Battery Management Systems (BMS), and vehicle CAN/CAN-FD communication networks.
* **HIL & Environmental Testing:**
  Oversee Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, vibration, thermal shock, ingress protection (IP67/IP6K9K), and EMI/EMC compliance testing.

**5.)
Qualification Requirements:**

* **Education & Qualification: B.Tech/B.E.**
  in Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Instrumentation / Mechatronics.
* **M.E. / M.Tech**
  in Power Electronics, Drives, Electrical Machines, or Hybrid Electric Vehicle Technology is an added advantage

**6.)
Technical Skills:**

* **Traction Motors & Drives:**
  In-depth understanding of PMSM,  SRM motor topologies, winding designs (hairpin/distributed), magnetic circuits, and high-voltage inverter architectures.
* **Power Electronics & Control:**
  Deep technical knowledge of SiC/IGBT power modules, gate driver circuits, field-oriented control (FOC), Asymmetric Half-Bridge MOSFETS Converter and resolver-to-digital conversion.

title: Product Executive
description:
* **Company Description**
  NFX Digital is a data-driven digital marketing company transforming the consumer and marketing research landscape in India. Through its flagship platform Adytude.com, NFX Digital blends traditional research instruments with innovative, digital-first methodologies to deliver fast, cost-effective, and statistically robust insights

**About the Role**

* **Experience:**

  1–2 years
* **Work Mode:**

  Full-time, Work from Office

NFX Digital is looking for a technically strong, product-obsessed
**Product Executive with hands-on experience building an AI SaaS product**

.

We are looking for someone who has been involved in taking a software product from an idea or early development stage to a working product. You should understand how AI SaaS products are built, how features move from requirements to implementation, and how to identify and solve problems throughout the product development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get deeply involved in building, testing, improving, and scaling an AI SaaS product. You will work closely with the founders and engineering team, contribute to product decisions, and take ownership of features from conception through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Development and Ownership**

* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to build and improve our AI SaaS product.
* Understand the product architecture, core features, user workflows, and technical dependencies.
* Translate business problems and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable feature specifications.
* Take ownership of features from initial research and requirement gathering through development, testing, and release.
* Identify product gaps and proactively recommend improvements.

**2. AI SaaS Product Research and Strategy**

* Research competing AI SaaS products, their features, positioning, user experience, and underlying capabilities.
* Analyse customer needs and market opportunities to identify areas where the product can differentiate itself.
* Evaluate feature requests critically, prioritising those that deliver meaningful value to users.
* Help the team maintain a clear product focus instead of building features without a strong use case.

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Work directly with developers to understand technical feasibility, dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
* Break down product requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and clear development tasks.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases, and software workflows at a practical level.
* Participate in technical and product discussions, asking the right questions and helping resolve ambiguity.

**4. Product Testing and Quality**

* Test new features, integrations, and releases thoroughly.
* Identify bugs, edge cases, usability issues, and inconsistencies.
* Document issues with reproducible steps, screenshots or evidence, and expected outcomes.
* Validate fixes and ensure that released features solve the intended problem.
* Continuously explore the product to identify opportunities for improvement.

**5. User Experience and Product Improvement**

* Evaluate the product from the user's perspective and identify friction points.
* Use customer feedback, product usage data, and research to inform product decisions.
* Improve onboarding, feature discoverability, usability, and overall product experience.
* Help ensure the product is intuitive, reliable, and valuable to its target customers.

**Required Qualifications**

* **1–2 years of relevant experience**

  , with demonstrable hands-on involvement in building an AI SaaS product.
* Experience working on an AI SaaS product during its development, launch, or early growth stage.
* A technical educational background, preferably in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* A practical understanding of the AI SaaS product development lifecycle.
* Experience working with developers and translating requirements into product features.
* Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, databases, and web application workflows.
* Experience with product documentation, feature specifications, user stories, and QA testing.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Value Most**

We are looking for someone who is genuinely obsessed with the product they are building.

You should be someone who:

* Wants to understand how every important part of the product works.
* Has experienced the realities of building an AI SaaS tool, including bugs, technical constraints, changing requirements, and iteration.
* Is comfortable getting hands-on rather than limiting themselves to meetings and documentation.
* Can independently investigate a problem, develop a point of view, and recommend a solution.
* Understands that building a good product means making deliberate choices about what to build and what not to build.
* Takes ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Is curious, resourceful, and willing to challenge assumptions.
* Cares deeply about product quality and the value delivered to customers.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, work-from-office position at NFX Digital. The candidate must be comfortable working from the office and collaborating closely with the founders and engineering team throughout the product development process.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an AI SaaS product, work directly with decision-makers, and develop into a Product Manager as the product and team grow.

* **Application Requirement**

Along with your CV, please share details of an AI SaaS product you have worked on. Explain your role in building it, the features you contributed to, the challenges you encountered, and how your work improved the product.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their actual product-building experience during the interview.

* Create automated workflows using n8n, webhooks and third-party integrations.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Our Company
  
  
We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast-moving digital transformation market.

**Job Description**
**The role:**

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable solutions, implementing best practices, mentoring junior developers, and ensuring that our Salesforce environment meets evolving business needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Development & Customization

+ Build and maintain custom objects, workflows, validation rules, flows, and triggers.
+ Develop and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware tools.

* Architecture & Design

+ Collaborate with technical architects to design scalable and secure Salesforce solutions.
+ Ensure adherence to Salesforce best practices, coding standards, and security guidelines.

* System Enhancements & Support

+ Translate business requirements into technical specifications.
+ Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in existing implementations.
+ Perform unit testing, integration testing, and deployment activities using CI/CD tools (e.g., Git, Copado, Jenkins).

* Collaboration & Mentorship

+ Work closely with business analysts, admins, and QA teams to deliver quality solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers.
+ Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5–7 years of Salesforce development experience in enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in:

+ Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura
+ Salesforce Flows and Process Builder
+ SOQL, SOSL queries
+ REST/SOAP API integrations

* Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, declarative development, and customization.

* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data model, security model, and governor limits.

* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud,
* Exposure to Einstein Analytics, Marketing Cloud, or CPQ is a plus.
* Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS for advanced customizations.

Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.

title: Senior Delivery AI Software Engineer
description:
**Locations**
: Gurgaon | Bengaluru
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a part of BCG’s X Delivery team you will work closely with consulting teams on a diverse range of advanced topics. You will have the opportunity to leverage software development methodologies to deliver value to BCG's Consulting & X (case) teams, X Product teams and Practice Areas (domain) through providing software developer subject matter expertise, and accelerated execution support.
  
  
You will collaborate with teams to gather requirements, specify, design, develop, deliver and support software solutions serving client needs. You will provide technical support through deeper understanding of relevant software solutions and processes to build high quality and efficient technology solutions. Assignments will range from short term Proof of concepts/Minimum viable product to long term cases with enterprise grade software development as a critical enabler through the project level description of the role responsibilities and impact within the organization.
  
  
**You're Good At**
Web Application Development
  
  

* End to End high scale web-development experience but not just limited to architecting, design, planning, development and deployment
* Maintains a strong knowledge base of new opensource tech stacks, applications, techniques, and skills
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills; must be proactive and take initiative
* Create robust proprietary code and translate business logic into project requirements
* Develop code using development best practices, and an emphasis on security best practices
* Leverage technologies to support business needs to attain high reusability and maintainability of current and newly developed systems
* Provide system design recommendations based on technical requirements
* Work independently on development tasks with minimal supervision
* Write effective unit tests and integration tests to ensure high-quality software delivery

GenAI & Agentic Systems Engineering
  
  

* Designing and shipping enterprise-grade GenAI features inside full stack architectures — not standalone notebooks or demos
* Building modular AI services in Python (FastAPI / Flask / Django) that wrap LLM APIs and are exposed to the front end via REST
* Designing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector search, re-ranking and context management
* Building agentic workflows — tool and function calling, multi-step orchestration, state and memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and sensible fallbacks when an agent fails
* Integrating AI inference into React or Angular applications with UX patterns suited to AI (streaming responses, latency masking, citations, edit-and-retry, graceful degradation)
* Treating evaluation as engineering: defining success criteria for AI output, building test sets, and instrumenting logging, tracing, monitoring and cost/token controls
* Applying guardrails and Responsible AI practice — prompt injection defence, PII and client-confidentiality handling, output validation, and a clear audit trail
* Using AI-assisted development tooling to accelerate your own delivery, with judgement about where it helps and where it doesn't

Business Requirement Gathering and Collaboration
  
  

* Owning all or part of a software development engagement and integrating with cross-functional teams
* Establish credibility by thought partnering with demanding stakeholders / consulting teams on web development and delivery topics; drawing conclusions on a range of external and internal issues and dependencies
* Communicate insights through sophisticated synthesis and packaging of results (including PPT slides and charts) with stakeholders / consulting teams; collecting, synthesizing, learnings & inputs into new best practices and methodologies
* Executing software development approach and creating defined outcome; contributing to approach selection
* Ensure proper sign‐off before uploading materials into internal repository for reference; sanitizing confidential client content in marketing documents
* Able to build and sustain relationships with consulting MDPs to generate project work by self-leveraging regular connects
* Guides juniors on advanced software concepts and platforms, and helps in quality checks
* Contributes to team’s content & IP development
* Imparts technical trainings to team members and consulting cohort

Problem Solving
  
  

* You should be strong in solutioning with hands-on experience in software delivery, through the entire life cycle of software development. Strong problem solving skills with the ability to develop and codify knowledge and provide appropriate technical advice where required
* Comfort working with non-deterministic systems — debugging by evidence and evaluation rather than assumption

**Technical Skills**
Must have
  
  

* Experience in building high-performance web applications using -Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), React, Angular, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3
* Leveraging SQL-Postgres for best performance
* On OOPs concepts, design patterns, responsive UI and Unit testing frameworks like Mockito, Junit, Jest.
* Knowledge of Material UI or And Design
* Knowledge of UI component libraries to produce high-quality production apps following a high-fidelity design and a specification
* Track record of designing, developing and supporting highly scalable, responsive web app
* Integrate UI with REST APIs to make the app production-ready
* Hands-on experience building applications on top of LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI preferred; OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent acceptable) that have been used by real users
* Experience with at least one agent or orchestration framework (LangChain / LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, DSPy or a comparable in-house equivalent)
* Implementing tool / function calling and structured output, including schema validation and error handling
* Logging, tracing and evaluating AI output (LangSmith, Langfuse, Azure AI evaluation tooling or equivalent)

Working knowledge
  
  

* Unix command-line tools and code repo Git
* CI/CD, DevOps tools
* Cloud infra architecture design (Azure, GCP, Oracle) and deployment using Kubernetes
* UI component libraries to produce high-quality production apps following a high-fidelity design and a specification

Good to have
  
  

* Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes
* Deploying AI workloads to a major cloud platform and managing cost, latency and rate limits in production
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards
* Multi-agent system design, including agent-to-agent handoff and supervision patterns
* File Storage and NoSql Databases like MongoDB
* Charting libraries like HighCharts, D3.js and Recharts
* Basic wireframing skills
* Hybrid Mobile app development using React Native or Ionic

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Job Requirement**
You Bring (Experience & Qualifications)
  
  

* Bachelor's / Master's degree in computer science engineering/technology or equivalent
* Excellent communication skills

**Work Experience**

* At least 4-6 years of end-to-end web – application/tool development experience in a commercial setup specifically services or consulting organization
* Additional weightage for contributions made to open source projects, blogs, forums etc. in relevant technologies

title: Platform Engineer — Healthcare AI Platform USA
description:
**Company:**
Cosentus

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About the Role

Cosentus is looking for a
**Senior Full Stack & AI Platform Engineer**
with strong expertise in
**system design, scalable architecture, microservices, full-stack development, and AI-powered applications**
.

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can independently design complex systems, develop application modules, integrate modern AI technologies, and take complete ownership from architecture through production.

A key challenge involves building scalable AI-powered healthcare applications capable of processing
**2,000–5,000 medical charts within a 1–2 hour peak processing window**
, ensuring performance, reliability, accuracy, and cost efficiency.

The ideal candidate should be strong in
**Node.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda, Amazon Bedrock, microservices, distributed systems, OCR, RAG, and practical AI/LLM implementation**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop scalable applications using
  **React.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB**
  .
* Own
  **High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD)**
  for complex modules, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Design high-throughput architectures using
  **asynchronous processing, event-driven workflows, queues, caching, and parallel execution**
  .
* Build and optimize
  **AWS Lambda-based services**
  and integrate AI models using
  **Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Develop and scale
  **AI/LLM workflows, OCR pipelines, Vision AI, structured data extraction, and RAG systems**
  .
* Design scalable APIs, database schemas, background processing workflows, and communication between microservices.
* Implement
  **concurrency controls, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, fault tolerance, and monitoring**
  .
* Integrate
  **AI agents, tool calling, and workflow orchestration**
  where required.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across backend services, databases, AI models, and infrastructure.
* Take ownership of
  **development, deployment, performance optimization, and production troubleshooting**
  .

Core Technical Skills1. Full Stack Development & System Design

Strong hands-on experience with
**React.js, Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and REST APIs**
.

Strong understanding of:

* **HLD, LLD, scalable architecture, and microservices**
* Distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing
* Database design, query optimization, and API architecture
* Concurrency, caching, load balancing, and horizontal scaling
* Authentication, authorization, security, and fault tolerance
* Performance optimization and architectural trade-offs

The candidate must be capable of
**converting business requirements into detailed, scalable technical designs and implementing them independently**
.

2. Microservices, Distributed Systems & AWS

Strong practical knowledge of
**microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven system architecture**
.

Hands-on expertise with:

* **AWS Lambda:**
  Serverless development, deployment, concurrency, performance optimization, and scaling.
* **Amazon Bedrock:**
  Foundation model integration and production AI workflows.
* Working knowledge of
  **AWS S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM**
  .

Experience with
**Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar messaging and caching technologies**
.

Understanding of
**worker concurrency, queue-based processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, failure recovery, observability, and cloud cost optimization**
.

Deep expertise across every AWS service is not required.

3. AI / LLM Engineering, OCR & Document Intelligence

Hands-on experience implementing production AI applications involving:

* LLM integration, prompt engineering, and context management.
* **OCR, Vision AI, multimodal models, and PDF/image processing**
  .
* Document classification, table/form extraction, and structured JSON outputs.
* Schema validation, error handling, and hallucination reduction.
* Multi-stage AI processing pipelines and model orchestration.
* Token optimization, AI latency management, and cost reduction.
* AI evaluation, accuracy improvement, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

The candidate should understand how to build
**reliable AI features beyond simply making LLM API calls**
.

4. RAG & AI Workflow Architecture

Hands-on experience designing and implementing
**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
systems, including:

* Document ingestion, chunking, and embeddings
* Vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, and metadata filtering
* Retrieval optimization, reranking, and context construction
* Response grounding and RAG evaluation

Working knowledge of
**AI agents, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, state management, and contextual memory**
.

Experience with
**LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks**
is preferred.

5. Scalability, Performance & Engineering Ownership

The candidate should be capable of:

* Designing architectures for high-volume document and AI processing.
* Performing capacity planning, throughput estimation, and load testing.
* Building scalable background workers and asynchronous pipelines.
* Optimizing APIs, databases, model calls, and infrastructure.
* Troubleshooting complex production issues.
* Making architectural decisions and explaining technical trade-offs.
* Independently owning complex technical modules from requirements to deployment.

Good to Have

* Experience with
  **US Healthcare, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical coding, insurance claims, or HIPAA-aware applications**
  .
* Advanced AI agents, multi-agent workflows, and agent orchestration.
* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, and advanced AI memory.
* Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and feedback-driven improvement systems.

Experience Required

* **3–5 years of professional software development experience**
  .
* Strong full-stack development experience, particularly in backend engineering.
* Strong system design, microservices, and scalable architecture knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS Lambda and Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **AI/LLM integration, OCR, and RAG**
  .
* Ability to independently design, implement, and own complex technical modules.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a
**hands-on engineer and strong system thinker**

title: Application Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
We Are
  
  
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are a DDR/LPDDR Controller System Architecture Specialist who can work directly with customer architects to close real system-level memory subsystem design decisions.
  
  
You are comfortable discussing SoC integration, memory subsystem architecture, controller configuration, performance optimization, power management, validation, and interoperability topics. You can help customers evaluate technical trade-offs and guide them toward practical architecture decisions.
  
  
This is a customer-facing technical role. You will help customers integrate DDR/LPDDR controller IP into complex SoCs, identify key requirements or gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable input for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the technical architecture engagement for DDR/LPDDR controller IP with strategic customers, from early platform requirements through architecture closure and initial deployment readiness.
* Work with customer architects and engineering teams to define suitable DDR/LPDDR memory subsystem configurations for advanced SoC platforms.
* Analyze system-level trade-offs related to memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and scalability.
* Translate customer platform requirements and integration constraints into clear feedback for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
* Support technical closure of design wins by providing architecture guidance, configuration recommendations and competitive positioning.
* Develop reusable technical material, application notes, and customer-facing guidance based on real engagement experience.
* Train FAEs and customer teams on DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem integration, performance tuning, validation expectations, and deployment best practices.

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve the quality of DDR/LPDDR design wins by ensuring customer memory architectures are technically sound before commitment.
* Strengthen Synopsys DDR/LPDDR roadmap by feeding real customer memory subsystem requirements into product planning and R&D execution.
* Reduce customer integration risk by identifying architecture, performance, power, validation, and bring-up issues early.
* Help establish Synopsys as a trusted technical partner for next-generation AI, HPC, mobile, automotive, networking, and edge computing platforms.

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Bachelors and/or Masters Degree in Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
* 5+ years of experience in DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem design, SoC integration, silicon validation, systems engineering, applications engineering, or customer-facing technical leadership.
* Solid understanding of DDR and/or LPDDR controller IP, including memory architecture concepts, controller configuration, scheduling, quality of service, power management, training, validation, or system integration.
* Good system-level understanding of SoC integration and ability to reason through memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and software/firmware trade-offs.
* Experience engaging directly with customer architects, design teams, validation teams, and technical decision-makers.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical recommendations, product feedback, and closure plans.
* Strong technical communication skills, including clear written analysis, structured trade-off explanation, and ability to align customer, sales, product, and engineering teams.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Linux, firmware bring-up, or software-driven debug of DDR/LPDDR subsystems.
* Familiarity with advanced SoC architectures used in AI, HPC, automotive, mobile, networking, or compute platforms.
* Experience with memory performance analysis, traffic modeling, quality-of-service management, memory hierarchy optimization, or system-level benchmarking.
* Knowledge of advanced topics such as DDR5, LPDDR5X, LPDDR6, memory training algorithms, RAS features, chiplet-based memory architectures, or AI memory bandwidth optimization.

The Team You’ll be a Part Of
  
  
You will be part of our IP high-performance computing applications engineering team, a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. The team focuses on helping customers integrate more capabilities into SoCs faster, working collaboratively across geographic and organizational boundaries to drive revenue growth and accelerate business closure.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
Inclusion and Diversity
  
  
Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:

We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organisations through complex digital decisions. Your Role As a Senior Software Engineer (L4) - Fullstack, your mission is to design and develop cloud-native applications that seamlessly integrate frontend and backend technologies to deliver efficient, scalable, and user-centric solutions. You’ll work across the entire stack to build responsive interfaces and robust APIs, ensuring high performance and an exceptional user experience. In this role, you will leverage modern frontend and backend frameworks alongside Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to solve diverse business challenges. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams and support clients across industries, gaining broad technical exposure and continuously enhancing your skill set in a dynamic, customer-focused environment. Responsibilities
- Lead technical delivery across the full project lifecycle — from discovery, architecture definition, and solution design through implementation, testing, and deployment.
- Architect and design cloud-native solutions on GCP, including application modernization, microservices design, serverless architectures, and GenAI-powered feature development.
- Own end-to-end full-stack development, setting patterns and standards for both backend services and frontend interfaces across the engagement.
- Design and implement AI-integrated agentic workflows that combine enterprise data sources with large language models and cloud-native services.
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customer stakeholders, clearly articulating architectural decisions, trade-offs, and technical progress to engineers, project managers, and executives.
- Translate complex technical requirements into well-structured implementation plans and guide junior engineers in their execution.
- Conduct and contribute to technical design reviews, architecture assessments, and code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
- Manage your technical scope across 1–2 concurrent customer engagements, balancing depth of delivery with cross-project awareness.
- Proactively identify risks, surface blockers, and communicate mitigation strategies to stakeholders in a timely and structured manner.
- Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, reusable frameworks, and best practice documentation that elevate the broader engineering team. Expectations
- Required Travel: Limited (<5%) travel to customer sites, conferences, and related events.
- Customer Facing: You will engage with customers regularly and with a higher degree of ownership at L4. Expect frequent interactions with senior engineers, technical leads, architects, and executive stakeholders. You will be expected to lead technical conversations, present architecture recommendations, and build trusted advisor relationships with customer teams.
- Technical Leadership: Beyond individual contribution, you are expected to guide technical direction on your engagements, mentor L3 engineers, and ensure consistent quality and standards across deliverables.
- Onboarding/Training: The first several weeks are dedicated to learning and will encompass learning materials, assignments, compliance training, and meetings with relevant individuals. Details are shared closer to the start date. Job Requirements Required Credentials
- 5–8 years of professional software development experience, with a strong emphasis on full-stack and cloud-native architecture.
- 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying AI-driven applications, agentic workflows, or LLM-based solutions in production environments. Required Qualifications This role requires deep full-stack proficiency combined with strong cloud-native architectural capabilities. Candidates must demonstrate advanced expertise in at least one backend technology and at least one frontend technology from the lists below and must be comfortable operating across the full stack when needed.
- 8+ years of experience in C# development, with a strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles.
- Extensive experience with .NET Framework and .Net Core
- Familiarity with frontend web technologies, particularly React and Angular.
- Solid understanding of database systems & storage (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, NoSQL) and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
- Experience designing, building, and maintaining high-quality, developer-friendly REST APIs using OpenAPI (Swagger) specifications.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
- Exposure to full-stack development, from setting up application and database server infrastructure to developing and implementing application code.
- Experience in writing automated tests, including unit, integration, and acceptance tests
- Experience with cloud platforms especially GCP
- Experience working with and diagnosing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub actions, Bamboo, Jenkins, Harness, or GCP Cloud Build) Useful Qualifications
- Experience in the upgrade of in-scope applications from .NET Framework to .NET 8.
- Expertise in development with few of the following languages: Python, Go, Node.js, Java (optional)
- Experience in using any message queue, such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
- Experience in writing GraphQL interfaced services
- Experience in working with authentication and authorization
- Hands-on experience in building, deploying, and optimizing AI/ML solutions
- Experience with Google Cloud Platform — in particular serverless (Cloud Functions), containers (Cloud Run), and Kubernetes Engine (GKE).

title: Software Engineer 3
description:
Enterprise Advanced is a distributed team across Europe and India that builds the software running MongoDB on any infrastructure, at global scale — from on-prem data centers to private cloud. You'll work primarily on Ops Manager and Automation, the systems that let customers deploy fault-tolerant, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in minutes. Our software manages some of the largest self-managed MongoDB deployments in the world, with production clusters running hundreds of shards and nodes under a single deployment.
  
  
The main focus of this team is to adapt our software to manage MongoDB clusters which are deployed in data centers or private cloud platforms.
  
  
You will work on the core functionality for all of our products, mainly on the Ops Manager, and Automation products. Our team's end users are some of the largest businesses in the world, deploying massive clusters and processing huge amounts of data.

* You're a self-starter! You're comfortable organizing your own time, acting on feedback and prioritizing with guidance from senior members of your team

* 4+ years experience with a language such as Java or GO.
