Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Embedded and Electronics Intern
description:
**Embedded and Electronics Intern**

**Location:**

New Delhi

**Employment Type:**

Internship-6 months On-site

Note: This is a 6 months internship suitable for recent graduates.

**About NITS Engineering**

NITS Engineering is a biomedical technology company building the next generation of biomedical devices, in vitro disease models, and engineering systems for drug discovery, regenerative medicine, and diagnostics. We combine precision hardware engineering with biomedical research to build the tools that take science from the lab bench to real world application.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an Embedded and Electronics Intern to contribute to the development of electronics, firmware, and software for our 3D bioprinters. The role involves hands-on work across motion control, dispensing systems, sensors, embedded systems, and machine-control software.

Projects will be assigned based on the candidate's technical strengths, interests, and the team's requirements. We welcome candidates with strong fundamentals in one or more relevant areas and a willingness to work across hardware and software.

**What You Will Do**

* **Bioprinter Development:**

  Develop, integrate, and test printer subsystems involving motion control, extrusion and dispensing, temperature control, and automation.
* **Firmware Development:**

  Program and debug microcontrollers, including STM32, AVR, and ESP32 platforms.
* **Electronics Design:**

  Develop circuit schematics, design PCBs, prepare bills of materials (BOMs), and assist with board assembly and testing.
* **Hardware Interfacing:**

  Integrate sensors, actuators, and controllers using communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, RS232, RS485, USB, and Wi-Fi.
* **Embedded Software:**

  Develop and troubleshoot embedded Linux applications on single-board computers such as Raspberry Pi.
* **Application Development:**

  Build software interfaces and applications that communicate with printer hardware and embedded systems using technologies such as Python, Qt, or React.
* **Debugging and Testing:**

  Diagnose hardware, firmware, communication, and software issues; conduct functional tests and document results.
* **Technical Documentation:**

  Maintain circuit diagrams, code documentation, test procedures, and development records.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Recently completed a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electronics and Communication, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
* Strong fundamentals in analog and digital electronics.
* Programming knowledge in C, C++, and/or Python.
* Familiarity with microcontrollers and embedded systems, including programming and debugging.
* Hands-on exposure to development boards and single-board computers such as Raspberry Pi.
* Understanding of communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, RS232, RS485, and USB.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical problems systematically and document work clearly.
* Willingness to learn across electronics, firmware, software, and automation.
* Must have a personal laptop capable of running development tools such as IDEs, PCB design software, and compilers, as a company laptop will not be provided.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or Qt.
* Previous academic, personal, or professional projects involving embedded systems, PCB design, or electronics.
* Experience with 3D printing, bioprinting, or biomedical devices.
* Familiarity with 3D printer firmware such as Marlin or Klipper.

**What You Will Gain**

* A monthly stipend.
* Hands-on experience developing bioprinter electronics and embedded systems from design to functional prototypes.
* Exposure to hardware, firmware, software, and automation within a single product-development environment.
* Experience troubleshooting and integrating real engineering systems.
* Mentorship and opportunities to develop practical engineering skills alongside an experienced team.

title: Senior Analyst, PPK Operations
description:
**Company Overview**
Bain & Company is the management consulting firm that the world's business leaders come to when they want results. Bain advises clients on strategy, operations, information technology, organization, private equity, digital transformation and strategy, and mergers and acquisitions, developing practical insights that clients act on and transferring skills that make change stick. The firm aligns its incentives with clients by linking its fees to their results. Bain clients have outperformed the stock market 4 to 1. Founded in 1973, Bain has 58 offices in 37 countries, and its deep expertise and client roster cross every industry and economic sector.
  
  
**Department Overview**
Bain's Product, Practice & Knowledge (PPK) department has played a vital role in harnessing the best of our consulting staffs' individual and collective expertise for over 20 years. Within PPK, each practice supports teams across the globe with deep expertise and knowledge. Our practices play a critical role in Bain's commercial success and are a key strategic priority.
  
  
PPK is continually focused on creating a stronger, more scalable, efficient and effective PPK organization. The PPK Operations team will help achieve this by developing and improving processes, tools, and communications to better support our PPK teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Senior Analyst is a technical builder on the PPK Operations team. Where the Analyst supports defined analytical workstreams and the Operations Manager owns the simplification agenda end to end, this role sits between the two: it takes ownership of complete solutions from problem definition through build and adoption, working with limited supervision, and is expected to bring the technical depth that makes automation and AI-enabled delivery real.
  
  
The distinguishing expectation of this role is speed of build. We are looking for someone who uses AI tools and low-code platforms to deliver dashboards, automations and analyses in a fraction of the time traditional approaches require, and who can explain and defend the logic behind what they build.
  
  
**Automation and AI-enabled solution build (~40%)**

* Designs and builds automated solutions that remove manual effort from recurring PPK processes, using Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel and scripting as appropriate
* Uses AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT as a core part of the build workflow to accelerate development, generate and debug code and formulas, structure unfamiliar data, and prototype solutions quickly
* Prototypes and deploys AI agents and assistants for defined PPK use cases; identifies where an agentic approach outperforms a conventional one
* Translates business requirements into working logic: data flows, conditional rules, error handling and validation, so solutions hold up in production and not only in demo
* Documents what is built so solutions can be maintained, handed over and reused across practices
* Maintains a healthy skepticism about AI output, validating results before they inform decisions or reach stakeholders

**Operations project delivery (~30%)**

* Owns discrete PPK Operations workstreams from scoping through delivery, with the Operations Manager as thought partner rather than reviewer of every step
* Contributes to the PPK Operations project backlog by identifying candidates, sizing effort and impact, and recommending sequencing
* Engages internal stakeholders directly to gather requirements, clarify scope, secure inputs and drive adoption of what is delivered
* Runs test and learn pilots, captures what worked and what did not, and folds those lessons into the next build
* Proactively flags gaps, dependencies and tradeoffs rather than waiting to be asked

**Analytics and reporting (~20%)**

* Builds and owns Power BI dashboards end to end, covering data modelling, DAX, Power Query and visual design, applying Bain visual standards
* Rebuilds and streamlines existing reporting so recurring outputs run with minimal manual intervention
* Performs quantitative analysis on PPK operational data and derives insights that stand on their own rather than only presenting the numbers
* Triangulates data across multiple systems and stakeholders, resolving inconsistencies and flagging data quality issues at source
* Produces insight-driven output in the right format for the audience, whether a dashboard, a deck, a model or a written recommendation

**Teaming and apprenticeship (10%)**

* Coaches junior analysts on technical craft, including tool selection, prompt design, dashboard structure and automation hygiene
* Reviews the technical quality of work produced by others on the team and raises the standard through direct, constructive feedback
* Shares reusable assets, templates and best practices across PPK so solutions built once are used many times
* Evangelizes the art of the possible to other teams and builds credibility for new ways of working through demonstrated results
* Contributes as a member of the broader PPK community through projects, training and experience sharing

**About You**
**Technical skills: required**

* Practical, daily working fluency with AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT, used to build and ship real deliverables rather than to draft text; you can point to work that was materially faster or better because of how you used them
* Strong Power BI capability including data modelling, DAX and Power Query, with the ability to take a dashboard from raw data to a stakeholder-ready product without handoffs
* Working knowledge of programming, in any language, sufficient that logic building is second nature: you understand data structures, control flow, functions and debugging, and can read, adapt and reason about code even where you do not write production software
* Advanced Excel, including complex formulas, structured data handling and comfort with large or messy datasets
* Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to structure a clear argument, not only format slides

**Technical skills: preferred**

* Experience across the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly Power Automate, SharePoint lists and libraries, and Power Apps
* Experience building AI agents or assistants, including prompt engineering, tool and API integration, and evaluating agent output
* Process automation experience of any kind, whether scripted, low-code or RPA based, with a track record of removing recurring manual work
* Python or a comparable scripting language for data manipulation, API work and automation
* Familiarity with APIs and how systems exchange data; comfort reading documentation and working out an integration independently
* Exposure to Alteryx, Tableau or comparable analytics and data preparation tools

**Experience And Mindset**

* 4 to 6 years of experience in a professional services, consulting, analytics, knowledge management or operations environment
* Demonstrated ownership of solutions end to end, from ambiguous problem statement through to a working, adopted product
* A self-learner with a genuine desire to figure it out; you pick up new tools quickly and without being taught
* A passion for changing how work gets done by adopting new approaches and new technology, paired with the judgement to know when the traditional approach is still the right one
* Structured problem-solving: you break ambiguous questions into clear hypotheses, analyses and implications
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical choices to a non-technical audience and establish credibility with senior stakeholders
* The maturity and integrity to handle confidential information and to use technology, including AI, responsibly
* Ability to operate independently, comfortable with a remote supervisor and wider team, managing competing priorities with minimal supervision
* Known for high-quality work, attentive to detail and well-organized
* Bachelor of Arts, Engineering, Science or equivalent undergraduate degree with strong academic credentials; Statistics, Business, Economics, Computer Science or Analytics concentrations also applicable

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s leading Community Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. We have proudly facilitated 5 million+ members. By leveraging AI-based algorithms, we streamline the process of searching and connecting with compatible profiles. Our platform redefines how people perceive and approach marriage, ensuring an easy and efficient experience.

**Build the Team. Own the Architecture. Ship the Product. Solve the Hardest Problems.**

**Experience:**
Proven engineering leadership experience required

**Preferred background:**
Strong product-based technology companies

**Role:**
Hands-on Engineering Manager / Individual Contributor

**Expectation:**
High ownership, high execution velocity, zero dependency on constant supervision

The Role

We are looking for an engineering leader who can do both:
**build a high-performing engineering team and personally solve difficult engineering problems.**

You are not someone who stopped coding after becoming a manager. You can review a system architecture, understand an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a production outage, write a critical service, build an AI agent, and still know how to hire, coach, challenge, and manage engineers effectively.

You can take an ambiguous business objective, translate it into an engineering strategy, break it into executable work, assign ownership, remove bottlenecks, and drive it to production.

When the team is moving fast, you multiply its output. When a critical technical problem is blocking delivery, you can get into the details and help solve it yourself.

You are technology-agnostic, obsessed with execution, comfortable with complexity, and actively exploring how AI and autonomous agents can change the way software is built.

**We are not looking for a manager who needs a team to do the engineering for them but for an engineer who has developed the ability to make an entire team more effective without losing the ability to build themselves.**

**What You Will Own**

1. Engineering execution and delivery

* Take complete ownership of engineering delivery, from understanding business priorities to shipping reliable production systems.
* Convert ambiguous business objectives into clear technical plans, milestones, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution across multiple projects without allowing dependencies, indecision, or coordination overhead to become excuses for delays.
* Identify bottlenecks early, make trade-offs decisively, and unblock the team without waiting for escalations.
* Maintain high execution velocity without accumulating reckless technical debt or compromising security and reliability.
* Ensure the team ships working software, not just completed tickets, merged pull requests, or impressive-looking roadmaps.
* Take direct ownership of critical deliverables when timelines or technical complexity demand hands-on intervention.

2. Hands-on engineering and technical leadership

* Remain technically credible through active coding, code reviews, debugging, system design, and production ownership.
* Design and build backend services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, automations, and AI-powered systems as required.
* Navigate unfamiliar repositories and technology stacks without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* Make sound architecture decisions based on business needs, scalability, reliability, maintainability, cost, and time to market.
* Diagnose complex production failures, performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, and difficult integration issues.
* Establish engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, deployment, and operational readiness.
* Know when to delegate, when to coach, and when to personally take the keyboard.

3. Team leadership and people management

* Build and manage a team of high-performing engineers with clear expectations, accountability, and ownership.
* Hire engineers who demonstrate exceptional problem-solving ability, technical depth, learning speed, and execution.
* Set a high engineering bar and address persistent performance issues directly and fairly.
* Coach engineers through difficult technical decisions instead of becoming the team's permanent debugging service.
* Develop engineers who can independently own systems, make decisions, and deliver outcomes.
* Create a culture where engineers challenge assumptions, surface problems early, take responsibility, and continuously improve.
* Balance delegation with hands-on involvement without becoming either a micromanager or an absent manager.
* Provide clear feedback, manage performance, resolve conflicts, and make difficult people decisions when necessary.

4. AI-native and agentic engineering

We expect you to be an active practitioner of modern AI-assisted engineering, not someone who merely encourages the team to experiment with ChatGPT.

* Use AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring.
* Build or integrate agentic workflows involving planning, tool calling, multi-step execution, external APIs, and verification.
* Identify engineering and business processes that can be automated using LLMs, agents, and conventional software.
* Establish practical workflows that increase engineering throughput without sacrificing correctness or security.
* Evaluate new AI tools based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, and cost.
* Teach the team how to use AI effectively, review AI-generated code critically, and validate agent-driven changes.
* Personally prototype and ship AI-powered solutions rather than limiting your involvement to strategy and vendor selection.

**We want a leader who uses AI to increase the output of the entire engineering organization, including their own.**

5. Cross-domain problem solving

You should be comfortable moving between fundamentally different technical challenges.

Depending on the problem, this may involve:

* Backend architecture, APIs, databases, caching, and distributed systems.
* Mobile, web, and end-to-end product workflows.
* Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, performance, and incident management.
* Payment gateways, third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, and data consistency.
* AI applications, LLM integrations, agentic systems, and automation.
* Security, reliability, cost optimization, and scaling systems under real-world constraints.

6. Business ownership

* Understand the business metrics behind the engineering roadmap.
* Prioritize work based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and engineering effort.
* Challenge unnecessary complexity, low-value projects and choices that don't solve a meaningful problem.
* Make informed build-versus-buy decisions.
* Optimize infrastructure and engineering costs without creating fragile systems.
* Communicate technical risks, delivery trade-offs, and progress clearly to business stakeholders.

You are expected to understand not just whether something can be built, but whether it should be built, why it matters, and how quickly it needs to deliver value.

The Non-Negotiable Bar

**Technical credibility:**
You have personally built and shipped production software and can still reason deeply about code and architecture.

**Independent execution:**
You do not need your manager to tell you what to prioritize, how to solve a problem, or how to unblock your team.

**Leadership without hiding behind delegation:**
You can manage through others while remaining capable of direct technical contribution.

**Breadth of experience:**
You have dealt with different classes of engineering problems and can adapt beyond your primary specialization.

**AI-native thinking:**
You actively use AI and agentic workflows to improve individual and team productivity.

**Accountability:**
When a project fails, you investigate the causes, own your part, correct the course, and prevent avoidable recurrence.

**People leadership:**
You can attract, develop, challenge, and retain strong engineers while addressing underperformance directly.

What We Do Not Want

* A people manager who has lost the ability to understand or contribute to the code.
* A project manager whose primary output is meetings, status reports, and Jira updates.
* An architect who produces diagrams but cannot validate implementation details.
* A hands-off manager who delegates every difficult technical problem.
* A micromanager who becomes the approval bottleneck for every decision.

What Success Looks Like

* The team consistently ships high-quality software with predictable execution.
* Engineers operate with greater independence and take meaningful ownership.
* Architectural and technical decisions improve the product rather than create unnecessary complexity.
* Critical production issues are diagnosed and resolved systematically.
* AI and automation measurably improve engineering throughput.
* Engineering resources are allocated to the highest-impact problems.
* You can step into the hardest technical problems without becoming a permanent bottleneck.

Interview Process

* **Technical deep dive:**
  Walk us through complex systems you have personally designed, built, shipped, or operated.
* **Live problem solving:**
  Debug an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a failure, or solve a practical engineering problem.
* **System design:**
  Design a production system and defend your choices around reliability, scale, security, cost, and delivery speed.
* **AI-agent exercise:**
  Use an AI coding agent to solve a bounded engineering task and demonstrate how you verify its work.
* **Engineering management scenarios:**
  Handle missed commitments, underperformance, technical disagreements, competing priorities, and team bottlenecks.
* **Execution review:**
  Explain a difficult project you owned, the decisions you made, what went wrong, and the measurable result.
* **Ownership verification:**
  Distinguish what you personally contributed from what the team delivered.

We will evaluate the reasoning behind your decisions, not just the final answers.

**The expectation is simple: lead the team, own the outcome, understand the technology, and be ready to build when it matters.**

* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with engineering simulation and computational tools such as OpenFOAM, SU2, CalculiX, Code\_Aster, FEniCS, Elmer, Gmsh, FreeCAD, CadQuery, MuJoCo, ROS, XFOIL, AVL, OpenVSP, JSBSim, OpenMDAO, pyCycle, poliastro, Orekit, GMAT, or SPICE.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction To Team**
Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.
  
  
The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.
  
  
We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.
  
  
As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
* Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Developer Experience
description:
**About Tide**
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
  
  
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
  
  
**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**
The Platform Engineering team builds the tools, infrastructure and ‘golden paths’ that let Tide’s engineers ship safely and quickly. We own everything from CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling to Tide’s service catalogue, including the Developer Productivity function, and our mission is to make the right way the easy way for every engineer at Tide — human or AI agent.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Senior Engineering Manager, Developer Experience / Head of Developer Experience, you will report directly to the Director of Platform Engineering and be responsible for how every engineer at Tide builds, tests and ships software. You will:
  
  

* Own the Developer Experience strategy for Tide, setting the vision and roadmap for developer tooling, CI/CD and the internal platform.
* Lead the design, build and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, reducing friction and lead time across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Define, track and report on DevEx and engineering productivity metrics (e.g. DORA, SPACE), using data to identify bottlenecks and prioritise investment.
* Own and evolve Tide’s service catalogue (Backstage), establishing it as the single source of truth for the ICT Asset Register and driving adoption across engineering.
* Manage the Developer Productivity function, responsible for building and maintaining Java/Spring and Python ‘paved road’ templates that give product teams a fast, secure and consistent way to start new services.
* Own the internally developed libraries for authentication and other common functionality, ensuring they are well documented, kept up to date, and widely adopted across product teams.
* Build, lead and mentor a team of platform, developer experience and developer productivity engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, craftsmanship and continuous improvement.
* Prepare Tide’s engineering platform for agentic development, ensuring our tooling, paved roads and guardrails allow AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) to contribute safely and effectively alongside human engineers.
* Define the platform, tooling and operating model for running AI-developed applications in production, covering observability, security, testing and governance for agent-authored code.
* Partner closely with engineering leaders, security and compliance stakeholders across Tide’s product and platform teams to identify friction points and shape the platform roadmap.

**What We Are Looking For**
Tide is seeking an experienced Head of Developer Experience to lead our efforts in making our engineers as productive and effective as possible. The ideal candidate will have:
  
  

* A proven track record leading Developer Experience, Platform Engineering or DevOps/SRE teams at scale.
* Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling in a modern cloud environment.
* Experience with Backstage, or a comparable internal developer portal / service catalogue tool, including rollout and adoption.
* Experience running a developer productivity or paved-road function, including building and maintaining project templates (e.g. Java/Spring, Python) and shared libraries (e.g. authentication, common functionality) used by product teams.
* Working knowledge of engineering productivity frameworks such as DORA metrics or SPACE, and experience using them to drive improvement.
* Familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), and a point of view on the guardrails, governance and infrastructure needed to run AI-developed applications safely in production.
* Strong people leadership skills, with a track record of building, growing and developing high-performing engineering teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to influence engineering leaders across multiple teams and locations.
* Experience in financial services or another regulated, technology-driven scale-up environment is a plus.

**OUR TECH STACK**
Our platform and developer experience tooling includes: Terraform, Helm, Crossplane, Kubernetes (K8S), GitHub, AWS, GCP, Claude, and Backstage as our developer portal and service catalogue. Our product teams build on Java/Spring Boot and Python.
  
  
**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
  
  
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
  
  
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
  
  
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
  
  
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
  
  
*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*
**Disclaimer**
It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That
  
  

* Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
* All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
* Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
* Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
  
  
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*
**Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.**

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With
**65,000+ success storie**
s and
**over 2 Million+ members**
, we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an engineer who can
**think independently, solve difficult problems, and turn ideas into reliable production software.**

You won't always get a detailed specification or a step-by-step implementation plan. You'll get a problem, its context, and the freedom to figure out how to solve it. You'll learn unfamiliar systems, make practical engineering decisions, build and test solutions, and take ownership of your work from implementation through deployment.

We're AI-native. You'll use AI coding agents and modern engineering tools to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, debug issues, and automate repetitive work. You'll remain accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Build and ship software:**
  Turn product requirements and business problems into working, reliable software that delivers measurable value.
* **Own features end to end:**
  Understand requirements, explore possible solutions, implement features, write tests, deploy changes, and fix issues after release.
* **Solve engineering problems:**
  Break down ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions without relying on step-by-step instructions.
* **Work across domains:**
  Contribute to backend systems, APIs, databases, infrastructure, integrations, data-intensive applications, and AI-powered workflows as the problem requires.
* **Navigate unfamiliar systems:**
  Understand existing codebases, investigate how components interact, and adapt to new technologies without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* **Debug and investigate:**
  Reproduce failures, analyze logs and system behavior, identify root causes, and implement fixes that prevent recurring problems.
* **Make sound technical decisions:**
  Consider correctness, performance, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and implementation complexity when choosing a solution.
* **Use AI-native engineering workflows:**
  Leverage AI coding agents for exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. Review their output critically and verify that solutions work as intended.
* **Automate repetitive work:**
  Identify inefficient manual processes and build tools or automations that improve productivity and reduce operational effort.
* **Collaborate and take ownership:**
  Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving. Communicate blockers early and incorporate feedback constructively.
* **Continuously improve:**
  Learn from production issues, measure the impact of your work, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems you build.

**Examples of Problems You'll Tackle**

* Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way.
* Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience.
* Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies.
* Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process.
* Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix.
* Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles.
* The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used.
* A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
* The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision.
* Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments.
* A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures.
* The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable.
* Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically.
* Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work.
* The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively.
* Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills.

**Strong Plus**

* **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users.
* Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs.
* Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks.
* Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards.
* Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials.
* Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution.

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

* **Engineering and project review:**
  Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made.
* **Practical problem-solving:**
  Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology.
* **Code implementation and debugging:**
  Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work.
* **System design and reasoning:**
  Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth.
* **AI-assisted engineering exercise:**

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About Chariot**

Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in Delhi, building foundation models. We're one of the original four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.

**The Role**

You'll build and own products powered by Chariot's models, from understanding a user's problem and deciding what to build to shipping it, measuring how it performs, and improving it.

This is a hands-on engineering role across the frontend and backend. You'll work directly with users and researchers, make product and engineering decisions, and take responsibility for both the user experience and the systems behind it. Your ownership continues after launch: understanding whether people are getting value, finding where the product falls short, and deciding what to improve next.

What you'll work on

1. **Understand users and shape the product.**

2. **Build and ship across the stack.**
   Turn ideas into working products, from interfaces and user flows to APIs and backend services. Own features through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
3. **Measure and improve.**
   Decide what success looks like and instrument products to understand how people use them. Use usage data, feedback, and failure patterns to improve the experience and guide what you build next.
4. **Own the systems behind your products.**
   Build and operate backend services that perform reliably under real load, including APIs, queues, storage, and integrations with model inference. Improve latency, throughput, reliability, and cost as usage grows.
5. **Connect product feedback to model quality.**
   Work with researchers to understand where models succeed or fail in real use. Build evaluation tools and automated checks that measure the quality of model-powered features, catch regressions, and help guide improvements.

What we look for

* **Strong product sense.**
  You can work through an ambiguous user problem, choose what matters, and explain why. You know how to scope a first version, decide what to measure, and use evidence to improve it.
* **Extensive experience building and operating backend systems at scale.**
  You've owned production services under real load, handled failures, and made informed tradeoffs around architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.
* **Full-stack engineering ability.**
  You're comfortable building usable interfaces and the services behind them, and carrying a feature through to production. You pay attention to the details that make a product clear and easy to use.

* **Thoughtful use of AI tools.**

  You follow through on adoption, quality, and reliability. You're comfortable revisiting decisions and changing course when something isn't working.

Experience with model serving, GPU infrastructure, large-scale data pipelines, ML evaluation, speech systems, or multilingual products is a strong plus.

title: Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Compiler Performance Engineer**
to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

  

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler
  
* Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime
  
* Improve code generation for x86\_64 and AArch64
  
* Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions
  
* Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense
  

  
**What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering
  
* Strong C++ design and coding skills
  
* Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations
  
* Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another
  

  
**Very Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8
  
* Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler
  
* Knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
  
* Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals
  
* MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

description:

* Contribute to application development activities to implement new and improve existing web applications that provide direct and measurable value to our users.
* Build and enhance reliable, scalable software solutions with guidance from senior engineers and architects.

* Write reusable, testable and efficient code and follow secure coding best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality and engineering skills.
* Work with product owners, stakeholders and other engineers to understand requirements, evaluate options and deliver pragmatic solutions.
* Contribute to software engineering best practices, knowledge sharing, tools and technology evolution, and standards.
* Work closely with end-users and business staff to investigate and resolve system issues.
* Learn and apply the technologies underlying current and future enterprise systems.

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, systems analysis or a related field of study, or equivalent training/experience.
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, including internships, co-ops or equivalent hands-on development experience.
* Working knowledge of modern full stack development technologies, including but not limited to:
* TypeScript and JavaScript for Node.js web applications, including frameworks such as Express, Angular, or React
* APIs using REST and/or GraphQL (Apollo)
* Fundamental understanding of modern system architecture patterns
* Data management principles and experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases
* Agile software development practices, source control and continuous integration
* Using AI-assisted development tools to support design, coding, testing or documentation
* Writing unit tests and exposure to integration and end-to-end automated testing

* Exposure to mobile application development is a plus.
* Experience working with data flows between databases, APIs and applications is a plus.
* Cloud, AI or relevant open source technology certifications are a plus.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:

The Staff Engineer L6 will lead development for various Inovalon products and platforms, innovating to overcome current technology and bring in solutions which solve resiliency, scale, security in a completely different level. This position brings subject matter expertise as a functional lead and is tasked with ensuring a high level of discipline and productivity.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and access patterns related to Healthcare;
* Research, evaluate and utilize new technologies/tools/frameworks centered around high-volume data processing in AWS;
* Document and estimate technical scope and design as needed;
* Design and implement distributed data processing pipelines using tools and languages prevalent in the big data ecosystem;
* Involve and drive a culture of collaborative reviews of designs, code and test plans;
* Work with business stake holders and architecture engineering leads to ensure quality solutions are implemented and engineering standard methodologies adhered to;
* DevOps Focus – Utilize and advance continuous integration and deployment frameworks;
* Solve complex data issues and perform root cause analysis;
* Work across teams to resolve operational & performance issues;
* Provide strong technical leadership, raise the technical bar, maintain data and results-driven culture, nurture a team culture of high collaboration and trust;
* Communicate effectively and partner well with other disciplines of the project team to deliver high quality solutions from ideas to production code;
* Facilitate alignment and clarity across teams on goals, outcomes, and timelines;
* Influence and coach junior engineers both within and outside of your team; be a role model for an open, honest, and inclusive approach to problem solving;
* Adhere to all confidentiality, HIPAA, regulatory, and other such policies, procedures, and requirements as outlined within Employer’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the scope of work; and
* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement, and fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Experience: 15+ years of industrial experience with Cloud and serverless technologies.
* Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with AWS; Azure DevOps CI/CD; test orchestration; IaC; observability tooling.
* Experience implementing fully automated pipelines with multi-stage validation.
* Data & Storage: Familiarity with SQL Server, Snowflake, PostgreSQL— especially test data creation, schema validation, and data quality automation.
* Quality: Proven ability to drive test automation maturity, reduce manual testing, eliminate flakiness, and improve reliability through automation. Experience with monitoring, proactive stability improvements, and automated alerting.

**Nice To Have (Preferred)**

* Experience with service meshes and asynchronous/event-streaming systems (Kafka, SQS, SNS).
* Advanced performance testing and benchmarking experience (k6, JMeter, Gatling).
* Security automation experience: vulnerability scanning, static analysis, secrets validation.
* Experience leading org-wide automation transformations, platform migrations, or quality initiatives.

**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Work Environment**- Primarily sedentary; ability to sit for extended periods.
- Occasionally lift to 10 lbs.
- Predominantly office/indoor working conditions.
Travel <10% (primarily local; training and collaboration).

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design and evolution of our backend platform. You'll own the architecture of large-scale, distributed systems built on Java and microservices, set technical direction across teams, and raise the bar for resilience, scalability, and operational excellence. This role spans building new products from the ground up and scaling existing ones. It is hands-on technical leadership: you'll write code, drive design reviews, and mentor engineers while partnering with product and engineering leadership to shape the roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

* **Build products from 0 to 1**
  by turning ambiguous ideas into a clear architecture, shipping MVPs quickly, and evolving them into production-grade systems.
* **Architect and build**
  highly available, fault-tolerant microservices that scale to millions of requests and handle failure gracefully.
* **Set technical direction**
  for backend systems across multiple teams, authoring design docs and driving architectural decisions with clear trade-off analysis.
* **Champion resilience engineering**
  through patterns such as circuit breakers, bulkheads, retries with backoff, rate limiting, idempotency, and graceful degradation.
* **Drive scalability and performance**
  by identifying bottlenecks, optimizing JVM performance, and designing for horizontal scale, caching, and data partitioning.
* **Own operational excellence**
  , including observability (metrics, logging, tracing), SLOs/SLAs, incident response, and blameless postmortems.
* **Lead modernization efforts**
  , such as decomposing monoliths, adopting event-driven architectures, and reducing technical debt.
* **Mentor and grow engineers**
  through code reviews, design reviews, and technical coaching, building a strong engineering culture.
* **Influence cross-functionally**
  by partnering with product, SRE, security, and data teams to deliver customer outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

* 7+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on backend systems.
* Proven experience building at least one product or platform from 0 to 1, from concept through production launch.
* Expert-level proficiency in Java, including concurrency, memory management, and JVM tuning.
* Deep experience designing and operating microservices in production using frameworks such as Spring Boot or Micronaut.
* Proven track record of building resilient, scalable distributed systems serving high-traffic workloads.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency models, CAP trade-offs, partitioning, replication, and failure modes.
* Experience with RESTful and gRPC API design, plus asynchronous messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
* Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, Cassandra).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Exposure to agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain4j, Spring AI, LangGraph) and building LLM-powered features such as tool calling, RAG, and multi-agent workflows.
* Experience using AI coding assistants and AI tools to speed up development.
* Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS or GCP) and cloud-native design.
* Proficiency with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Experience with resilience libraries and practices such as Resilience4j, service mesh, and chaos engineering.
* Strong background in observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, Datadog).
* Experience with event-driven architecture, CQRS, event sourcing, and saga patterns.
* Track record of leading technical initiatives spanning multiple teams.
* Excellent written communication, especially design docs and architectural proposals.

In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for an innovative AI-Native DevSecOps Developer to rapidly design, build and ship custom software products that automate, orchestrate and modernize EY's infrastructure platform engineering capabilities. This is not a traditional software engineering role — it is a product builder position for someone who uses AI as their primary development accelerator and who thrives on shipping working software quickly.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-native internal products — self-service infrastructure portals, workflow orchestration engines, policy-as-code enforcement systems and operational automation platforms — built on modern cloud-native stacks including Kubernetes, Temporal, Terraform and Angular. They will have sufficient infrastructure awareness to understand the operational context of what they are building, and will work closely with I&O engineering teams to translate complex infrastructure workflows into elegant, automated, AI-augmented software solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer designs and delivers bespoke internal software products that eliminate manual infrastructure workflows, accelerate provisioning and give engineers and stakeholders real-time, self-service operational visibility. Drawing on AI coding tools as a core development accelerant, this professional dramatically compresses delivery timelines — prototyping, iterating and shipping production-grade software at a pace that traditional development workflows cannot match.
  
  
The role spans the full software development lifecycle — from requirements and architecture through build, test, security hardening, deployment and ongoing improvement — with a security-first mindset embedded at every stage. The developer will own the product delivery end-to-end, partnering with I&O platform engineers, architects and service management stakeholders to ensure what is built reflects the real operational needs of the infrastructure estate and is designed to scale across EY's global data center footprint.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade software rapidly using AI development tools as a primary delivery accelerant (exclusionary).
* Deep, active use of AI coding assistants throughout the development lifecycle, including:

+ GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI pair-programming tools
+ ChatGPT, Claude or similar LLMs for architecture design, code generation and review
+ AI-assisted test generation, security scanning and code refactoring
+ Prompt engineering for development workflow automation

* Strong full-stack development capability across front-end and back-end disciplines:

+ Angular (v14+) for self-service portal and operational UI development
+ Python or Go for back-end services, APIs and automation engines
+ REST and GraphQL API design and implementation

* Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, particularly Temporal.io.
* Strong Kubernetes engineering skills — deployment, Helm charts, operators, RBAC and namespace management.
* Infrastructure-as-Code authoring using Terraform and Ansible for provisioning automation.
* Strong DevSecOps pipeline development — CI/CD design, security gate integration and automated deployment:

+ GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines
+ SAST/DAST tooling integration (Snyk, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP or equivalent)
+ Container image scanning and policy enforcement (Trivy, Cosign, OPA/Gatekeeper)

* Policy-as-Code implementation using Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent.
* Experience building AI-native product features, including:

+ LLM integration via API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent)
+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns for operational knowledge bases
+ AI-driven workflow decision making and self-healing automation
+ Copilot / chat interface integration into operational tooling

* Sufficient infrastructure platform knowledge to design software that reflects real-world operational constraints:

+ Virtualization and hyperconverged infrastructure concepts (Nutanix, Hyper-V, VMware)
+ Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
+ Networking concepts — VLANs, DNS, IP management, load balancing
+ Storage and compute provisioning workflows
+ ServiceNow ITSM integration patterns

* Strong software product ownership mindset — able to take a problem statement from whiteboard to production with minimal hand-holding.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to demo working software and articulate product decisions to both technical and executive audiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.

**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**

* Full-stack software product development and delivery — 5–7 years.
* AI-assisted software development as an active daily workflow — 2+ years.
* Angular front-end application development (v14+) — 3–5 years.
* Python or Go back-end service development — 5+ years.
* Kubernetes cluster management and application deployment — 3–5 years.
* Terraform and Ansible Infrastructure-as-Code authoring — 3–5 years.
* Temporal.io or equivalent workflow orchestration platform (Argo, Conductor or equivalent).
* CI/CD pipeline development with integrated security gates — 3–5 years.
* LLM API integration for production AI-native product features.
* Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent policy-as-code enforcement.
* REST API design, development and documentation.
* Container build, scanning and secure image management (Docker, Podman).
* Git-based source control and pull-request-driven development workflows (GitHub, Azure DevOps).
* SAST/DAST security tooling integration in CI pipelines.
* ITSM platform integration — ServiceNow API or equivalent.
* Agile sprint-based delivery with regular demo and release cadences.
* Infrastructure provisioning workflow automation (VM builds, network configuration, DNS/IP management).
* Helm chart authoring for Kubernetes application packaging and deployment.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or equivalent cloud certification (desired).
* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) or CKA certification (better to have).
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification (desired).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience building on or integrating with Nutanix platform APIs (NCM, Prism, Calm).
* Experience with Temporal Cloud or self-hosted Temporal cluster operations.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio or Azure AI Studio for enterprise AI product development.
* Familiarity with GitOps patterns using ArgoCD or Flux for continuous deployment.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure automation projects.

**What We Look For**
A builder — someone who moves fast, thinks in systems and ships working software that solves real infrastructure problems. We are looking for an individual who genuinely uses AI as a development superpower, who understands enough about infrastructure to design software that works in the real world, and who takes pride in owning a product end-to-end from first commit to production. The ideal candidate has already built something like HCSP — a platform that replaces manual, multi-portal, error-prone operational workflows with a single automated, observable, self-healing system — and is ready to do it again at EY scale.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
**Who We Are**

* Create and customize forms, service catalogs, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, and Flow Designer workflows.
* Perform platform upgrades, enhancements, and issue resolution to maintain platform stability, performance, and functionality.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, analyze root causes, and implement effective fixes and improvements across the platform.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to gather requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver platform enhancements aligned to business priorities.
* Improve platform performance and support ongoing optimization of ServiceNow applications, configurations, and development practices.

**What You'll Need**

* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, ServiceNow scripting, and ServiceNow platform configuration.
* Experience with integrations, Service Catalog, Flow Designer, and API development.
* Experience developing, configuring, and maintaining ServiceNow applications and workflows.
* Familiarity with Agile development practices.
* ServiceNow CSA certification required.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

title: Scientific Computing / Research Engineering Expert — Earth Sciences
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking experienced Earth Sciences experts to develop realistic, terminal-based scientific and computational tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will design challenging scientific tasks involving climate science, atmospheric processes, geophysics, oceanography, geology, hydrology, remote sensing, and environmental modeling. You will build reproducible computational workflows that require AI agents to analyze scientific datasets, execute code, run simulations, troubleshoot technical issues, and generate objectively verifiable scientific outputs.

**What you'll do:**

* Design realistic, multi-step scientific tasks based on authentic Earth Sciences, climate, geospatial, environmental, and geophysical research workflows.
* Prepare and process scientific datasets involving climate, weather, atmospheric conditions, oceanography, geology, hydrology, satellite imagery, and environmental systems.
* Develop computational tasks involving geospatial analysis, time-series processing, numerical modeling, interpolation, forecasting, remote sensing, and environmental risk analysis.
* Build reproducible, terminal-based computational environments using scientific libraries, command-line tools, and appropriate dependencies.
* Develop expert reference solutions using Python, R, Bash, Julia, or domain-specific scientific software.
* Create automated tests and evaluation criteria to verify scientific correctness, numerical accuracy, spatial and temporal consistency, and reproducibility.
* Validate coordinate reference systems, measurement units, timestamps, missing-data handling, uncertainty, and scientific assumptions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues involving geospatial projections, large scientific datasets, software dependencies, computational performance, and numerical stability.
* Ensure tasks require meaningful multi-step scientific reasoning and cannot be solved through simple shortcuts or hard-coded outputs.
* Document dataset sources, computational workflows, expected outputs, edge cases, and scientific limitations.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Earth Sciences, Climate Science, Atmospheric Science, Geophysics, Oceanography, Geology, Hydrology, Environmental Science, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in Python, R, Bash, Julia, or another relevant scientific programming language.
* Hands-on experience working in Linux and terminal-based computational environments.
* Practical expertise in at least one major area: scientific data processing, numerical modeling, geospatial analysis, climate modeling, remote sensing, or environmental data analysis.
* Strong understanding of spatial datasets, time-series analysis, scientific modeling, numerical accuracy, uncertainty, and data quality control.
* Experience working with real-world scientific datasets, including geospatial, climate, atmospheric, oceanographic, geological, or hydrological data.
* Ability to independently develop, execute, debug, and validate reproducible scientific computational workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify scientific inaccuracies, data inconsistencies, and computational errors.
* Ability to design objective validation methods and clearly document technical solutions and scientific assumptions.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with scientific computing and geospatial libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, xarray, rasterio, GeoPandas, Cartopy, GDAL, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with scientific data formats such as NetCDF, HDF5, GeoTIFF, shapefiles, GRIB, and other geospatial or environmental data formats.
* Experience working with climate, weather, oceanographic, seismic, satellite, hydrological, or geological datasets.
* Familiarity with Docker, Conda, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience using high-performance computing (HPC) environments or processing large-scale scientific datasets.
* Experience with Earth-system models, environmental forecasting, remote sensing applications, or geophysical simulations.
* Research software engineering experience, including developing scientific tools, simulation pipelines, or reproducible research workflows.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, scientific benchmarks, or automated grading systems.
* Publications, research contributions, or open-source development experience in Earth or Environmental Sciences.
* Prior experience in AI training, scientific quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
