title: Solutions Architect
description:
Role Overview

* Role: Solution & Integration Architect
* Team: Technology
* Reporting to: Global CTO
* Location: Mumbai or Delhi, India
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Experience: Typically 8–12+ years, including at least 3 years in solution architecture or a technical leadership role.

Role Purpose

The Solution & Integration Architect is responsible for designing scalable enterprise solutions and seamless integrations between a digital property decisioning platform and banks’ existing technology systems.

The role acts as a technical bridge between customers, Product, Engineering, IT Operations and leadership, ensuring that business requirements are translated into practical, secure, and buildable technical solutions. It involves hands-on API design, troubleshooting, customer engagement, and end-to-end integration delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Architecture

* Lead technical discovery and architecture workshops with banking customers.
* Design solution architectures, application components, data flows, security, and non-functional requirements.
* Maintain architecture documentation, decision records, risks, and dependencies.
* Promote reusable solutions and minimise customer-specific development.

2. API and Integration Design

* Design and document REST APIs, webhooks, callbacks, event-driven integrations, and secure file transfers.
* Develop API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger, including payloads, validation, error handling, versioning, retries, and idempotency.
* Define authentication, authorisation, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Work with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure API Management, Service Bus, Functions, and App Services.
* Troubleshoot integration issues using logs, API traces, and monitoring tools.

3. Requirements Definition

* Work with Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and customers to gather requirements.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications, API contracts, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and technical constraints.
* Support backlog refinement, estimation, prioritisation discussions, and solution feasibility assessments.

4. Customer Integration Delivery

* Act as the primary technical contact for bank integration teams and third-party vendors.
* Coordinate connectivity, certificates, whitelisting, environments, and security approvals.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, go-live, and post-launch support.
* Ensure integrations are properly documented and handed over to Support and IT Operations.

5. Security and Compliance

* Ensure designs meet banking security requirements and enterprise security standards.
* Address data protection, encryption, data residency, audit logging, and retention requirements.
* Support security assessments and compliance reviews involving RBI guidance, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, and CERT-In requirements.

6. Architecture Standards and Continuous Improvement

* Develop reusable architecture patterns, integration templates, and API standards.
* Improve onboarding efficiency across multiple banking customers.
* Capture implementation lessons and collaborate with global architecture, Product, and Engineering teams.

Essential Skills and Experience

* Enterprise solution architecture and integration design, preferably in banking or financial services.
* Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON, and XML.
* OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, mutual TLS, certificates, and API security.
* Microsoft Azure integration services and API management.
* Event-driven messaging, webhooks, callbacks, batch processing, and SFTP.
* API versioning, retries, timeouts, error handling, and idempotency.
* Experience integrating with loan origination systems, loan management systems, core banking platforms, document management systems, and bank middleware.
* Understanding of banking network security, release governance, SIT, and UAT.
* Experience writing technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

* .NET or Java development experience.
* Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Experience working with Indian public sector banks.
* Knowledge of Finacle, TCS BaNCS, Oracle FLEXCUBE, or similar core banking platforms.
* Familiarity with RBI regulations, data protection, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
* TOGAF or other architecture frameworks.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, and integration monitoring tools.

Key Success Metrics

Performance will be measured by:

* Quality and completeness of solution designs and API specifications.
* Clear, testable requirements with minimal engineering rework.
* Successful integration delivery through SIT, UAT, and production go-live.
* Reduction in integration defects and troubleshooting time.
* Reuse of common APIs, templates, and integration patterns.
* Positive feedback from banking technology and security teams.
* Accurate documentation and effective handover to operational teams.
* Reliable technical commitments aligned with platform capabilities.

title: Electrical Engineering & Computer Science
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks.
* Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability.
* Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results.
* Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design.
* Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles.
* Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm.
* Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions.
* Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions.
* Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

The Splunk Agent Resilience team is defining the future of AI resilience. Together our team provides scalable, cost-effective evaluation and guardrails that ensure AI agents behave as intended, improving reliability and reducing risks. This unified approach empowers our customers to expertly deploy and manage AI-powered applications with enhanced observability and control.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation to help some of the world's largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. You'll partner closely with external customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with internal Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, You Will**

* Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
* Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
* Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
* Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of strong software engineering experience building production-grade applications.
* Experience with APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or backend development.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, cursor, etc.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.
* Experience building customer-facing technical solutions or integrations.
* Experience creating reusable developer tools, frameworks, or open-source contributions.
* Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.
* Experience with programming language such as python, Java, etc.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

title: Data/Integration Engineer
description:
We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Data Integration Engineer to lead offshore data engineering delivery for a US-based investment management client.

You’ll own ingestion and transformation delivery on Fivetran, Snowflake and dbt, and coordinate MDM, reporting and platform work with the onshore architect and project manager.

**What you’ll do**

• Own offshore data engineering estimates, task allocation, dependencies, progress reporting and delivery commitments

• Build and maintain Fivetran ingestion and approved file/API pipelines; manage incremental loads, schema changes, failed loads and recovery

• Develop Snowflake Bronze, Silver and Gold datasets and modular dbt models with documented dependencies

• Implement source-to-target mappings, reconciliation, incremental processing, historical data handling and dimensional models

• Own pipeline data quality through dbt tests, completeness and freshness checks, and remediation tracking

• Review code and designs across the offshore team and enforce engineering standards

• Coordinate Snowflake and Profisee data flows with the MDM engineer, and trusted reporting datasets with the BI engineer

• Maintain technical metadata, documentation and lineage

• Coordinate integration testing, defect resolution, deployment readiness and production handover

**What you bring**

• 8+ years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading delivery teams

• Strong SQL, Snowflake data engineering, dbt development and Fivetran ingestion

• At least two production data platform implementations delivered, including source reconciliation and operational handover

• dbt models, tests, documentation, incremental strategies, Git workflows and performance tuning

• Working knowledge of MDM integration patterns, data governance controls and Power BI data requirements

• Strong written and verbal communication and ownership of assigned work

**Nice to have:**
 financial services or investment data (customer, account, advisor, sales), Profisee, Dynamics 365 integrations, Python, Azure DevOps, Snowflake or dbt certification, consulting or SI delivery experience.

* Overlap with US Central business hours is required.

title: Software Development Engineer -1
description:
**About Mechademy**

Mechademy is transforming the predictive analytics landscape for rotating machinery. Our flagship platform, Turbomechanica, seamlessly integrates applied physics with advanced machine learning to deliver prescriptive insights. Turbomechanica detects potential issues long before they become costly failures, enabling clients to maximize uptime, extend asset life, and reduce operational risks. By empowering clients with optimized performance and reliability of their multi-billion-dollar assets, we’re setting a new standard for operational excellence.

**What We’re Looking For**

People who would rather build than talk about building. You’ll fit right in if you:

* Like owning a problem end to end, from the first design note to production.
* Pick up new tools quickly, and have opinions about which ones we should use.
* Care about getting things right, because engineers make real decisions on what we build.
* Enjoy a small, energetic team that ships fast and celebrates its wins.

**Why Mechademy?**

Kickstart your career with a company that’s fun, innovative, and shaping the future of the oil and gas industry. Mechademy is where cutting-edge predictive analytics meets a culture of collaboration and creativity. We’re not your typical start-up company – we thrive on solving complex challenges with technology, fostering growth, and making an impact. Whether you're diving into groundbreaking projects, learning from industry leaders, or enjoying team outings, you’ll feel valued and inspired every step of the way.

•
**Work on groundbreaking technology**
that is shaping the future of rotating equipment diagnostics.

•
**Relish a challenging, dynamic role**
with opportunities for individual contributions that direct impact on the success of the company.

•
**Grow into a leadership position**
as Mechademy grows.

•
**Enjoy flexible work hours**
to work when you are most efficient.

•
**Generous compensation**
to help you achieve financial stability.

At Mechademy, your ideas matter, your growth is our priority, and your future starts now.

**About the Role**

An unplanned trip of a single critical machine can halt production at an entire facility. Turbomechanica exists to see that coming, and the team makes sure the right people see it, trust it and act on it in time. You do not need an industrial or mechanical background. Our domain engineers will teach you how turbines and compressors fail.

**Responsibilities**

* **Platform -**
  Design, build and own features on a secure, multi-tenant platform used by enterprise clients across the globe. Work on authentication, access control and auditability, web and mobile experiences, and APIs that let other systems work with platform data safely.
* **Monitoring -**
  Build the workflows that turn detected issues into alerts, escalations and tracked actions, and the tooling that helps engineers prioritise, investigate and resolve issues faster. Work with large volumes of time series sensor data.
* **Reliability -**
  Add alerting, health checks and dashboards so we catch problems before a client does.
* **Engineering Quality -**
  Write clean, tested code and own features from design through production. Write design notes, take part in design and code reviews, and document what you build.
* **Ways of Working -**
  Ship in two-week sprints using Git, GitHub, CI/CD and ClickUp. Use modern developer tooling, including AI coding assistants, while staying accountable for every line you merge.

**Requirements**

**Must Have**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related branch
* 1.5+ years building and shipping production software
* Strong Python (preferred), or Java, Go, TypeScript or similar; solid DSA and OOP fundamentals
* REST APIs with Django, FastAPI, Flask, Express or similar
* SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL
* JavaScript or TypeScript, React preferred
* Web authentication basics (sessions, tokens, OAuth) and secure coding
* Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD
* Clear communication and a real willingness to learn and take feedback
* LLM APIs (Claude and other leading models), Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG and agent orchestration frameworks

**Good to Have**

* Open source work or side projects you can discuss in depth
* Interest or experience in applied machine learning or LLMs
* Multi-tenant SaaS systems
* Time series data or large datasets
* Mobile app development
* SSO / OIDC providers, role-based access control
* Docker, AWS or Azure in production; logging, monitoring and alerting tools
* Mentoring peers, writing clear design docs

**What This Role Offers**

* **Work that matters -**
  What you build runs in production every day at some of the world’s largest energy companies.
* **Hard, real problems -**
  Security, multi-tenancy, large-scale sensor data and systems engineers depend on.
* **Ownership -**
  A squad buddy gets you productive in 30 days; you own a part of the platform within 6 months.
* **Mentorship -**
  Learn from senior engineers and domain experts with decades of equipment experience.
* **Growth -**
  A clear path from SDE-1 to SDE-2.
* **Flexibility -**
  Flexible work hours and a hybrid setup.

**Selection Process**

1. Introductory call - A short conversation with our talent team about your background, interests and expectations.
2. Technical interview 1 - Problem solving and live coding, plus a deep dive into a project you have shipped.
3. Technical interview 2 - System design and full stack fundamentals: APIs, data modelling, scaling and trade-offs.
4. Hiring manager - A conversation with the P&M Squad Owner about how you work, own problems and grow.
5. HR and culture - Team fit, compensation and joining logistics.

*No trick puzzles. When you apply, tell us about something you have shipped. That matters more to us than where you have worked.*

title: Senior Software Development Engineer

**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
As a Senior Software Development Engineer L4, you independently work through complex engineering tasks and apply strong software engineering fundamentals to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable software. You contribute as a senior member of the team by partnering with engineers and product management throughout the software development life cycle, from design and estimation through testing, deployment, and support. In this role, you help improve team delivery by producing high quality code, strengthening engineering practices, and supporting secure, compliant software development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Write high quality, testable code that meets team commitments and the Definition of Done.
* Design, implement, unit test, and validate software solutions by following defined engineering processes and software development life cycle practices.
* Apply a test-first approach to software development where possible, and create automated unit, system, and acceptance tests to support quality and reliability.
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and test plan reviews with other engineers to improve software quality, scalability, and maintainability.
* Support assigned integration, testing, and deployment activities to ensure successful delivery of software products and enhancements.
* Partner with product management to scope, estimate, and refine product enhancements and technical work.
* Troubleshoot and fix internal and customer-reported software defects by following defined processes and debugging best practices.
* Contribute to end of iteration demos, retrospectives, and continuous improvement efforts by identifying team impediments and helping resolve them.
* Write and maintain documentation covering program development, logic, code changes, testing, corrections, and related technical details.
* Participate in change management and on-call rotation responsibilities, including support for critical issues outside standard business hours in accordance with defined service expectations.

**What You'll Need**

* Minimum 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, and with data structures and algorithms; plus 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Advanced design, debugging, and coding skills.
* Ability to build secure applications and adhere to security standards.
* Strong understanding of software testing, scalability, and core software engineering principles.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
The database market is massive (IDC estimates it to be $121B+ by 2026!) and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.
  
  
MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to create tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Staff Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The ideal candidate for this role will have
  
  

* 8+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
* Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium
* Extensive experience with relational data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc)
* Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus
* Empower the engineering team with unparalleled thought leadership on emerging technologies and best practices
* Proactively engage with product leaders and senior management to align technical solutions with overarching business strategies
* Mentor and guide junior and senior engineers on best practices in data structures, algorithms, and database design
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall technical direction and roadmap of the team
* Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Position Expectations
  
  

* Architectural Leadership: Drive the architectural vision and technical strategy for the data migration engine and its surrounding ecosystem. Contribute core, foundational code that solves the hardest scalability problems and sets the standard for the rest of the team
* Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Engineering Leadership, Product Management, and Design to shape the technical roadmap. Anticipate future business needs and translate them into scalable, long-term technical initiatives
* Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Define and champion engineering best practices, patterns, and standards across multiple teams. Actively mentor Senior and Mid-level engineers, cultivating a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning

Success Measures
  
  
Within the first three months, you will have:
  
  

* Familiarise yourself with the MongoDB database and aggregation language
* Familiarise yourself with the problem space and the domain
* Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
* Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews

Within six months, you will have:
  
  

* Worked on and delivered a large-scale code analysis feature in the product
* Contributed to and helped deliver a few releases of the product
* Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within 12 months, you will have:
  
  

* Delivered large-scale features across our entire tech stack
* Helped recruit, interview and mentor new members of the team
* Collaborated with other teams at MongoDB

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Software Engineer 2
description:
**The role**

An SDE 2 at CareFi owns problems, not tickets. You will take a business outcome, work out what needs to be built, design it, ship it, and stay accountable for how it behaves in production.

This is a backend-leaning role on a small team, which means your work will show up in front of hospital staff, ops teams and borrowers within weeks. You will have real say in architecture, and real responsibility when something breaks at 11pm on a discharge that has to clear tonight.

**What you will own**

- Design and deliver backend services end to end: scoping, data modelling, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and the fixes that follow

- Write a lightweight design doc for anything that spans more than one service or one engineer, and get it reviewed before you build

- Model and evolve financial and claims data correctly. Ledgers, disbursements, repayments and reconciliation have to be right the first time, and auditable afterwards

- Build and maintain integrations with hospitals, insurers, payment providers and logistics partners, including the messy ones with no sandbox and a PDF for documentation

- Raise technical risk, feasibility concerns and scope creep before work starts rather than in the retro

- Review code substantively. Explain the reasoning behind a change request, not just the change

- Mentor SDE 1s and interns through pairing, intentional PR reviews, and unblocking them early

- Own incidents in your domain: triage, mitigate, write the post-incident review, close the action items

- Identify tech debt in the areas you touch and propose a concrete fix alongside the flag

- Keep the documentation for your systems current after every release

**What we work with**

- Backend: NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL

- Cloud and infra: Azure (AKS), containerised services, GitLab CI/CD

- Adjacent: React Native and Flutter clients, OCR and document extraction pipelines, internal ops tooling

- Ways of working: sprint-based delivery, design docs, PR review culture, blameless post-incident reviews. You do not need prior NestJS experience. Strong Node and TypeScript fundamentals transfer in a week or two.

**What we are looking for**

- 5 to 7 years building and running backend systems in production, with at least 3 years in a typed language on a modern service framework (Node/TypeScript, Java, Go, Python)

- Strong relational database skills: schema design, indexing, query performance, transactions and isolation levels. You can explain why a migration is safe under load

- Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of at least one non-trivial system or service, including what it cost you to operate it

- Practical experience with API design, third party integrations, idempotency, retries and failure handling

- Comfort with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD. You can deploy, observe and debug your own service without waiting for someone else

- Testing as a default habit, not a compliance step

- Clear written communication. Design docs, PR descriptions and incident notes are part of the job

- Evidence of lifting other engineers: mentoring, reviews, standards, or documentation people actually use

title: Dynamics 365 CCaaS Developer
description:
Dynamics 365 CCaaS Developer — Job Description

\*\*Experience- 3–5 Years

\*\*Employment Type- Full-Time

\*\*Location- Delhi (Onsite)

About the Role

Today, complaint and service intake is fragmented: Facilities Management runs its call centre on plain telephony with no caller ID or history lookup, and all in-unit tenant work is tracked through messaging groups and spreadsheets rather than any system of record. We are hiring a Dynamics 365 CCaaS Developer to help close that gap — building the contact-centre, IVR, omnichannel and case-routing capability that sits behind Dynamics 365 Customer Service, so that a call, chat or WhatsApp message from a tenant, owner or vendor becomes a tracked case, routed to the right desk (Facilities, Leasing or Sales), the same way a preventive-maintenance job already flows automatically today.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, configure and build contact-centre solutions on Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Omnichannel for Customer Service, covering voice, chat and WhatsApp channels.
* Integrate the CCaaS/telephony platform with Dynamics 365 via CTI, so inbound calls resolve caller identity and case history automatically instead of being keyed by hand.

title: Databricks AI & Power BI Reporting Developer
description:
**Databricks AI & Power BI Reporting Developer**

**Experience: 4–7 Years**

**Primary Skills**

Databricks, AI/Analytics Reporting, Power BI, SQL, Python, PySpark, AWS

**Role Overview**

The Data Engineer – Databricks AI & Power BI Reporting Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data solutions, analytical reporting, and AI-enabled insights using Databricks, Power BI, and AWS. The ideal candidate should have 4–7 years of relevant experience in data engineering, Databricks-based analytics and reporting, and Power BI report development. The candidate must have strong hands-on experience in developing interactive Power BI dashboards, transforming and analyzing data in Databricks, and building scalable data pipelines to support business intelligence and AI-driven reporting requirements. The role involves close collaboration with business stakeholders, data engineers, data architects, analytics teams, and implementation partners to deliver reliable, high-quality, and performance-optimized reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI reports, dashboards, and visualizations to meet business and analytical requirements.
* Develop and optimize Databricks notebooks, SQL queries, and data transformation workflows using Python, PySpark, and Spark SQL.
* Build and maintain data pipelines using AWS and Databricks to support reporting, analytics, and AI-related use cases.
* Prepare, transform, validate, and integrate data from multiple source systems for reporting and analysis.
* Implement and maintain Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers using Databricks and Delta Lake.
* Develop efficient data models, relationships, measures, and calculated columns using Power BI and DAX.
* Connect Power BI to Databricks and other data sources to deliver accurate, reliable, and timely business insights.
* Work with AI/ML-enabled analytics and reporting capabilities in Databricks to support predictive insights and advanced analytics, where required.
* Perform data profiling, reconciliation, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure report accuracy and data quality.
* Optimize Power BI dashboards, DAX calculations, data models, SQL queries, and Databricks workloads for performance and scalability.
* Implement data refresh schedules, incremental refresh, and appropriate reporting security, including row-level security where required.
* Support data governance, metadata, lineage, and access management activities using Databricks Unity Catalog and related tools.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and validate report outputs.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, CI/CD, and production support.
* Prepare technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer to internal teams.

Required Skills

* 4–7 years of relevant experience in Databricks analytics/reporting, Power BI development, data engineering, or a closely related role.
* Strong hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
* Strong knowledge of Power BI data modeling, DAX, Power Query, and report performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks notebooks, Databricks SQL, and data transformation.
* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, analysis, and validation.
* Experience with Python, PySpark, and Apache Spark.
* Experience integrating Power BI with Databricks and other enterprise data sources.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, data quality, and data reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and cloud-based data platforms.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with Databricks AI capabilities and AI-assisted analytics or reporting.
* Knowledge of Databricks Mosaic AI, AI/BI capabilities, or machine learning integration for analytics use cases.
* Experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Lakehouse architecture.
* Experience with AWS services used in data engineering and analytics.
* Knowledge of Tableau or other BI and visualization platforms.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and security.
* Databricks or Microsoft Power BI certifications.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will combine strong Databricks data and analytics expertise with hands-on Power BI report development skills. The candidate should be capable of preparing reliable data in Databricks, building effective analytical data models, and delivering interactive dashboards that help business stakeholders make informed decisions.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Sirion**
Sirion is the world’s leading
**AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform**
. Global enterprises use Sirion to author, negotiate, manage, and extract value from their contracts, using generative AI for extraction, conversational search, and AI-assisted negotiation. With more than 7 million contracts and close to $800B in contract value under management, Sirion is recognized as a leader by Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters.
  
  
**Power the Future of AI & Why This Role Matters**
We are looking for an
**AI Automation Engineer**
with
**4–6 years of Python development experience**
and hands-on experience building
**AI-powered and agentic automation solutions**
. The ideal candidate combines strong Python backend skills with practical knowledge of
**LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and workflow orchestration**
.
  
  
As part of Sirion’s Automation team, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent automations in which AI agents reason over contracts and business data, call APIs and tools, and execute multi-step processes end-to-end, with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Design, develop, and deploy agentic AI automations that use LLMs, tool/function calling, memory, and multi-step reasoning to automate business processes end-to-end.
* Build agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.
* Build AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, documents, web applications, and external tools.
* Design and implement RAG-based solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Integrate OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs into production systems, including prompt engineering and structured outputs.
* Develop scalable backend services and APIs in Python using FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST Framework.
* Build human-in-the-loop checkpoints, guardrails, and error-handling/retry logic so automations run reliably in production.
* Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows where required.
* Evaluate agent quality, accuracy, latency, and cost; monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize automations in production.
* Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis.
* Deploy and maintain solutions using Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* Write clean, maintainable, testable, production-ready Python code.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Stay current with developments in Generative AI and Agentic AI.

**Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table**
**Python & Backend Development**

* 4–6 years of professional experience in Python development.
* Strong understanding of OOP, data structures, exception handling, and concurrency (asyncio/threading).
* Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Django REST Framework.
* Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs.
* Good understanding of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL); MongoDB/Redis experience preferred.

**Agentic AI / GenAI**

* Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept.
* Understanding of agentic AI architecture, including planning, tool use, memory, and autonomous multi-step workflows.
* Experience with one or more agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Experience with tool/function calling and integrating external APIs and tools with LLMs.
* Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent.
* Good understanding of prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations.
* Experience building multi-agent systems.

**Cloud & DevOps**

* Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with logging, monitoring, debugging, and production deployments.

**Education & Soft Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with RPA or workflow automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or n8n.
* Experience with document AI: extracting and processing data from PDFs, contracts, or other unstructured documents.
* Exposure to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Experience with task and message queues such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka.
* Experience with Kubernetes.
* Experience working with open-source/local LLMs and Hugging Face models.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost optimization.
* Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

**What We Are Looking For**
The ideal candidate is
**strong in Python backend development and has built real AI/agentic automation solutions**
, not just theoretical knowledge of Generative AI. Candidates should be able to demonstrate projects that combine
**LLMs + tools/APIs + orchestration + backend services**
, preferably deployed in production.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law, and we provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. These principles apply across all of our employment practices.
  
  
**Excited About This Opportunity?**
We’d love to hear from you! Apply through the
**Sirion Careers page**
and follow the steps listed there.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Autofills Coverage)
description: Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that “we are all in this together” – we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog.As a Senior Software Engineer on the Autofills side of this team, yyou will help make autofill work reliably on the sites people actually use, and keep it fast and unobtrusive as the product evolves. Autofill is the Bitwarden capability that fills logins, payment details, and identities into web forms across browsers. The Autofill Coverage team maintains and expands a curated dataset of site-specific autofill rules, builds automation that continuouslychecks autofill across popular websites, and builds lab-based measurement of autofill’s performance in the browser. Every engineer on the team works across all of this, so we value curiosity and range over a perfect match to any single tool. This is a hands-on role.You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code, alongside your teammates and in close partnership with the wider Autofill team.WHAT YOU WILL DOEnd-to-End Delivery & Ownership: Own substantial pieces of the team’s work from design through production: the site-specific rule dataset and its tooling, theautomation that continuously checks autofill on real websites and turns failures into fixes, and the benchmarking harness that measures autofill’s performance impact and responsiveness. Stay with your work once it is live.Automation at Scale: Design browser automation that runs reliably against real, constantly changing websites. Handle flakiness, dynamic content, and anti-bot measures, and turn results into actionable signal rather than noise.Performance Measurement: Build and improve lab-based benchmarks that measure how autofill affects page responsiveness, rendering, and memory. Treat measurement as engineering: control noise, question surprising numbers, and make sure a metric means what it claims before anyone acts on it.Engineering Standards and Automated Quality: Build and maintain the validation, versioning, and CI checks that catch bad data and misleading results before they ship. Review teammates’ pull requests with care and invite the same scrutiny of your own. Keep documentation and contribution guidance in our open source repositories clear.Decoupled Architecture and Service Boundaries: Design the dataset so it can evolve independently of client release cycles, with backward compatibility across supported client versions. Keep test and measurement tooling cleanly separated from the product code it exercises.Technical Mentorship: Pair on hard problems, share what you learn, and help SDETs and newer engineers find their footing in a security-sensitive codebase.AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants effectively in daily engineering and exercise judgement about where they help and where they do not. Build assistive tooling that speeds up rule authoring, with a human always reviewing and approving the result.Operational Stewardship: Triage autofill defects from support, internal reports, automated checks, and benchmarks. Fix what belongs to the team and route the rest to the right owner with clear attribution.Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration: Partner closely with the Autofill team, Product, Security, and SDET teammates to design and validate solutions before implementation begins.WHAT YOU BRING Overall Experience: 5–9 years building and operating production software, with a track record of owning substantial, technically demanding work end to end as an individual contributor.Technical Stack: We hire for strength and mindset, not an exact tool match. You should be strong in at least one of browser automation or front-end performance, and keen to grow into the other.Expertise – TypeScript or JavaScript, and Node.js – The DOM, HTML forms, and CSS selectors, including how real-world pages diverge from spec – Browser automation with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Cypress, or front-end performance analysis with Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, and Core Web Vitals – CI/CD with GitHub Actions or a similar platformExperience – Shell scripting and Docker – Data validation with JSON Schema or similar, and maintaining versioned datasets or configuration – Reading performance data: percentiles, run-to-run variation, and telling a real regression from noise – Dashboards and alerting with Datadog, Grafana/Prometheus, New Relic, or similar – AI-assisted development, preferably Claude CodeFamiliarity – Browser internals such as rendering, garbage collection, the Chrome DevTools Protocol, and Performance APIs (PerformanceObserver, Long Tasks, User Timing) – Browser extension architecture (Manifest V3, content scripts, extension messaging) – Front-end frameworks and tooling such as Lit, React, RxJS, and webpackT-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Depth in one area and genuine range across others. You ask why, not just what; you treat a flaky test or a surprising number as something to understand rather than hide; and you pick up new tools quickly.Practical experience with containerized environments, automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.Secure Coding: Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards, and threat-modeling methodologies, and an understanding of why vetted, human-authored rules and heuristic-based autofill carry different security postures.Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops.Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet.Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions.Why Join UsThis is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world.If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.Equal Opportunity EmployerWe are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

**About Team**
 The CRM Technologies Team plays a critical role in optimizing our sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce and Quote\-to\-Cash technologies, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, and operational support needed to effectively manage quoting, pricing, approvals, and downstream business processes.
   

  

 With deep expertise in Salesforce development, CPQ, integrations, and platform operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM ecosystem to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Deal Desk, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Quote\-to\-Cash solutions.

 We are looking for a CPQ Engineer III to design, build, and support core capabilities in our Configure–Price–Quote (CPQ) stack that power how our GTM teams sell and price MongoDB offerings. As a senior individual contributor, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of features across configuration, pricing, discounting, approvals, and quote generation, working closely with Product, Deal Strategy, RevOps, and Sales.
   

  

 You will translate business requirements into high\-quality technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ and related platforms, spanning configuration, custom development (Apex/LWC/Flows), and integrations with downstream systems. This role is hands\-on and delivery\-focused: you will be responsible for implementing well\-structured, testable solutions, improving performance and reliability of existing CPQ flows, and contributing to shared patterns, frameworks, and best practices within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering team.
   

  

 What you’ll do

**Minimum Requirements**

* 6\+ years of Salesforce development experience, including strong hands\-on expertise in the Salesforce platform

* Hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and REST/SOAP APIs

* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, and implementation best practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s CPQ implementation, product and pricing structure, Quote\-to\-Cash flows, and stakeholder processes.
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver meaningful enhancements across Salesforce CPQ, support key pricing and quoting workflows, and become a dependable contributor to ongoing QTC initiatives.
* In 12 months, you will: Become a trusted technical SME for Salesforce CPQ and related Quote\-to\-Cash processes, helping drive scalable improvements across pricing, approvals, renewals, amendments, and downstream integrations.

title: Sr. Implementation Consultant - CCAAS (AMER shift)
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions.  6 PM IST to 3 AM IST
   

  

 The

* You proactively elevate the implementation practice by sharing knowledge, defining standards, and fostering innovation.

**We focus on our mission**

Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**

title: Senior Performance Advertising Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a results\-oriented Senior Performance Advertising Engineer to own and drive the optimization of our buyer\-side and performance marketing systems. In this role, you will be directly responsible for designing algorithms, building data systems, and refining optimization loops that drive Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for our Advertisers and Agencies.You will own the technical architecture and end\-to\-end evaluation, implementation, and scaling of robust data pipelines for attribution data. This position spans our complete omnichannel environment, requiring expert\-level performance engine development across Mobile App (including privacy\-aware frameworks like SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox), Video, Connected TV (CTV),and Desktop environments.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* ROAS Optimization \& Algorithmic Design: Develop, benchmark, and deploy real\-time bidding (RTB) algorithms, pacing controls, and predictive models aimed squarely at maximizing ROAS and conversion tracking across all screens (CTV, Mobile App, Video, and Desktop).
* Attribution Data Pipelines: Design, evaluate, and implement scalable, low\-latency streaming and batch data pipelines that ingest, validate, and process complex conversion and multi\-touch attribution (MTA) datasets.
* Omnichannel Execution: Advance PubMatic’s performance capabilities across specific programmatic formats.
* Mobile: Build robust mechanisms that thrive within SKAdNetwork, Attribution API, and Android Privacy Sandbox constraints.
* CTV \& Video: Implement precise cross\-device graph integrations, household\-level frequency capping, and server\-to\-server attribution systems.
* Desktop: Innovate alternative identity framework integrations (e.g., UID2, LiveRamp ATS) to sustain high attribution fidelity post\-third\-party cookies.
* Data Pipeline Evaluation: Constantly audit existing data ingestion points for architectural flaws, data loss, or systemic latencies that negatively skew attribution accuracy and campaign performance.
* Scalable Systems Engineering: Write high\-performance, low\-latency, and memory\-efficient code (Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+) matching our ultra\-scaled backend layer that processes trillions of monthly events.


**We'd Love For You To Have**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience focusing on performance advertising, programmatic bidding, or large\-scale user\-conversion optimization loops.
* Attribution Domain Expertise: Demonstrated track record of evaluating and implementing multi\-touch attribution (MTA), last\-touch attribution (LTA), or incrementality testing frameworks in a production environment.
* Data Engineering \& Scale: Hands\-on experience engineering pipelines handling terabyte\-to\- petabyte scale data via distributed frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Kafka, and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Format Versatility: Strong technical familiarity with technical specs supporting Mobile App (IDFA/GAID loss mitigations), CTV (App Transport Security, IFA standards), and Desktop environments.
* Deep understanding of the OpenRTB protocol, DSP/SSP mechanics, and supply\-path optimization (SPO).
* Experience deploying production\-grade Machine Learning frameworks for CTR/CVR prediction.
* Strong system\-level performance benchmarking skills (profiling memory allocation, reducing I/O bottlenecks.


**Qualification**
 Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.
