title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

description:
**Description**
 Help shape the future of AI\-powered creative production at Amazon. As a GenAI Design Technologist, you will pioneer the intersection of Generative AI and creative production \- shipping tools and workflows that transform how product images and videos are created at scale.
   

  

 We are operationalizing Generative AI for visual content creation. This team partners with world\-class artists and scientists to push what's possible with image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal AI systems. You will work at the rare intersection where creative craft meets technical depth.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production\-grade visual content
* Act as the bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering \- translating artistic intent into scalable technical solutions
* Build automation that removes bottlenecks and enables content creators to focus on what they do best
* Evaluate emerging foundational models and translate the latest research breakthroughs into production\-ready capabilities
* Partner with engineers and scientists on prompt engineering frameworks and centralized GenAI tooling


 This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver \- someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services
* Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering \- translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions
* Build and maintain automation scripts and tools that resolve workflow bottlenecks, improve content quality, and increase creator productivity
* Evaluate AI\-generated output for visual quality, brand consistency, and production readiness \- applying both technical metrics and creative judgment
* Support the fine\-tuning, testing, and evaluation of foundational models and LLMs for image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal content creation
* Design and implement prompt engineering frameworks that enable consistent, high\-quality results at scale across content types
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists to contribute to a centralized suite of GenAI tools used across visual content workflows
* Research and prototype emerging Generative AI capabilities \- assessing production viability and recommending adoption paths to creative leadership
* Develop batch processing solutions and content pipelines that enable teams to generate, review, and publish AI\-created assets efficiently
* Document workflows, best practices, and technical specifications to enable partner teams to adopt generative workflows independently
* Participate in cross\-functional reviews to align AI tooling development with evolving creative standards and business requirements


 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, you will move between creative and technical work. You might review AI\-generated image outputs \-tuning prompts and parameters to improve quality and consistency. Then shift to prototyping a workflow with a creative lead and ML engineer, translating a creative brief into a scalable technical solution. You could also be evaluating a new foundational model for production readiness or helping a partner team adopt your automation pipeline. Throughout it all, you will collaborate closely with creative directors, applied scientists, and content producers \- solving the gap between what AI can technically generate and what meets the visual quality bar at scale.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team builds how hundreds of millions of customers see products \- through photography, video, CGI, and increasingly through Generative AI. We are a global network of creatives, technologists, and scientists unified by one mission: make every product look its best, at extraordinary scale. Our culture values builders who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. We ship fast, learn from what breaks, and believe the best creative work happens when art and technology push each other forward.

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
* 3\+ years of experience in front\-end technology, engineering, or UX prototyping
* Coding samples in front\-end programming languages
* Available online portfolio demonstrating relevant work
* Experience with web, mobile web, or mobile app front\-end development
* Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users
* Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large\-scale computing environments
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques for content generation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of technologies such as JavaScript/Node.js, HTML/CSS, Responsive/Adaptive Design
* Knowledge of Python, JavaScript, and source control (Git)
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team
* Knowledge of video production, live streaming technologies, studio workflows, edit and post\-production techniques, production calendars and staffing

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. title: Software Development Engineer II, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, implement, and deploy software solutions that improve quality, performance, and customer experience across major portions of your team's systems.
* Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross\-functional peers to understand business needs and deliver the right technical solutions, balancing short\-term priorities with long\-term architectural goals.
* Actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback to teammates at all levels, and mentor engineers on best practices for producing high\-quality, maintainable code.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's operational processes and reliability.
* Evaluate and integrate generative artificial intelligence tools where appropriate to augment productivity and code quality, applying responsible practices to refine outputs.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will start your morning reviewing pull requests and providing constructive feedback to teammates, then shift into designing a new feature that addresses a customer pain point. Afternoons might find you pairing with another engineer to troubleshoot a production issue, documenting your system's architecture for new team members, or evaluating a new approach that could simplify an existing workflow. You will regularly engage with product and engineering partners to align on priorities and share progress.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly serves Amazon's customers. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and an inclusive environment where every voice is heard. As we invest in new capabilities and modernize existing systems, you will play a key role in shaping our technical direction and mentoring the next generation of engineers on the team.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.

**About Us \& Our Mission**
 At our core, we are a fast\-growing, product\-driven technology company building mission\-critical B2B SaaS solutions for global supply chain logistics and high\-throughput fintech settlement rails. Our platform ingests millions of data points every single hour, runs complex vector searches, and powers real\-time enterprise dashboards relied upon by thousands of business\-critical users worldwide.
   

  

 However, we firmly believe that external product velocity is directly bottlenecked by internal engineering efficiency. As our engineering organization scales rapidly across multiple squads—spanning backend microservices, data warehousing, machine learning, and frontend interfaces—maintaining developer velocity, standardization, and infrastructure reliability becomes our biggest operational leverage. We are building a dedicated Platform Engineering function to create a world\-class Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that treats developers as our primary "users." If you are passionate about building abstractions, automating cloud infrastructure, and eliminating cognitive friction so engineers can ship secure code with a single click, you will find your ultimate engineering home with us.
   

  

 The Role \& Impact
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary, hands\-on
 **Platform Engineer (Developer Experience \& Internal Tooling)** 
 to take ownership of our internal infrastructure automation, developer portals, CI/CD templates, and shared deployment primitives. In this role, you will work at the intersection of DevOps, software engineering, and security. You won't just write scripts; you will architect self\-service developer workflows that abstract away the complexity of Kubernetes, Terraform, and cloud networking. Your work will directly accelerate our deployment frequency, reduce lead times for changes, and enforce enterprise\-grade security and compliance standards natively across all engineering squads without slowing them down.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Daily Expectations
   

  

* Internal Developer Platform (IDP) Architecture: Design, build, and scale our custom internal developer portal and self\-service provisioning cli tools, enabling engineers to spin up microservices, databases, and staging environments in minutes.
* CI/CD Pipeline Standardization: Architect, optimize, and maintain reusable, hardened CI/CD pipeline templates (via GitHub Actions) that incorporate automated testing, security scanning (SAST/DAST), and container building out\-of\-the\-box.
* Kubernetes \& Infrastructure Automation: Manage core Kubernetes cluster primitives, service meshes (such as Istio or Linkerd), ingress controllers, and immutable infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Atlantis.
* Developer Onboarding \& Experience: Streamline local development workflows using Docker, Devcontainers, and micro\-service scaffolding tools to reduce new engineer ramp\-up time from weeks to days.
* Observability \& Guardrails Integration: Implement monitoring for internal platform services, establish feedback loops for build performance, and embed compliance guardrails directly into developer self\-service workflows.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Security, DevOps, and Product Engineering squads to understand pain points, collect feedback, and continuously iterate on internal tooling architecture.


**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**
* Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure Automation, or senior DevOps roles within high\-growth tech product companies.
* Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt), and modern CI/CD orchestration engines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Programming Fluency: Strong scripting and software development skills in Go, Python, or Bash, with the ability to build robust internal command\-line utilities and automation services.
* Cloud Competency: Comprehensive hands\-on experience managing cloud architecture, IAM security policies, networking, and serverless compute primitives on AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Empathy \& Communication: Strong product mindset with an empathetic approach toward developer experience, exceptional documentation skills, and a collaborative attitude.


**What We Offer \& How To Apply**
* Competitive Compensation: Industry\-leading salary package (20–34 LPA) structured with base pay, performance bonuses, and meaningful equity participation.
* Modern Tech Stack \& Autonomy: Full ownership over platform choices, architecture designs, and internal tool adoption.
* Growth \& Wellness: Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you and your dependents, plus an annual learning stipend for certifications and tech conferences.

title: Product Quality Intern
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building more than just AI tools; we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world. From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally.
   

  

 But we’re just getting started. Our mission is clear: solve the biggest pain points in photography, and keep evolving with photographers who use our tools daily.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **About the Role**
 A wedding photographer shoots 4,000 photos on a Saturday.
   

  

 Before Aftershoot, that meant three nights hunched over a screen, clicking through near\-identical frames, missing dinner, missing their kids, missing the life they take pictures of for everyone else.
   

  

 With Aftershoot, it takes an hour.
   

  

 That hour is the entire product. 100,000\+ photographers around the world trust us with it. Culling, editing, retouching \- our AI does the grunt work so they can go back to doing the thing they actually love.
   

  

 Which means when we ship a bug, we don't ship an inconvenience. We ship somebody's ruined Sunday. That's where you come in.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Every engineer here builds a piece of the product. The PM holds the plan for it. Design holds the intent.
   

  

 You're the only person on the team whose entire job is to know what the product
 **actually does** 
 .
   

  

 Not what the ticket said. Not what the spec promised. What happens when a photographer drags in 12,000 RAW files, loses Wi\-Fi halfway through, closes the laptop lid, and reopens it four hours later on battery.
   

  

 We're not hiring you to tick boxes on a test sheet. You'll write code, own an automation suite, and hold the call on whether something is fit to go in front of 100,000 photographers. We're hiring you to become the person we can't ship without.
   

  

**Here's the bar we're setting, out loud:**
 Six months in, when an engineer and a PM disagree about how a flow is supposed to behave, someone in that room should say "just ask \[your name]" and that settles it.
   

  

 You will know this product better than the people who built it. That's not a stretch goal. That's the job.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Basic programming in JavaScript or TypeScript
* Comfort with browser developer tools
* A grasp of testing fundamentals — test cases, severity, the defect lifecycle, what regression actually means
* Sharp analytical instincts and genuinely strong attention to detail
* Clear written and verbal communication (a bug report is writing)
* Real eagerness to learn automation, not just tolerance for it
* BE/B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or B.Sc in CS/IT — freshers and final\-year students very welcome


**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
* Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress
* Git / GitHub
* REST APIs and API testing
* Anything you've built and shipped yourself, however small


**You will work with**
* Captain: Neha
* Team Members: Vikas, Aditi and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

title: R&D Engineering, Staff Engineer - Design Verification/ VIP Verification Engineers
description:
**We Are**
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

**You Are**
 You have spent years building Verification IP that engineers actually trust, not just IP that passes a checklist. The difference matters to you because you know a VIP is only as good as the edge cases it catches and the clarity it brings when something breaks at 2 a.m. in a customer lab. Debugging a protocol violation three layers deep does not frustrate you, it pulls you in because finding the root cause matters more than closing a ticket.
   

  

 When you read a protocol specification, you are already mapping out the sequences that will stress the implementation in ways the design team has not considered yet. You think in coverage metrics and edge cases. Working with AMBA, PCIe, Ethernet, DFI, or DRAM protocols long enough has taught you where the gaps usually hide and what good verification architecture looks like when it scales across products and customers.
   

  

 Deploying directly with customers does not feel like a distraction, it feels like the part where you learn what actually matters. Bringing tasks to closure is non\-negotiable because leaving something half done keeps you up at night. At Synopsys, you will work with protocol experts, Design IP teams, and industry\-leading verification tools. What you build will ship into semiconductor development workflows across the industry.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Design, develop, and maintain Verification IP using SystemVerilog and UVM for industry\-standard protocols including DFI, DRAM, AMBA, PCIe, USB, and Ethernet
* Build comprehensive verification plans that map protocol specifications to testable scenarios, coverage goals, and corner case strategies
* Code sequences, test scenarios, and checkers that drive coverage\-based verification across functional and code coverage dimensions
* Debug complex simulation failures across multi\-layer protocol stacks, identifying root causes in both VIP logic and customer integration environments
* Enhance existing VIP products for performance, reusability, and scalability as protocols evolve and customer use cases expand
* Support customers during VIP integration and deployment, troubleshooting issues, answering technical questions, and ensuring successful bring\-up
* Collaborate with Design IP teams, R\&D engineers, and field application teams to align VIP capabilities with product roadmaps and customer needs


**The Impact You Will Have**
* Your VIP will enable faster, more reliable verification for semiconductor companies building next\-generation SoCs and AI\-powered products
* Coverage\-driven verification strategies you implement will catch critical protocol violations before they reach silicon, saving months of debug time downstream
* Enhancements you make to existing VIP products will improve performance and expand protocol support across the Synopsys IP portfolio
* Customer deployments you support will directly influence how engineers at leading semiconductor companies adopt and trust Synopsys VIP
* Verification plans you create will set the standard for how protocol compliance is validated across complex, multi\-protocol designs
* Collaboration with Design IP teams will tighten the feedback loop between design and verification, improving quality across both disciplines
* Your work will contribute to a VIP product line used globally in semiconductor development, affecting how chips are verified at scale


**What You'll Need**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing Verification IP or SystemVerilog/UVM\-based test benches
* Deep working knowledge of at least two industry\-standard protocols such as AMBA (AXI, AHB, APB), DFI, DRAM, PCIe, or Ethernet
* Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog and UVM methodology for building reusable, scalable verification environments
* Demonstrated ability to create and execute coverage\-driven verification plans, including functional and code coverage analysis
* Experience debugging complex simulation failures and resolving issues across protocol layers and integration boundaries

title: Computer Engineering
description:
**Computer Engineering — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
 We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI models. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep technical knowledge is exactly what's needed to make these systems smarter, more accurate, and more reliable.
   

  

 You'll stress\-test advanced language models on complex hardware and systems topics, expose their failure modes, and help build the ground\-truth solutions that shape how AI reasons about computer engineering.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Create advanced computer engineering scenarios spanning RISC\-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, hardware\-software co\-design, embedded systems, and more
* Author Gold\-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams that serve as benchmarks for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated code (C/C\+\+, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and OS kernel implementations for technical accuracy, efficiency, and standards compliance
* Improve AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in AI\-generated reasoning — such as race conditions, memory leaks, or timing constraint violations — and provide structured feedback to improve model performance


**Who You Are**
* Pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science (hardware focus), or a closely related field
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of: Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems
* Able to communicate complex hardware concepts and low\-level software logic clearly in writing
* Highly detail\-oriented — comfortable working at the level of bit operations, clock cycles, and technical documentation
* No prior AI experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, data quality, or AI evaluation workflows
* Proficiency in engineering tools such as MATLAB, ANSYS, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with IoT, networking, distributed systems, or hardware security domains


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and institutions
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with experts worldwide
* Gain rare, firsthand exposure to how advanced LLMs are built and trained
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - NV Cloud Functions
description:
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA Cloud Functions (NVCF) is an open\-source platform that links workloads to GPUs. It lets teams deploy, manage, and serve GPU\-accelerated, containerized applications across regions and clusters worldwide. The platform routes inference, streaming, and batch jobs across decentralized GPU clusters. This allows endpoints to scale repeatably, whether hosted on\-prem or in the cloud.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team. You will focus on improving the performance, reliability, and scaling behavior of a system that routes AI workloads onto distributed GPU fleets. You will work on a polyglot platform that is now fully open source, with both control plane and edge deployments. The work suits someone with deep experience in systems performance, distributed systems, and Kubernetes\-based runtimes. We are looking for engineers who want to learn and grow. Expect to be challenged in an environment with rapidly shifting priorities, where insight, focus, and execution are key.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* You'll be working in a distributed team that explores innovative ways to make GPU\- and DPU\-accelerated applications easier to develop, deploy, and monitor on the latest and greatest NVIDIA hardware.
* Design and ship services in Java, Go, and Rust, building in the open on a public repository where your commits, design proposals, and reviews are transparent to the community.
* Work on automating and optimizing build, test, integration, and release processes for cloud native.
* Partner with engineering teams across NVIDIA so the platform integrates with adjacent NVIDIA technologies, including the KAI Scheduler, NVIDIA NIM, Grove, and Dynamo.
* Help steward an open\-source project. You will triage community issues and pull requests and write docs contributors can build on.


**What We Need To See**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years of hands\-on software engineering.
* Expert\-level knowledge in a systems programming language (Go, C, Rust) and a proven understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Distributed Software Architecture
* Strong understanding of container orchestration systems (Kubernetes) and container technologies with hands\-on automation experience in continuous integration frameworks like GitLab \& ArgoCD.
* Expertise in a scripting language (Bash, Python) and knowledge and experience working with the system internals of Unix/Unix\-like kernels such as Linux.
* Understanding of performance, security, and reliability in complex distributed systems.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Background with pub\-sub models and message queues
* Experience optimizing for high\-throughput network paths, with a working understanding of unary versus streaming and bidirectional protocols across HTTP/2 and gRPC.
* Experience with developing Kubernetes Custom Resources and Operators deployed in Cloud Service Providers


 With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking individuals in the industry working for us. Due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are expanding rapidly. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

title: Lean 4 programmer
description:
**Company Description** 




**Moleculyst Ventures Private Limited is an AI research and engineering company focused on building reliable, autonomous, and self\-improving AI systems. Our work includes LLM reasoning, hallucination detection, automated research pipelines, interpretability, formal verification, and systems that can evaluate and improve their own problem\-solving procedures.** 




**We are particularly interested in combining modern language models with rigorous mathematical and computational tools. One area of our work involves integrating formal theorem provers such as Lean 4 into AI systems so that mathematical reasoning and generated proofs can be mechanically verified rather than accepted solely on the basis of model output.** 




**Role Description** 




**We are looking for a Lean 4 Programmer** 
 to work on formal theorem proving and its integration with AI systems.
 



 The role will involve writing and verifying formal proofs in Lean 4, working with Mathlib, understanding and manipulating proof states, and developing infrastructure that allows AI models to generate, test, repair, and verify formal proofs.
 



 You will collaborate with our AI research and engineering team on systems where language models interact programmatically with Lean. Depending on experience and interests, the work may also involve tactic development, Lean metaprogramming, automated theorem proving, proof\-search systems, dataset generation, and evaluation of LLM mathematical reasoning.
 



 This is a
 **part\-time, remote role** 
 with flexible working hours and regular online collaboration with the research team.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Write, debug, and maintain formal proofs in
 **Lean 4** 
 .
* Work extensively with
 **Mathlib** 
 and existing Lean libraries.
* Formalize mathematical statements and translate informal proofs into machine\-checkable Lean proofs.
* Diagnose proof failures and work effectively with Lean proof states, goals, tactics, and error messages.
* Help build interfaces between
 **LLMs and the Lean 4 theorem prover** 
 .
* Develop methods for automatically generating, checking, repairing, and evaluating proofs.
* Contribute reusable Lean code, tactics, utilities, and formalization infrastructure.
* Review generated proofs for correctness, maintainability, and appropriate use of Mathlib.
* Collaborate with researchers working on automated reasoning, AI evaluation, and autonomous research systems.
* Document formalizations, experiments, and technical workflows clearly.



**Qualifications** 



* Practical experience with
 **Lean 4** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **Mathlib** 
 and Lean's tactic/proof ecosystem.
* Strong understanding of mathematical proofs, logic, or discrete mathematics.
* Comfortable programming and debugging formal proofs rather than only writing informal mathematics.
* Familiarity with concepts from
 **type theory, formal methods, theorem proving, or proof assistants** 
 .
* Experience with Lean metaprogramming, tactic development, automated theorem proving, or proof search is a strong advantage.
* Experience with other proof assistants such as Coq, Isabelle, Agda, or HOL is useful, but Lean 4 experience is strongly preferred.
* Programming experience in Python or another general\-purpose language is beneficial, particularly for integrating Lean with external systems.
* Interest in
 **LLMs, automated reasoning, AI\-assisted mathematics, or formal verification**

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About Us:** 




 We are a profitable health\-tech brand focusing on men's sexual wellness, scaling our revenue target from 5 cr to 40 cr this year. We have cracked Product\-Market Fit and are now rebuilding our core engine to handle an 8x traffic multiplier. Because of our niche, user data is highly sensitive.
 



  





**\[Expected Compensation Range: ₹35,00,000 – ₹55,00,000 per annum]** 




  





**The Role:** 




 The Permanent Player\-Coach We do not want an Engineering Manager who only manages Jira boards, nor do we want a lone\-wolf architect. This is a hands\-on Engineering Manager role. We expect a 60/40 split: you will spend the majority of your time writing the hardest architectural code and the remaining managing the humans writing the rest.
 



  





**Experience Range:** 




 8 to 12 years of backend development, with proven architectural responsibilities, system design and team management experience.
 



  





**The 6\-Month Trajectory:** 




 ● 
 **Months 1\-2 (Heavy Architecture):** 
 Your focus will be architecting the AWS\-to\-Zoho pipelines and queues, getting your hands dirty in the codebase, and earning the technical respect of the current team.
 



 ●
 **Months 3\-6\+ (The Steady State):** 
 You will take full ownership of the tech org and begin exploring the manager side of the role.
 



 You will be building critical features and running the Weekly Triage, conducting 1\-on\-1s, and partnering with the existing Tech Lead to optimize sprint delivery.
 



 You’ll begin representing the engineering function at the org level and with various internal/external stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ● Architect the Core (The "Player"): Design and build the resilient integration layer between our systems and the Zoho ecosystem.
 



 ● Lead the Team (The "Coach"): Partner with our existing Technical Lead (who will act as your elite Delivery Lead). Run the Weekly Triage, enforce strict Kanban flow, and protect the team from scope creep.
 



 ● Own System Security: Ensure secure API design, implementing data encryption, payload masking, and strict access controls to prevent data breaches of highly sensitive patient histories.
 



 ● Manage Technical Debt: Establish proper coding standards and automated testing thresholds without bringing feature velocity to a halt.
 



 ● Mentorship: Upskill a team of 5\-6 junior developers with the empathy and patience to turn them into enterprise\-grade engineers.
 



 ● Pair With The Product Management Function: Partner with the product management function to streamline the roadmap.
 



 ● Stakeholder Management: Be the face of the engineering organization for internal/external stakeholders.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 ● 8 to 12 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of managing at least one small team through a rapid scaling phase (the "1 to 10" journey).
 



 ● Senior\-level proficiency in backend architecture (Node.js) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL). Frontend experience, while not mandatory, will be a BIG plus.\*
 



 ● Deep, practical, hands\-on experience designing and managing message queues and asynchronous background jobs.
 



 ● Experience integrating complex third\-party enterprise suites (specifically CRMs) and handling massive traffic spikes.
 



 ● High empathy and low ego; you must know how to partner with an existing, hard\-working startup team rather than dictating changes on day one.
 



 ● Working knowledge of DevOps workflows on any of the public clouds (AWS\*, GCP, Azure)

description:

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**






 Coro is Bain’s persistent product development and engineering organization serving the firm’s digital solutions across Commercial Excellence (B2B) and the newly established Demand Generation Suite (B2C). Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.
 





 This role sits within the newly established B2C pillar of Coro, building the technical foundation for Artemis – Bain’s AI\-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform, and one of three products in the Demand Generation Suite.
 




  






**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM** 






 The Software Engineer role is a full stack engineering position focused on building and maintaining product features across the Artemis backend (Python/FastAPI) and frontend (React/TypeScript). Engineers in this role contribute to platform capabilities used by consultants and clients in live engagements, working within established patterns and with guidance from senior team members. Contributions span both the API layer and the React components that surface those capabilities to users — including the marketing mix model configuration interface, channel allocation dashboards, scenario planning tools, and client\-ready output views.
 





 This is a delivery\-focused role for engineers who are ready to contribute meaningfully across the full stack and grow their ownership over time. The core expectation is shipping well\-tested features within defined specifications, collaborating closely with senior engineers, and developing the habits and judgment that come with working in a production product environment. Additional responsibilities include participating in support and operations by identifying system defects, contributing to troubleshooting efforts, and supporting code deployments.
 




  






**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 





 Feature Development
 
* Implement features across backend API logic and React frontend components for assigned Artemis product areas, working from clear specifications and with guidance from senior engineers. Contribute to taking features from development through testing and deployment across both layers.
* Build and maintain backend routes for assigned product areas, following established patterns for request/response contracts, versioning, and testing. Keep TypeScript type contracts on the frontend in sync with backend changes.



 Frontend and Data Visualization 
 
* Build and maintain React components using the shared Demand Generation Suite design system, contributing to marketing analytics interfaces including channel allocation dashboards, scenario comparison views, and model configuration workflows. Follow established component and styling conventions.
* Write database queries and data access logic for Artemis data models, following existing schema and migration patterns. Develop familiarity with the data volumes and access patterns typical of marketing analytics engagements.



 Quality and Collaboration
 
* Write and maintain tests for backend and frontend code. Ensure new features ship with adequate coverage and do not degrade existing functionality, with support from senior engineers on testing strategy.
* Participate in structured feedback sessions with Artemis Expert Consultants and go\-to\-market\-aligned specialists. Contribute observations and help translate feedback into concrete improvements in subsequent sprints.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across the team and with adjacent stakeholders.



 Innovation \& Emerging Technologies
 
* Drive innovation through out\-of\-the\-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands.
* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs.
* Investigate and keep up\-to\-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing.
* Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches.



  






**ABOUT YOU** 





 Technical
 
* Proficient in Python for backend development, with exposure to or interest in async frameworks (FastAPI or equivalent). Able to implement features within an established codebase and framework.
* Proficient in React and TypeScript in a production or near\-production context, with foundational understanding of state management patterns, data fetching, and TypeScript type safety.
* Familiarity with CSS and comfort working within component libraries and design systems, following established conventions rather than authoring them from scratch.
* Working knowledge of relational databases: writing SQL queries, reading and modifying schemas, and debugging query issues.
* Exposure to data visualization libraries for building chart\-based interfaces is a plus.
* Experience contributing to time and cost estimates of product enhancements, advise on trade\-offs of features.
* Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to support and accelerate development workflows.
* Results\-driven, with an analytical and collaborative mindset. Eager to learn and grow in a fast\-paced Agile environment.



 Education
 
* Associate/Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.



 Experience
 
* 2\-3\+ years of experience building full\-stack web applications.


* Track record of delivering in an Agile environment.
* Experience with troubleshooting and issue resolution skills.
* Experience building web interfaces for data\-heavy or analytics applications, where outputs are used by business users to make commercial decisions, highly preferred.
* Exposure to marketing, media, or commercial data (such as spend, sales, or campaign performance) in any context, including academic or side projects, is a plus.

title: Platform Engineer - OpenStack
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cloudstrats is an Indian exponential technology product company that builds Artificial Intelligence platforms powered by analytics and automation. Its solutions use computer vision, speech, and text technologies to address complex real\-world challenges for government and enterprise customers. The company’s platforms apply Deep Learning, NLP, and ML to support sustainable development goals across sectors such as citizen services, public safety, education, health, and transport. Cloudstrats delivers marquee projects including command control centers, e\-governance solutions, grievance redressal platforms, data hubs, fraud detection, and health systems. The organization is driven by the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and large\-scale digital transformation in India and beyond.
 



  





***Immediate Joiners preferred.***




  





**About the Role.** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on private\-cloud engineer who can take an OpenStack\-based platform from bare metal to a working, accepted, and supportable production environment — and then own it through its operational lifecycle.
 



 This is a greenfield deployment covering compute, software\-defined storage, GPU enablement, Kubernetes, and an AI/ML platform. You'll lead or contribute to technical delivery, automation, capacity growth, operational improvement, resilience testing, documentation, and training of the internal cloud team.
 



 This is not a role for someone who has only consumed OpenStack through a dashboard. We need someone who has deployed it, broken it, recovered it, automated it, and documented it — using Kolla Ansible as the deployment tooling.
 



 The role combines architecture input with hands\-on engineering. You won't be expected to single\-handedly deliver every specialist subsystem without support, but you must understand the full platform and be able to troubleshoot across its major layers.
 



  





**What You will do.** 




 Deployment \& Architecture
 


* Design and deploy a multi\-node OpenStack private cloud using Kolla Ansible
* Configure a highly available control plane and define service placement, failure domains, and network segmentation (management, API, provider, tenant, external)
* Deploy and configure core services: Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Maintain version\-controlled inventory, configuration, and secrets\-management procedures
* Produce architecture documents, capacity plans, and implementation runbooks



 Storage
 


* Design and deploy a distributed software\-defined storage platform (Ceph preferred) as the shared substrate
* Integrate block/image storage with Glance, Cinder, and Nova; stand up an S3\-compatible object endpoint
* Define replication/erasure\-coding policies, failure domains, and capacity thresholds
* Validate failure, degraded\-mode, and recovery behaviour



 Networking \& Security
 


* Design and configure management, API, provider, tenant, storage, and tunnel networks
* Implement VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, and security groups per the organisation's addressing standards
* Apply security\-hardening baselines and maintain compliance evidence



 Compute \& Workloads
 


* Build and maintain golden images and flavour catalogues (CPU, memory, NUMA, huge pages, GPU profiles)
* Configure host aggregates, availability zones, and placement/scheduling policies
* Restore and re\-platform existing Windows and Linux workloads into the new environment



 GPU Enablement
 


* Enable GPU access end\-to\-end: firmware, BIOS, IOMMU, kernel parameters, drivers, device binding
* Configure PCI passthrough or vGPU as required; configure Nova PCI aliases, traits, and scheduler filters
* Expose GPU resources to Kubernetes worker nodes via appropriate device plugins



 Kubernetes \& AI/ML Platform
 


* Deploy and operate a highly available Kubernetes cluster on the private cloud
* Configure CNI, ingress, RBAC, CSI\-backed persistent storage, and GPU\-schedulable nodes
* Deploy an approved AI/ML workspace platform (notebooks, training jobs, model serving) with per\-project isolation and quotas



 Identity \& Enterprise Integration
 


* Integrate with the organisation's enterprise directory; configure SSO/federation across OpenStack, Kubernetes, and the AI workspace
* Implement role mapping, least\-privilege access, and credential\-rotation procedures



 Monitoring, Logging \& Audit
 


* Implement monitoring/alerting across hosts, OpenStack services, storage, VMs, Kubernetes, and GPU utilisation
* Configure centralised logging, audit collection, and alert escalation



 Resilience, Backup \& Recovery
 


* Define and execute resilience tests (compute/controller/storage/network/Kubernetes/GPU/identity failure scenarios)
* Validate backup/restore against agreed RTO/RPO targets
* Produce test plans, execution evidence, and resilience reports



 Restricted\-Network Delivery
 


* Build and maintain internal package repositories and private container registries
* Prepare an offline bill of materials (packages, images, charts, drivers, firmware, licenses)
* Establish controlled import, scanning, signing, and promotion procedures
* Ensure deployment, patching, and recovery can operate without dependency on public internet access



 Lifecycle Ownership
 *(post go\-live)* 



* Own technical evolution: capacity expansion, tuning, upgrades, automation
* Act as escalation point for platform issues; lead root\-cause analysis
* Maintain architecture documents, SOPs, and runbooks
* Train the internal cloud engineering team to independent competency



  





**Experience we Need.** 




  





 Core
 


* 6\+ years infrastructure/platform\-engineering experience; 3\+ years hands\-on OpenStack
* Demonstrable delivery of at least one production OpenStack environment from install through acceptance
* Evidence of personal technical contribution, not just project oversight



  





 OpenStack \& Kolla Ansible
 


* Strong working knowledge of Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Hands\-on Kolla Ansible: inventory, globals config, secrets handling, bootstrap, prechecks, deployment, validation, upgrades
* Ability to troubleshoot containerised OpenStack services and deployment failures



  





 Storage
 


* Hands\-on experience with a distributed SDS platform (Ceph preferred)
* Experience integrating storage with Glance/Cinder/Nova and Kubernetes CSI



  





 Linux, Compute \& Networking
 


* Deep Linux systems engineering (kernel, drivers, systemd, networking, storage stacks)
* Strong KVM/QEMU understanding
* VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, DNS, NTP, load balancing



  





 Kubernetes \& AI Platforms
 


* Production Kubernetes deployment and operation experience
* GPU scheduling via vendor device plugins
* AI/ML platform deployment (notebooks, training, model serving) strongly preferred



  





 GPU Virtualisation
 


* PCI/IOMMU passthrough, device binding, driver installation and validation in VMs/containers



  





 Identity, Observability \& Automation
 


* Enterprise directory integration, SSO/RBAC, certificate and secrets management
* Strong Python/shell scripting and Ansible or equivalent IaC experience



  





 Restricted\-Network Environments
 


* Demonstrable experience delivering in air\-gapped or restricted\-network environments
* Comfortable with formal change control, security review, and audit evidence



  





**Desirable.** 



* Ceph RBD, CephFS, RADOS Gateway
* Octavia, Barbican, Ironic, Heat, Swift, Manila
* Kubeflow, JupyterHub, MLflow, Ray, KServe, vLLM, or comparable AI/ML platforms
* NVIDIA GPU operators or equivalent vendor tooling
* Multi\-site disaster recovery experience
* CKA / CKS / Linux / OpenStack certifications (supplementary to delivery evidence, not a substitute



  





**You will own.** 




 High\-level and low\-level architecture · Capacity\-sizing workbook · Kolla Ansible configuration · IP/VLAN/DNS/firewall matrix · Storage architecture and recovery procedures · GPU enablement report · Kubernetes and AI\-platform architecture · Restricted\-network BOM · Security baseline · Monitoring/logging catalogue · Backup/RTO/RPO design · Migration and cutover plan · Resilience test plan and evidence · As\-built documentation · Runbooks and SOPs · Training materials

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

title: SDE II, Last Mile
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. Node Receive COD team handles the process of receiving packages, routing them back to right origin, and handling Cash on delivery reconciliations and liabilities among driver, station and bank.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an SDE\-2, you will develop a deep understanding of our business, work closely with development teams and own the architecture and end\-to\-end delivery of software components.
